### 26.5 C. Bencana Bintang & Murka Langit

#### 26.5.1 Sumber / Source

- *Renegade Immortal* ch. ~1157–1159 (DESIGN 20.3.19 / 23.20): Ancient Gods grow by stars and face Three Trials with Seven Calamities (2 + 2 + 3); most meet the first at six stars; failing means death (here: injury); Wang Lin ends at Heaven Trampling.
- *I Shall Seal the Heavens* Book 4 ch. 385 "Bring It On!": Meng Hao says the Heavens are trying to slay him; the lightning gathers far more intensely after his defiance. Ch. 386 "Five Colored Sky, Cultivation Base Breakthrough!": his laughter angers the heavens and more lightning joins. The envoys and the Panglima are *terinspirasi dari* these chapters; the beings themselves are game design (the source answers with lightning, drawn here by the client only).
- In-mod precedent: DESIGN 3 Dao Protectors.

#### 26.5.2 The player's Seven Calamities

**Gate.** Calamity k (1–7) gates star `s_k = f + 9(k − 1)`, with the 20.3.19 rule: f = 6 (average breakthrough quality Normal or lower), 7 (Perfect), 8 (Heavenly, Sempurna Foundation or Darah Dewa Kuno). Spine `Stars.StarGate` (#7): `ImmortalPerks.condense` stops before `s_k` with "Bencana ke-k menanti" and a [Mulai] link; Stored Qi keeps filling.

**Run** (`purba/StarCalamity`): start from the Bencana tablet or `/kultivasi bencana mulai`; the star's cost is deducted at the start; omen 6 s; `6 + k` strikes of `(0.12 + 0.01 × trial) × max HP` (trial 1 for k 1–2, 2 for k 3–4, 3 for k 5–7), one per 60 ticks, the last ×1.5 (audit integrasi; was ×2), with lightning rings (NS+, twin from IA) and a graze (40% damage, heals 6%), through `Tribulation.strike` inside `Tribulation.ritualBegin/ritualEnd` (Hu Fa guards it through `Listener.onRitual`) (would-kill = failure); every 3 strikes an envoy wave of `2 + k` with health ×(1 + 0.5k). DeathGuard `LANGIT` covers every source during the run.

**Segel Penangkal:** consuming 3 `heaven_seal_shard` at the start makes every strike ×0.85 for that run (game design; the shards' sink).

| Result | Effect |
|---|---|
| **Lulus** | The star condenses. Finishing a Trial (k = 2, 4, 7) multiplies T by 1.1 (≤ 1.331). T multiplies `S(stars)` in `P_player` (spine #5 `addPlayerStarFactor`) and the star health bonus in `Stats`. |
| **Gagal** | "Luka Bencana": Qi Deviation 12,000 ticks; no star; 50% of the cost back to Stored Qi. |
| After k = 7 | title **Penginjak Langit** (Status page), server announcement, EXTRA `PLAYER_TRAMPLING`, advancement `heaven_trampler_player` |

Skipped calamities (26.1) can be run any time for T alone; they never take a star back. `starCalamities = false` registers no gate.

#### 26.5.3 Murka Langit: the wrath descent and the Heaven's duel

**Who:** players with ≥ 1 calamity passed or skipped, when `heavenlyWrath = true`.

**Schedule:** a roll at each dusk (overworld day time 12,000) when `game day ≥ extra.purba.wrath_next`; then `wrath_next = day + heavenlyWrathDays (5; 3–15) ± 1`. **Live only if** the player had input in the last 60 s, not Peaceful, not in a realm run, a live raid of their own hall, a tribulation, a calamity, an ascension, a primordial fight or a batin defence, not riding or gliding, and in the Overworld or Alam Abadi. Otherwise retried next dusk; after 2 skips it lapses with no penalty.

**Flow:** omen 30 s ("Langit menatapmu…", EXTRA `WRATH_OMEN`, white-gold sky grade, a chat line citing ISSTH) → three waves of 2, 3, 4 Utusan, 15 s apart or when the previous wave is cleared (advancement `wrath_repelled`) → **Duel Kehendak Langit**: the **Panglima Langit** descends; only the challenged player's damage counts (disciples, mates and formations deal 0 to it, but still fight the waves); boss bar "Panglima Langit · ★{stars}".

| Result | Effect |
|---|---|
| **Menang** | 25% star share; 6–12 Batu (in the Overworld too); 2 `heaven_seal_shard`; BOSS beat kind `BOSS_HEAVEN_GENERAL`; advancement `heaven_general` |
| **Kalah** (DeathGuard `LANGIT`) | 1 HP; "Luka Langit" 10 min (technique ×0.85); the descent ends; no item loss |

#### 26.5.4 Entity `kultivator:heaven_envoy` (Utusan Murka Langit and the Panglima)

- `HeavenEnvoyEntity extends Monster`, built like `RogueCultivatorEntity`: never saved, `NoGrief.TAG`, no loot pickup, no doors, no custom name. Synced `kind` (0 envoy, 1 Panglima).
- Renderer `client/purba/EnvoyRenderer` like `RogueRenderer`: `DiscipleRenderState` + player model, white-gold robe tint, client halo ring (FxBudget), slightly translucent `getModelTint`.
- Tags `kultivator.abadi_foe`; the Panglima also `kultivator.boss`.

| | HP | Melee | Skills (share of the target's max HP) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Utusan | `24 × 3 × (1 + 0.35 R_eff) × (1 + 0.5k in calamities)`; ★9 299 | `4 + R_eff + 3` | **Tombak Cahaya**: line telegraphed 1 s, 8% |
| Panglima Langit | `24 × 12 × (1 + 0.35 R_eff)`; ★9 1,195; ★36 1,498; intake 4%/s | `6 + 1.5 R_eff` | **Pedang Hukuman**: line telegraphed 1.5 s, 20% · **Rantai Langit**: root 2 s (BIND rules) · **Segel Pengadilan**: 6-block ring telegraphed 2 s, 15% + Weakness II 5 s · at 50% HP **Murka**: skill frequency ×1.3 |

**Drops:** envoys 20% `heaven_seal_shard`, XP `combatXp × 5`, no beast cores. ≤ 8 envoys alive (waves queue).

**Contract for A:** `int Purba.spawnEnvoyWave(ServerPlayer target, int count, int k, Consumer<Boolean> onCleared)`.

### 26.6 D. Dunia Batin (the inner world)

#### 26.6.1 Sumber / Source

*Reverend Insanity* (RevI) ch. 409 "Managing the Blessed Land": the land spirit represents the land and knows everything in it; earthly calamities strike every ten years and Hu Immortal withstood five; the 2nd was a meteor fire rain that ruined the east; the 4th a flood over the northern grassland; the 5th a human-shaped blue lightning shadow that avoids Dang Hun Mountain, where its soul would be shocked to ash; over 1,300 of 4,000 km² were lost; time inside passes five times faster; green, grape-like immortal essence pearls; an underground rockman tribe that eats ore; about 4.7 million foxes. *Terinspirasi dari* RevI (fan wiki, unofficial): rank 6–7 Gu Immortals' apertures are blessed lands graded by size — the reason the inner world is born at the Immortal ascension. **Game design:** plots, rates, calendar scale, defence events, every number.

#### 26.6.2 Birth and grade

Born on A's ascension success (`Abadi.addAscendListener`); advancement `batin_born`. Grade from the average breakthrough quality and `Ascension.flawlessPath(data)`:

| Grade | When | Plots | Pearls per day | Fox cap |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kecil | average ≤ Normal | 4 | 1 | 1,000 |
| Sedang | Perfect | 6 | 2 | 2,000 |
| Besar | Heavenly | 9 | 3 | 3,000 |
| Agung | Heavenly + flawless path | 12 | 4 | 4,000 |

- **Perluas:** +1 plot for 16 Batu + 1 `#kultivator:primordial_material`, up to 16. `land_expansion_token` (auction lot) gives +1 plot when used.
- **Calendar:** 1 in-game day outside = 2 "Tahun Batin" (game scale). The ×5 of RevI ch. 409 is the herb growth multiplier.

#### 26.6.3 What lives inside (data in `extra.batin`, zero ticking)

Everything advances by elapsed overworld days when the Batin page opens or on the player's day roll (lazy). Catch-up ≤ 10 days.

- **Petak Herba:** plant any `SpiritHerbs.isHerb` item (consumed). Age +25 per outside day × (1 + Kesuburan), cap 3,000. Harvest returns `SpiritHerbs.create(kind, age)`; from age ≥ 1,000 a harvest also returns a second herb of the same kind at age 100. One herb per plot; only clicks move herbs.
- **Kawanan Rubah:** starts at 100, +5% per day up to the grade cap. **Kesuburan** = +1% herb growth per 100 foxes (≤ +40%). Shown as a number and a sprite; no entities.
- **Manusia Batu:** awakened once by depositing 64 items of `#kultivator:rockmen_ore` (P9-batin tag: iron/copper ores incl. deepslate, `raw_iron`, `raw_copper`, gold/redstone/lapis ores, `raw_gold`, diamond/emerald ores; never ancient debris). Then they eat from **Lubang Bijih** (≤ 256 items, consumed on deposit; no withdrawal, so no duplication). Each day 32 items: 8 iron/copper → 1 Mid stone; 4 gold/redstone/lapis → 1 Mid; 1 diamond/emerald ore → 1 High. Every 7th day 1 Batu. Advancement `rockmen`.
- **Mutiara Esensi Abadi:** virtual counter (≤ 99) filled by the grade rate. Withdraw as `immortal_essence_pearl` (≤ 16 per day). Uses: Jurus Ciptaan, Perkokoh, **Seduh** (1 pearl = 1% of `Stars.barSize` as Qi Abadi, ≤ 5 per day).
- **Roh Tanah:** a card with a name rolled from 8 (e.g. "Roh Rubah Kecil"); reports status, warns one outside day before a calamity, keeps the last 10 events.

#### 26.6.4 Bencana Bumi (every `innerWorldCalamityDays` = "ten inner years"; default 5; 3–15; 0 = off)

Type cycles with the calamity number n: **Hujan Api Meteor → Banjir Besar → Bayangan Petir**, then again at +1 strength.

**Due:** **live** when the owner is online, active (input in 60 s), not in a run, raid, tribulation, calamity, ascension, primordial fight or wrath descent, and ≥ 70% of a 16-block ring is `safeSpot`. It waits up to 1 outside day for that, then **resolves as data**. EXTRA `INNER_CALAMITY` and a land-spirit chat line. Boss bar "Bencana Bumi ke-n".

**Live defence (90 s, around the player, entity-only):**

| Calamity | Mechanic | Loss |
|---|---|---|
| **Hujan Api Meteor** (RevI 2nd) | `12 + 4n` `batin_meteor` entities (≤ 16 alive; HP `20 × (1 + 0.35 R_eff)`, `abadi_foe`) fall from 40 blocks over 6 s each with a ground-ring telegraph. Destroy them in the air. A landing: 3-block burst 10% max HP + entity fire (no block fire, no explosion) | landed / 4 plots "Terbakar" (herbs destroyed, plot unusable 3 days) |
| **Banjir Besar** (RevI 4th) | channel **Tanggul Qi** inside a 4-block circle for a total of 60 s (progress kept). `2 + n` waves of "Roh Air Bah" (`RogueCultivators.spawn` tier 2, `VARIANT_ENERGY`, `ROLE_QUEST`, tracked). A hit above 15% max HP interrupts | unfinished share × plots "Terendam" (herb age −30%, never below 1) |
| **Bayangan Petir** (RevI 5th) | one "Bayangan Petir Berbentuk Manusia": `RogueCultivators.spawn` tier 4, `VARIANT_ENERGY`, health modifier `kultivator:batin_calamity` ×(1 + 0.15n), boss bar, `abadi_foe`. A **Gunung Dang Hun** glyph ring (r 5, client Displays) 8 blocks away: inside it the shadow takes ×2 damage and is slowed. Lure it in. Lightning visuals client-only | foxes −20%, pearls −10, 1 plot "Hangus" |

**Win:** `5 × n` pearls, foxes +10%, a land-spirit line, advancement `batin_calamity`.

**Data resolution:** `P(survive) = clamp(0.30 + 0.10 × fortify + 0.05 × rockmen awake + 0.05 × grade index, 0.30, 0.90)`. **Perkokoh** (fortify): 10 pearls per step, ≤ 3, bought before the due time. A loss applies **half** of the live loss. Peaceful: always survive.

**Never:** items in the player's inventory, blocks, or the land below 2 usable plots.

### 26.7 E. Jurus Ciptaan Sendiri (self-created techniques)

#### 26.7.1 Sumber / Source

- *I Shall Seal the Heavens* ch. 1379 "Incredible Power": Meng Hao calls his last Hex "my own Ninth Hex" (`ninth_hex` already cites ch. 1379, 1465, 1534, 1540).
- *Battle Through the Heavens* ch. 262 "Merging the 'Heavenly Flames', Angry Buddha Lotus Flame!" and ch. 363 "Killing Yun Leng" (Xiao Yan brings two flames together; even Medusa did not know the Angry Buddha Lotus Flame existed): the precedent for a technique born from fusing two powers. The disciples' Buddha lotus (20.3.16) stays separate.
- *Coiling Dragon*: Linley fuses profound mysteries of different elements (`mystery_fusion`, 22.2.7); its pair rows are reused.
- **Game design:** slots, forms, coefficients, quality, costs, naming.

#### 26.7.2 Registration (6c engine, no runtime registry change)

`TechniqueRegistry` is frozen at init on both sides, so **three fixed specs** go in the new net-id block 1100–1199 (`module("CiptaanArts", 1100, 1199, CiptaanArts::register)` before `freeze()`, spine #15):

| netId | id | Spec |
|---|---|---|
| 1100 / 1101 / 1102 | `own_art_1` / `own_art_2` / `own_art_3` | Dao `null`, grade DEWA sub 0, type PAMUNGKAS, realm TRUE_IMMORTAL, flag `NO_TEACH`, `special = "own_art"`, keep-alive timeline (40 t), qiPct 70, cooldown 480 s; fx/shake/source entries so `uji teknik audit` passes |

- Lang: "Jurus Ciptaan I/II/III" / "Created Art I/II/III" + `.desc`, `.source`, `.lore` (in `lang-src/arts_ciptaan.*`). No route; never loot.
- The player's own name: `extra.batin.ciptaan[i].name`, shown on the Ciptaan page, in the Kitab Teknik (server `Codex.addNameProvider`, client `CodexNames.register`, spine #12, fed from `CH_BATIN`) and on the cast action bar. Lists still sort by spec id.
- Creation calls `data.learn("own_art_i")`; destroying a creation un-learns it and clears its loadout slots and mastery.

#### 26.7.3 Creating an art (the Ciptaan tablet)

- **Needs:** Dunia Batin born, TI Puncak, two Daos with comprehension ≥ 60 (the same Dao twice at ≥ 90 = "Murni").
- **Choose:** Dao A, Dao B, a form, a name of 1–24 characters matching `[\p{L}\p{N} '\-]` (trimmed, server-sanitised, no formatting codes, `§` refused).
- **Cost:** 20 pearls + 1 `#primordial_material` + 10% of `Stars.barSize` in Qi Abadi (Stored Qi).
- **Pencerahan Ciptaan:** 60 s meditation channel; interrupted = full refund (costs are taken only at completion).
- **Quality** `Q = clamp(0.55 + (compA + compB − 120) / 200 + 0.03 × Purba.distinctKinds, 0.55, 1.0)`, shown as "Kesempurnaan 55–100%". **Sempurnakan:** half the cost, re-roll Q, keep the higher.
- **Slots:** ≤ 3; overwriting asks for confirmation.

**Forms (CRITIC: coefficients held at or below the catalogue's strongest single coefficient, 18):**

| Form | Shape (built at cast time through `CastContext` and the same run helpers `MysteryFusion` uses; every 22.3.5 rule and cap) | Coef at Q = 1 |
|---|---|---|
| Tebasan Dao | BEAM 64 × width 3 (`BEAM_LENGTH_CAP_DEWA`) | 18 |
| Ledakan Dao | NOVA at the aim, r 12 → 20 (≤ 32) | 15 |
| Hujan Dao | RAIN r 16, 18 impacts × 1.0, ≤ 6 impacts per target | 18 total |
| Gelombang Dao | FRONT 64 × 16 × 8, speed 4 | 16 |
| Wilayah Dao | ZONE r 14 for 8 s, 10 pulses × 1.4 (each ≤ the 2% boss tick) | 14 |
| Segel Dao | needs a target: ROOT 3 s (BIND rules), then a strike | 16 |

- **Dao pair effect:** the two Daos' 22.10.1 domain pulses at ×1.5; where `MysteryFusion` has a pair row, that row applies (its public constants, e.g. `FIRE_ICE_FACTOR`). Murni: coef +15% and its pulse ×2.
- Damage = coef × Q × P through the choke points; boss caps, trial-mob, `abadi_foe` and arena rules all apply. Mastery levels 3–4 as 22.6 (no ECHO, as `mystery_fusion`).
- Kehancuran: `DShape.bowl(4)` for NOVA and RAIN, `DShape.trench(...)` for BEAM and FRONT, only when the existing switch is on.
- FX: TechFx events with the two Dao colours packed in `count` (the `MysteryFusion` convention), drawn by `client/batin/CiptaanFx` from existing templates (RUNE_CIRCLE, LASER, SHOCK_RING, SKY) + a SHAKE layer. EXTRA `OWN_ART_BORN` on the first cast. Advancements `own_art`, `own_art_perfect` (Q = 100%).

### 26.8 F. Lelang Abadi & Pengejaran (the Immortal auction)

#### 26.8.1 Sumber / Source

*RMJ: Immortal Realm* ch. 615 "Another Beast Bone" (a bidding war in Immortal Origin Stones: 3,800 → 4,000 → 4,300 → 5,000) and ch. 567 "Pursuit" (Han Li flees on an origin-stone-powered carriage). "A contested win draws a pursuer" is *terinspirasi dari* these two chapters; rival names, lots, prices and timings are game design.

#### 26.8.2 Sessions

- **When:** one session per 2 in-game days, overworld day time 12,000 → 18,000. Lots seeded by `(world seed, session index)`; all players see the same lots and compete. State is session-only, in memory; a restart mid-session voids open lots with no charge.
- **Where:** the Lelang tablet, active only while the viewer is in Alam Abadi; elsewhere it shows the next session time.
- **Lots:** 5 per session from a weighted table (items looked up by registry id; a missing id skips the row):

| Lot | Base (Batu) |
|---|---|
| `kunpeng_bone_fragment` (random piece) | 40 |
| `heavenly_flame_seed` (random kind) | 60 |
| herb aged 1,000–1,500 | 25 |
| Dewa-band jade slip (`TechniqueLoot`) | 120 |
| 5 × `tomb_essence` | 30 |
| `tomb_sigil` | 35 |
| `ancient_god_blood` | 30 |
| `inheritance_crystal` | 40 |
| 1 `#primordial_material` | 50 |
| `land_expansion_token` | 80 |
| 2 `tribulation_warding_pill` | 20 |
| `soul_nurturing_wood` | 25 |
| 2 Supreme spirit stones | 30 |
| forging embryo of grade Abadi (`ArtifactItem.create`) | 90 |

- **Bidding:** 4 NPC rivals (game-design names, e.g. "Tetua Paviliun Awan Ungu"), each with a hidden limit 0.6–1.6 × base; every 4 s each rival under its limit may raise 5–15%. The player clicks +5%, +10%, +25% (the Action carries lot index and expected price; a stale click is refused). A bid is refused if the Batu in the player's inventory is below it. A lot sells after 8 s with no raise.
- **Payment:** Batu are taken from the inventory only on a win. **CRITIC:** if the winner no longer holds enough, the lot passes to the best rival and that player cannot bid for the rest of the session. The lot goes to the inventory; overflow to the Lumbung, else dropped with an owner lock. Advancement `auction_win`; EXTRA `AUCTION_WIN`.
- **Consign:** ≤ 2 items per session from `#kultivator:auction_sellable` (P9-langit tag); sold at 0.7–1.3 × a value table always ≤ 50% of the same item's lot base (no buy-sell loop); paid in Batu at session end (if offline: on next login, `extra.abadi.auction.owed`).

#### 26.8.3 Pengejaran (pursuit)

- **Tersinggung:** a rival whose limit was ≥ 90% of the final price of a lot the player won. Chance `auctionPursuitChance` (0.35) per offended rival, ≤ 1 pursuit per session.
- **When:** 60–180 s after the session ends, the next time the player is in Alam Abadi or the Overworld outside any hall territory, active, and not in a run, raid, tribulation, calamity or fight.
- **Band:** `RogueCultivators.spawnBand(level, center 12–18 blocks ahead, {4, 2, 2}, 8, ROLE_QUEST, null, onCleared)`; the leader gets its own boss bar; all get `abadi_foe` and a health modifier `kultivator:abadi_pursuit` ×`(1 + 0.35 R_eff) / 3.8`.
- **Telegraph:** the 19.3.15 danger alert 3 s before.
- **Win:** a `demonic_loot_pouch`, 5–15 Batu, advancement `pursuit_survived`. **Lose:** normal death rules (like a Phase 8 ambush).

| `uji murka [gelombang <1-3>\|panglima]` / `uji murka menang\|kalah` / `uji murka jadwal` | a descent now / force outcome / print schedule |
| `uji utusan <n> [k]` | n envoys ahead |
| `uji batin lahir [kecil\|sedang\|besar\|agung]` | create or reset the inner world |
| `uji batin hari <n>` | advance n days (≤ 30) |
| `uji batin bencana <meteor\|banjir\|petir> [n]` / `uji batin bencana data` | live calamity now / resolve as data now |
| `uji batin herba <slot> <umur>` / `uji batin rubah <n>` / `uji batin batu` / `uji batin mutiara <n>` | plot age / foxes / awaken rockmen / pearls |
| `uji ciptaan <slot> <daoA> <daoB> <bentuk> [kesempurnaan]` | create without ritual or cost |
| `uji lelang sesi` / `uji lelang tutup` / `uji lelang kejar` | start a session now / end it / spawn the pursuit now |
| `uji jalan bab <1-15>` | extended to 15 |

**Debug (op):** `debug abadi info` (conv, border distance, natives near, arrival), `debug purba info` (looked-at beast: phase, intake window, Celah), `debug batin` (raw `extra.batin`), `debug ciptaan <slot>` (resolved coefficients and caps).

| Field | Default (range) |
|---|---|
| `immortalRealm` | true |
| `immortalRealmRadius` | 2048 (512–4096) |
| `immortalNativesPerPlayer` | 4 (0–6) |

| `innerWorldCalamityDays` | 5 (0 off, 3–15) |

| `auctionPursuitChance` | 0.35 (0–1) |

| Budget | Limit |
|---|---|
| Added server time | ≤ 0.2 ms per tick average with 1 player outside fights |
| Alam Abadi | no force-loading; arrival search ≤ 8 heightmap samples per tick, once per world, no chunk loads; border and ground-record check per player every 10 ticks; void check every tick only below y 16 |
| Natives | ≤ 6 per player, ≤ 12 world; spawn pass every 400 ticks; skill pass every 10 ticks over a tracked UUID set (the elite pattern) |
| Primordial | ≤ 1 alive; ≤ 3 relics; one entity query per skill; client ≤ 800 points, halved beyond 48 blocks |
| Envoys | ≤ 8 alive |
| Inner world | zero ticking; lazy catch-up ≤ 10 days; ≤ 2 KB NBT |
| Batin live calamity | ≤ 16 meteors, ≤ 6 foes |
| Auction | memory only; one 4 s bid tick only while a session has open lots and ≥ 1 viewer |
| `DuniaSync` channels 4–6 | ≤ 8 KB each; only on screen open or a data change |

### 26.14 Spine (orchestrator, before the modules; compiles alone with stubs)

1. **`network/Actions`:** `ABADI = 42`, `PURBA = 43`, `BATIN = 44`, each `text = "op[:param]"`; `Net.handle` routes to `abadi.Abadi.handleAction`, `purba.Purba.handleAction`, `batin.Batin.handleAction`.
2. **`network/Payloads`:** `OpenScreen.ABADI = 8` (tab arg 0–5); `DuniaSync.CH_ABADI = 4`, `CH_PURBA = 5`, `CH_BATIN = 6`; `client/dunia/DuniaClient.VERSIONS` length 7, routing the channels to `client.abadi.AbadiClient.onSync`, `client.purba.PurbaClient.onSync`, `client.batin.BatinClient.onSync`.
3. **`fx/FxType`:** append `ABADI, PURBA, BATIN`; `FxDispatcher` calls `client/<pkg>/<X>Fx.play` / `.tick`. Sub-ids in `abadi/AbadiFxIds`, `purba/PurbaFxIds`, `batin/BatinFxIds`.
4. **`epic/EpicIds`:** EXTRA `ASCEND_OMEN 13`, `ASCEND_PASS 14`, `PRIMORDIAL_OMEN 15`, `PRIMORDIAL_PHASE 16`, `WRATH_OMEN 17`, `PLAYER_TRAMPLING 18`, `INNER_CALAMITY 19`, `OWN_ART_BORN 20`, `AUCTION_WIN 21` (the max-sub-id switch updated to 21); BOSS kinds `BOSS_PRIMORDIAL 8`, `BOSS_HEAVEN_GENERAL 9` (with `uji momen bos` names `binatang_purba`, `panglima_langit`); all through the generic EXTRA and BOSS client paths; all obey 23.1.
5. **`technique/spec/TechniquePower`:** `TAG_ABADI_FOE = "kultivator.abadi_foe"` accepted by `isTrialMob`; in the trial-mob branch ×`sqrt(starFactor(attacker stars))` when the target has the tag; `addPlayerStarFactor(ToDoubleFunction<CultivationData>)`, a product clamped 1.0–1.331 multiplied into `starFactor` for players only; `Stats` reads the same product for star health.
6. **`util/DeathGuard`:** `Stage = {DUEL, REALM, LANGIT, TRIBULATION, TOTEM, TECHNIQUE, PERK}`; never acts on `BYPASSES_INVULNERABILITY`. Both P9-langit and P9-purba register their own guards at `LANGIT`.
7. **`ascension/Stars`:** `interface StarGate { @Nullable Component blocks(ServerPlayer p, int nextStar); }` + `addGate(StarGate)`; `ImmortalPerks.condense` asks every gate before each star and stops with the first message.
8. **`ascension/Stars`:** `static double barSize(ServerPlayer)` = `max(rank.xpRequired(), ImmortalPerks.nextStarCost(data))`; `static void grantShare(ServerPlayer, double fraction)` adds XP with `XpSource.TRIAL`.
9. **`cultivation/Tribulation`:** `public static boolean strike(ServerPlayer, double shareOfMaxHealth)`: tribulation damage type, existing modifiers (Tribulation Warding, Hu Fa), rule-3 clamp; returns true when the strike would have killed (the caller fails the ritual). The private per-instance `strike` stays as it is.
10. **`disciple/Disciples.onChangeLevel`:** also returns early when origin or destination `Abadi.isImmortalLevel(level)`.
11. **`formasi/effect/FormationTargets`:** `TAG_ABADI_FOE` gets the elite ×0.6 `damageFactor`.
12. **Names:** `technique/spec/run/Codex.addNameProvider(BiFunction<ServerPlayer, String, @Nullable String>)`; client `client/codex/CodexNames` with `register(Function<String, @Nullable String>)` and `lookup(String)`, used by the Kitab list and the cast action bar.
13. **Refusal hooks (one line each, calling stubs):** `BuildPlacer` and Sect Hall placement refuse `Abadi.isImmortalLevel`; the Phase 8 realm gate refuses during `Purba.inFight`, `Purba.inCalamity`, `Purba.inWrath`, `Batin.inDefence`, `Abadi.inAscension`; breakthroughs and Cave Abode entry refuse during `Purba.inCalamity` and `Abadi.inAscension`.
14. **`KultivatorConfig`:** the fields of 26.12, clamped on load.
15. **`data/TechniqueRegistry`:** `module("CiptaanArts", 1100, 1199, CiptaanArts::register)` in fixed order before `freeze()`; stub `batin/CiptaanArts` registers the three specs and `special("own_art", OwnArt.STUB)`.
16. **`technique/arts/ShadowArts`:** `kunpeng_art` gains `.route(Route.item("kunpeng_whole"))`.
17. **`client/fx/spec/PointClouds`:** `beast(FxLayer.BeastKind)` public; `public static float[] sample(float[][] polylines)`.
18. **Entry points:** `Kultivator.onInitialize` calls `abadi.Abadi.init()`, `purba.Purba.init()`, `batin.Batin.init()` before `ModItems.init()`; `CultivateCommand` calls each module's `addCommands` plus the spine `/kultivasi abadi [tab]` opener; `TestCommands` calls each `addTestCommands(uji)` and `uji kit` adds the "Fase 9" shulker from each `kitItems()`; `KultivatorClient` calls the three client `init()`s and `registerRenderers()`; `Keys` gains `key.kultivator.abadi` (unbound); `goals` `uji jalan bab` accepts 1–15 (the glue fills chapters 11–15).
19. **Screen shell:** `client/keabadian/KeabadianScreen` (6 tablets, height 36, built like `DuniaScreen`) with page stubs `client/abadi/AlamAbadiPage`, `client/abadi/LelangPage`, `client/purba/PurbaPage`, `client/purba/BencanaPage`, `client/batin/BatinPage`, `client/batin/CiptaanPage`, all extending `DuniaPage`.
20. **Stubs** with the final signatures of 26.15.2; `lang-src/spine9.*`: config comments, tab names, key name, `kultivator.spine9.no_sleep`, BOSS/EXTRA beat names.

#### 26.15.2 Public contracts (spine stubs, filled by the owner)

```java
// spine
TechniquePower.TAG_ABADI_FOE ; TechniquePower.addPlayerStarFactor(ToDoubleFunction<CultivationData>)
DeathGuard.Stage.LANGIT
Stars.addGate(StarGate) ; double Stars.barSize(ServerPlayer) ; void Stars.grantShare(ServerPlayer, double)
boolean Tribulation.strike(ServerPlayer, double share)            // true = would have killed
float[] PointClouds.beast(FxLayer.BeastKind) ; float[] PointClouds.sample(float[][])
Codex.addNameProvider(BiFunction<ServerPlayer, String, @Nullable String>) ; CodexNames.register(Function<String, @Nullable String>)
// P9-langit
boolean Abadi.isImmortalLevel(@Nullable Level) ; boolean Abadi.ascended(ServerPlayer) ; double Abadi.conversion(ServerPlayer)
boolean Abadi.inAscension(ServerPlayer) ; boolean Abadi.startAscension(ServerPlayer, boolean free)
void Abadi.addAscendListener(Consumer<ServerPlayer>)              // D creates the inner world
boolean Abadi.inAuction(ServerPlayer)
// P9-purba
boolean Purba.inFight(ServerPlayer) ; boolean Purba.inCalamity(ServerPlayer) ; boolean Purba.inWrath(ServerPlayer)
int Purba.spawnEnvoyWave(ServerPlayer target, int count, int k, Consumer<Boolean> onCleared) // A's ascension waves
int Purba.kills(ServerPlayer, String kind) ; int Purba.distinctKinds(ServerPlayer)

// P9-batin
boolean Batin.has(ServerPlayer) ; boolean Batin.inDefence(ServerPlayer) ; int Batin.pearls(ServerPlayer)

```

**Cross-module wiring:** A calls `Purba.spawnEnvoyWave` in the ascension; D registers `Abadi.addAscendListener`; E reads `Purba.distinctKinds`; B, C, D, F refer to each other's items **by registry id** and `#kultivator:primordial_material`, never by class; batin and langit use P8's `RogueCultivators.spawn` / `spawnBand`; the busy checks (`inFight`, `inCalamity`, `inWrath`, `inDefence`, `inAscension`) are read through the contracts above; the glue reads advancements only.

**Order of work:** (1) spine; (2) the 3 modules in parallel, no Gradle; (3) one compile: `compileJava`, `compileClientJava`, `jar --no-daemon` (never tests, `runClient` or `build`); (4) fix pass; (5) docs: `docs/uji/FASE-9.md`, PANDUAN.

**May slip without breaking contracts:** langit: consignment, pursuit; purba: Taotie mouth-heal (becomes a plain Celah cycle), Zhulong Lilin relic, Segel Penangkal; batin: rockmen, Sempurnakan.

### 26.17 Daftar uji untuk `docs/uji/FASE-9.md`

**A. Alam Abadi**
1. `uji abadi naik` saat Dewa Abadi Puncak ★9: langit lima warna, 9 sambaran, dua gelombang utusan, pusaran 15 detik. Keluar dari lingkaran 8 blok berarti gagal. Sambaran yang akan membunuh menjadi gagal, bukan mati, dan Totem tidak terpakai.
2. Berhasil: tiba di pulau kedatangan di `kultivator:alam_abadi`. Ada pulau melayang, pohon sakura, bijih vanilla dan partikel qi. Tidak ada hujan, struktur, spawner, silverfish, lava, atau monster alami. Layar "Experimental settings" tidak muncul.
3. Prajurit Tulang Abadi tidak terbakar di siang hari dan helmnya tidak jatuh. Babi Taring Emas tidak berubah menjadi zoglin.
4. Jimat Lintas Alam: channel 5 detik, pulang ke titik asal, lalu kembali ke posisi terakhir. Pemain yang belum naik ditolak. Murid Inti+ (maks. 3) ikut; murid yang tertinggal tersapu pulang saat pemain keluar lewat portal Nether atau mati.
5. Lewat batas 2048 blok: didorong balik. Jatuh di bawah y −8: kembali ke tanah terakhir dengan −10% HP, tidak mati.
6. Menambang batu dengan tangan di Alam Abadi: kadang mendapat Batu Asal Abadi, paling banyak 16 per hari. Mode Kehancuran tidak memberi Batu dan tidak memahat pulau kedatangan (radius 48). `grep setBlock` di paket `abadi`, `purba` dan `batin` kosong.
7. `uji abadi konversi 0` lalu `100`: kerusakan ke penduduk asli naik dari ×0,6 ke ×1,0. Meditasi di Alam Abadi memberi XP ×3. Memadatkan bintang dengan 10 Batu di tas: biaya −10% dan Batu terpakai.
8. Penduduk asli muncul ≤ 4 di sekitar pemain dan ≤ 12 di dunia, tidak di atas void, dan HP-nya naik dengan bintang. Murid di bawah Kenaikan Abadi terkena Weakness I.

**B. Binatang Purba**
9. `uji purba kunpeng`: Kun muncul ke permukaan dengan gelombang bertelegraf, Peng menukik, angin puyuh menarik pemain tanpa merusak blok, memecah Mata Angin membuka celah. Ultimate tidak pernah membunuh dalam satu serangan (`debug purba info` menunjukkan batas per detik dan garis fase).
10. `uji purba zhulong`: Mata Tertutup memberi Darkness dan waktu dunia tidak berubah. Napas dingin membekukan, napas panas hanya membakar entitas.
11. `uji purba taotie`: Pelahap yang mencapai kepala menyembuhkannya. Serangan teknik saat mulut terbuka menyembuhkan setengahnya.
12. `uji purba enam` lalu membunuh Kun-Peng: `kunpeng_art` dipelajari dan pecahan habis. Jika sudah tahu `kunpeng_art`, pecahan tidak terpakai.
13. `primordialDeathGuard=true`: pukulan mematikan menyisakan 1 HP dengan Luka Purba, tanpa kehilangan barang. Setelah 3 hadiah ulang dalam sehari, hanya material 50% yang diberikan.

**C. Bencana dan Murka**
14. Pada ★5 dengan kualitas Normal, memadatkan ★6 berhenti dengan "Bencana ke-1 menanti". `uji bencana 1 lulus` lalu ★6 terpadatkan. Gagal: Luka Bencana dan 50% biaya kembali. Segel Penangkal (3 serpihan) membuat sambaran ×0,85.
15. Dunia lama dengan ★20: bencana 1–2 "Terlewati", bintang tidak berkurang, dan bisa diambil untuk faktor T.
16. `uji murka`: tiga gelombang utusan lalu Panglima. Murid dan formasi tidak bisa melukai Panglima. Kalah: 1 HP dan Luka Langit 10 menit.
17. Murka tidak terjadi saat AFK, Peaceful, serbuan, alam rahasia atau kesengsaraan. Setelah 2 kali terlewat tidak ada hukuman.

**D. Dunia Batin**
18. `uji batin lahir besar`: 9 petak. Tanam herba lalu `uji batin hari 4`: umurnya +100 tahun (+ Kesuburan rubah). Panen pada umur ≥ 1.000 memberi herba kedua umur 100.
19. Manusia Batu: setor 64 bijih sekali, lalu bijih berubah menjadi batu roh tiap hari. Ancient debris ditolak. Bijih yang disetor tidak bisa diambil lagi.
20. `uji batin bencana meteor`: meteor jatuh dengan telegraf dan bisa dihancurkan di udara; yang mendarat membakar petak, bukan blok.
21. `uji batin bencana petir`: Bayangan Petir menerima ×2 di dalam lingkaran Gunung Dang Hun. `uji batin bencana data`: peluang sesuai Perkokoh, dan kalah hanya memberi separuh kerugian.

**E. Jurus Ciptaan**
22. `uji ciptaan 1 api es ledakan 1.0`: "Jurus Ciptaan I" dengan nama sendiri di Kitab dan bar aksi. Kerusakan lewat batas bos dan aturan trial-mob. `uji teknik audit` tetap lulus (FX, SHAKE, sumber).
23. Nama dengan kode warna (`§`) atau lebih dari 24 karakter ditolak. Menghapus ciptaan mengosongkan slot loadout dan penguasaannya. Ritual yang terputus mengembalikan semua biaya.

**F. Lelang**
24. `uji lelang sesi`: 5 barang, saingan menawar tiap 4 detik, terjual setelah 8 detik tanpa tawaran. Batu diambil hanya saat menang. Klik dengan harga basi ditolak. Menang tanpa Batu cukup: barang pindah ke saingan dan pemain tidak bisa menawar sampai sesi berakhir.
25. Barang titipan terjual ≤ 50% harga dasar lot (tidak ada lingkaran beli-jual). `uji lelang kejar`: saingan tingkat 4 menghadang dengan peringatan 3 detik.

**G. Keamanan dan performa**
26. Tidak ada LightningBolt, perubahan cuaca, waktu atau tick-rate, dan tidak ada blok yang berubah dari fitur fase 9.
27. Pertarungan purba + 6 penduduk asli: server tetap mendekati 20 TPS di laptop. Tidak ada chunk yang dipaksa termuat; pencarian pulau kedatangan tidak membuat lag.
28. Setiap item, makhluk, fase, bencana, bentuk dan aturan lelang punya baris Sumber dalam `id_id` dan `en_us` dengan kunci yang sama. Kode server tidak merujuk kelas client.

## 27. Polish pass — every art reads on the subject

Players reported casts that were "only a camera movement", with stiff bodies and weak effects. This pass makes every one of the 146 specs, the 23 legacy techniques, the disciple powers, the Destroyer Arts, the signature ultimates and the self-created arts read on the subject first: a body that moves (a cast pose), a visible object or energy shape (3D props, quads, emissive qi particles), a build-up, an impact and an aftermath. The camera only supports what the subject already shows. The server (this section's M1 part) sends richer events; the clients draw them (27.7). Block safety, damage choke points, budgets, `EffectQuality` scaling and every Sumber line are unchanged.

### 27.1 Engine (server)

- **Every step sends its own phase** (`Steps.execute` / `runShape`). The cast's first step is the one that runs at timeline age 0, stage ≤ 1, with no CAST sent yet; it sends the cast's single CAST and then its own phase like every other step: its EXTRAn, else IMPACT (PULSE for a repeating step whose spec draws PULSE but not IMPACT). Stage recasts and steps a special runs from `cast()` are never "first", so their phases are always sent. A step anchored on a hit or kill (an onKill `restoreQi`) plays at that body, toward the caster's hand.
- **Geometry.** STRIKE, CONE and BEAM CASTs leave the hand (eye + look × min(range, 2), 0.3 lower) toward the end of the reach. TARGET sends CAST hand → target and a TRAVEL with the same points (duration max(4, distance / 2)); its own IMPACT lands on the target. PATH casts start where the body leaves. HIT events have pos = the victim's middle, to = the caster's hand, target = the victim. ALL and RECALL shapes that pick at most 8 foes send one TRAVEL (hand → foe) and one own event per foe. Multi-point evaluations (pillar rings, EACH_TARGET, CORNERS, EMITTERS, AFTERIMAGE) send one event per struck point with index / of; more than 8 points send one event with `of` = n and `aux` = ring radius × 100. Fan fronts (≤ 8 lines) send one TRAVEL per line. Rain IMPACTs land at the ground point with to = the sky point (14 up).
- **Build-up and falls.** Waves, fronts, beams and rains of an uncharged cast wind up: CAST at once, the release (TRAVEL and the first query) after `spec.windup()` ticks (default 4, PAMUNGKAS 6, `.windup(t)`), unless another step is timed inside the windup. Charged casts release at the end of the charge. A sky zone (`fromSky(h)`) now lands after clamp(h / 2, 6, 20) ticks unless it names its own delay. Every delayed ZONE / PILLAR sends a pre-impact TRAVEL (`FLAG_PRE_IMPACT`, from `h` up, duration = ticks to land) so a falling seal, palm, sun or cauldron lands exactly on the IMPACT; a repeating DENSEST / EACH_TARGET zone falls on its own point. Rain drops of a spec with TRAVEL layers are announced `fall` ticks before they land (one pre-impact TRAVEL per drop, index / of) and a spec with PULSE layers gets one PULSE per impact tick. Fronts gained `Mode.SKY_BAND` (`.skyBand(h)`): the damage line runs along the ground like LOOK, the visual (the Ruyi staff, the taiji diagram) comes down from a band `h` up. SKY fronts press down onto their `from()` anchor (a dense cluster) instead of the aim.
- **Real movement** (`Moves`). DASH (ticks > 1; at least distance / 4, 2-10 ticks) and leaps (a 9-tick parabola, `Moves.LEAP_TICKS`) move the body each tick instead of one teleport: players get the step as their velocity (`syncVelocity`, the server's motion packet), disciples and mobs `move(MoverType.SELF)`. The end spot is checked first exactly as before and the last tick snaps to it. A leap's landing step (`eachHop`) runs on landing; overlord_fury's slam moved to tick 10. Blinks stay instant but their TRAVEL carries `FLAG_BLINK` (pos = from, to = to). Hops that must face their target turn the caster with an absolute yaw. The cloud somersault and the earth travel ride with velocity between their checked points.
- **Stop signal.** `Phase.ABORT` (appended) goes out once for every cast that ends other than DONE (cancelled, replaced, interrupted, death, logout, dimension), when a toggle is cast off, when an area is replaced or cancelled and when a form ends early. Clients end that caster's runs, pose and cinematic.
- **Climax.** `TechniqueSpec.climaxPhase()`: `.climax(phase)`, else the highest EXTRA phase with layers, else IMPACT, else TRAVEL, else CAST. The first event of that phase per cast carries `FLAG_CLIMAX` (never on echo copies).
- **Caps and sounds.** CAST, CHARGE, END and ABORT are never capped; other events 40 per second per cast; HIT 12 per second, the rest folded into one MASS_HIT per tick. A phase's sounds play whatever its layers and the caps say. No NaN or infinite float reaches the wire (positions are checked, radius and length cleaned, `lastAreaRadius` sent as 0 until set).
- **Durations.** A CAST without a duration carries `spec.castTicks()` (`.castTicks(t)`), else the channel's ticks, else the longest SELF boon of the first steps (guard, counter window, form, buff, cheat death), so lasting stances and props last as long as the effect.
- **Hand swing.** At CAST (a charged cast's CAST is its release) and on any phase whose authored pose swings, the caster swings its main hand with the pose's `SwingAnimation` (STAB or WHACK, `LivingEntity.swing(hand, animation, true)`).
- **New event sources.** PHANTOM per phantom attack (pos = phantom, to = victim, target, aux = `PhantomKind`) and, for slow phantoms (interval ≥ 30), a PHANTOM with `FLAG_PRE_IMPACT` 10 ticks before the strike. LAND when a simulated projectile hits the ground. One TRAVEL per projectile for volleys up to 16 (`FLAG_VOLLEY`, aux = spread mode, index / of, sent when each one launches); bigger volleys send one event. EXTRA6 for every blow a COUNTER stores (aux = blows stored), EXTRA7 for every projectile a guard catches. A two-Dao art (`CastContext.twoDao(rgb)`: Profound Mystery Fusion, self-created arts) marks every event with `FLAG_TWO_DAO` (aux = second Dao RGB); a stage recast's events carry `FLAG_STAGE` (aux = stage − 1); caster-following domains and auras carry `FLAG_FOLLOW` on CAST and PULSE.
- **Checks** (`SpecLint`, logged in the dev environment at registry init and listed by `uji teknik audit`): a phase with layers that no step can send, VERTICAL / SPLIT / FANNED on templates that ignore them, `size(≥ 3)` on ring, shell, dome, mist, vortex and rune templates, a MODEL layer without a model, a model id without `assets/kultivator/items/fx/<id>.json`, and an ultimate or domain without a climax.

### 27.2 Cast poses

`dsl/Pose` (27 poses plus AUTO / NONE, shared) names what the body does. Specs author `.pose(pose)` for CAST and `.pose(phase, pose)` for any other phase (a slam on EXTRA0, a punch per blow); `spec.resolvedPose(phase)` gives the authored pose or, for CAST and CHARGE, the automatic one from type, first shape and Dao. Every catalogue spec, the legacy techniques and the self-created arts have their poses; the client keyframes, accents and first-person hands are DESIGN 27.7.

### 27.3 DSL

- `FxLayer` gained `model` (a 3D prop `kultivator:fx/<id>`, `.model(id)`, the MODEL template or a GIANT_ITEM / BEAST / SWARM / RIBBON with a model), `facing` (FACE_VIEWER, FACE_FORWARD, BLADE, UPRIGHT, FLAT), `fallback`, `swingPeriod` (`.swingEvery(t)`), `perTarget` (`.eachTarget()`), `atHand` (`.fromHand()`) and `followUntil` (`.until(phase)`); templates MODEL and RIBBON; withers `.vertical()` and `.split()`.
- `Dsl.model(id)`, `Dsl.modelGlow(id, tint)`, `Dsl.ribbon(color)`.
- The spec builder gained `.pose`, `.poses`, `.climax`, `.windup`, `.castTicks` and `.bindLook(BindKind)` (what the spec's binds, or its marks when it has no bind, look like on the clients).
- Arts authoring: identity displays no longer hide below visual tier 3 (`minTier` 3 → 1, glyph tier gone; the client scales instead of hiding), `size(≥ 8)` on ring and area templates became `radius`, smaller sizes became 1.5, sky silhouettes use `scale`, and about a hundred props became MODEL layers (giant swords, Buddha palm, emperor and fantian seals, suns, cauldron, lotus, phoenixes, dragons as ribbons, white tiger, staff, taiji disc, void mirror, mountain peaks, the pagoda storeys, the bodhi tree...). Beam visuals moved from CAST to TRAVEL so they appear with the release, not during the wind-up.

### 27.4 Sync payloads

- `TechFx` v2: `flags` is a short (new FLAG_CLIMAX 128, PRE_IMPACT 256, FOLLOW 512, DOT 1024, STAGE 2048, BLINK 4096, TWO_DAO 8192, VOLLEY 16384); new fields `target` (-1 none), `index`, `of` and `aux`. New phases ABORT, PHANTOM, LAND.
- `PhantomSync(caster, spec, entries)`: the virtual phantoms of a cast (slot, `PhantomKind`, position, yaw, cling, mode, ticks left) on spawn, every 10 ticks and once empty at the end, to the players within 96.
- `FormSync(entity, form, ticks, stage)`: a TRANSFORM form on start, stage change (heaven fire 1-3, the ancient god's stomps), every 2 s and end ("" = none). Client ids: the 72 transformations as `seventy_two:tiger|eagle|fish|insect|temple`, fa_tian_xiang_di and the legacy Dharma Form as `dharma`, Lei Zhenzi as `lei_zhenzi`, the rest as their own id.
- `BindSync(entity, kind, ticks, caster, spec)`: a visual bind (`BindKind`: ROOT_VINE, ROPE, CHAINS, SEAL, FREEZE, TIME_STOP, SUSPEND, SLEEP, KARMA_LINK) on start, extension and end; freezes of 30 ticks or more send FREEZE, LINK groups send KARMA_LINK, a spec's `bindLook` overrides the default per gameplay bind.

### 27.5 Self-created arts

Each form of an own art has its own phase and pose (EXTRA2 cut, EXTRA3 burst, EXTRA4 rain, EXTRA5 wave, EXTRA6 domain, EXTRA7 seal); EXTRA1 (the Daos' pulses) is the climax with the one big shake; a two-Dao art carries both colours on every event.

### 27.6 Disciples

Disciples stand still and face their foe while they charge or channel (`TechniqueRunner.holding`), hold the fire lotus or sit in a flame ritual (drawn as meditating). The sword formation sends a dive per struck foe (`FX_ULT_SWORD_DIVE`), the evil-dispelling bolts one packet per victim and per chain (`FX_ULT_BOLT`, b = entity id, f 0 / 1), the Undying fist swings the arm before it lands, the fire lotus flies (`FX_LOTUS_RELEASE`, the blast lands when it arrives), the Kunpeng dash sends its trail (`FX_KUNPENG_DASH`) and spreads the wings (`DiscipleEntity.FLAG_KUNPENG`), the Seven Fairies link once with one packet per fairy (`FX_FAIRIES`, `FLAG_FAIRIES`, a chime and a line to the master). Divine Clones start fading 10 ticks before they go (`PathFxIds.CLONE` b = 1). Heir hexes cast through the spec runner. Destroyer Arts deal damage through `TechniquePower.finalDamage` and, like the signature ultimates, send a light 7b beat (`EpicIds.EXTRA_DESTROYER_ART`, `EXTRA_DISCIPLE_ULT`).

### 27.7 Client (modules M2, M3)

The client side of this pass (the emissive `kultivator:qi` particles, quad bolts and ribbons, phantom and bind visuals, the 3D prop models, cast poses and first-person hands, the giant avatar renderer and the 7b director changes) follows the polish plan and is documented with its code.

## 28. Phase 10 — Dampak Langit (impact sinematik)

Numbered 28 because 27 is the polish pass. The user asked (2026-10-20, Indonesian) to study how a popular sky-strike
weapon mod presents its strikes and to give the Kultivator ultimates "animations, effects and impacts as cool as that".
Only the **presentation ideas** of that mod's public description are used (its code and assets are All Rights Reserved:
nothing is copied, no texture, model, sound or line of code). Every idea is re-told in our cultivation language and
built on our own engines: the 6c technique runner (22), the client FX of the polish pass (27), 7b cinematics (23) and
Mode Kehancuran (22.11, `kehancuran/WorldBreaker`).

| Their idea | Ours (name in game) | Section |
|---|---|---|
| target mark from the sky on the crosshair | **Tanda Langit**: a pillar of heaven's light and a turning glyph ring on the aim, a seal bracket on the crosshair | 28.2 |
| long camera trip up the beam into space and back down | **Perjalanan Langit**: a ≤ 4 s three-part shot up the pillar, through the cloud sea, to a heavenly vista, then riding the strike down | 28.3 |
| silence, then the boom; full-screen impact frames | **Dampak Sunyi** and **Bingkai Dampak** (Penuh / Lembut / Mati, photosensitivity warning) | 28.4 |
| shock ring flattening the land into a molten crater | **Gelombang Kejut** and **Kawah Lebur** (real blocks only under Mode Kehancuran) | 28.5, 28.8 |
| the weapon stays planted in the crater | **Monumen**: a lingering client-only prop (60-180 s) | 28.10 |
| a constellation projected on the land, star impacts, burning lines | **Sigil Bumi**: formation diagrams on the terrain (the Northern Dipper's nine stars, Luoshu, Wuxing, bagua, sword rings) | 28.9 |
| a light grid cuts the land into cells lifted into the sky | **Gunung Terangkat**: cells rising and turning, the real carving still by WorldBreaker | 28.7 |
| heavy post shaders, power sliders | faked with layered additive quads, glow textures, sky grades and HUD overlays; a **Daya dampak** setting | 28.1.3, 28.11 |

### 28.1 Principles (binding; they extend 0, 22.11, 23.1)

#### 28.1.1 Blocks and gameplay

1. **Blocks change only through `kehancuran/WorldBreaker`**, and only for jobs that already exist: the player's own
   casts with the opt-in Mode Kehancuran switch (`Kehancuran.submitSelf`, via `technique/spec/run/Destruction`) and
   the disciple Destroyer Arts / Pemusnah orders. Phase 10 adds two things to those jobs and nothing else: a capped
   **surface pass** (Kawah Lebur, 28.8) inside the same job and undo entry, and **sigil trenches** (28.9.3) inside the
   same cast's block cap. Without Kehancuran every Phase 10 effect is visual only (client displays, particles, quads).
2. Never `LightningBolt`, `Explosion`, fire, fluids, falling-block entities, weather, time or tick-rate changes. No
   entity is added on the server. Client displays use their own negative id range (28.6.4).
3. **No gameplay number changes**: damage, ranges, radii, timelines, cooldowns, costs, caps
   (`kehancuranMaxBlocksPerCast`, `TechniquePower.blockCap`, `kehancuranBlocksPerTick`), the 22.15 runner caps and
   every spec's Sumber line stay exactly as they are. The only server-visible change of a cast is that the climax
   event's sounds of a spec marked silent are played by the clients instead of the server (28.4.3).
4. Server code never references a client class; the shared description of a spec's impact (`technique/spec/dsl/Dampak`)
   and the sigil geometry (`technique/spec/dsl/SigilPattern`) are plain common code used by both sides.

#### 28.1.2 Camera and comfort (amends 23.1.2, 23.1.6 and 23.1.7)

- Perjalanan Langit is a 7b shot like any other: **own client only**, Kamera **Penuh** only for the full ride,
  **Singkat** gets a short crane-up, **Mati** none; never in danger (28.3.4); every key ends it; Backspace skips; a
  hurt snaps back at once. "Kurangi gerak" forces Mati for the ride and Lembut for the frames.
- **Amendment of 23.1.6 "No invert frame"**: an inverted impact frame is allowed **only** under the new setting
  "Bingkai dampak: Penuh", which the player must confirm on a photosensitivity warning screen the first time. The
  default "Lembut" keeps 23.1.6 exactly (one tint ≤ 0.35, no inversion). Every impact frame is one luminance event of
  the 500 ms rule (`EpicScreen.LUMINANCE_GAP`), obeys vanilla "Hide Lightning Flashes" (then Mati), "Kilatan layar"
  (off = Mati) and `screenEffectScale`.
- **Amendment of 23.1.7**: the climax sounds of a silent spec are client presentation sounds (the same cues, at the
  same position; every client in range derives them from the same TechFx). The ≤ 4 cues per phase rule
  (`TechniquePower.SOUNDS_PER_PHASE`) still holds; HOSTILE and PLAYERS are never ducked.

#### 28.1.3 Performance (the laptop also runs Valorant)

- The "heavy shader" look is **faked**: nested additive quads at falling alpha (a cheap bloom), emissive glow strips
  (`glow_strip.png`), soft rings (`ring_soft.png`), sky grades (`SkyDirector`), the vanilla sky flash
  (`ClientLevel.setSkyFlashTime`), full-bright displays (`Display.setBrightnessOverride(new Brightness(15, 15))`) and
  HUD layers. **No post chain, no core shader, no custom `RenderPipeline`** (23.1.5 stays; the one invert frame uses
  the vanilla `RenderPipelines.GUI_INVERT`).
- Geometry takes from the shared 7b budget (`EpicBudget.takeQuads / takeLarge / takePillar`, × 0.6 under a shader
  pack) and is cut by the 7b frame guard (`EpicBudget.tier()`); displays have their own pool (28.6.4); particles go
  through `FxBudget` and `EffectQuality.scale`. Idle cost: one boolean per system.
- Server: at most one debris packet per running WorldBreaker job per tick (≤ 64 entries, about 400 bytes), only to
  players within 96 b; no extra block reads for debris (the breaker reads the state anyway); the surface pass is
  capped and spends the same `kehancuranBlocksPerTick` budget.

#### 28.1.4 Compatibility

- Sodium: nothing touches chunk meshes; debris are entity displays, sigils and rings are world quads drawn from Fabric
  `LevelRenderEvents.COLLECT_SUBMITS` (registered after `EpicRenderer`, so `EpicBudget.beginFrame` already ran).
- Iris: no geometry in the shadow pass (the event does not fire there; `isRenderingShadowPass` is still checked);
  ground quads sit 0.04 b above the surface (no polygon offset); the pack profile of 23.14.3 applies (× 0.6 quads, one
  large layer, HUD sky channel).
- Only vanilla render types through `EpicRenderTypes`: `entityTranslucentEmissive` for soft layers, `lightning()` for
  thin glow, the beacon beam for pillars.

#### 28.1.5 Verified Minecraft API (26.3, `butterbot-fabric/reference/mcsrc`)

`Display.setBrightnessOverride / setViewRange / setWidth / setHeight / setGlowColorOverride /
setTransformationInterpolationDuration / setTransformationInterpolationDelay` (always through `DisplayKey`),
`Display.BlockDisplay.setBlockState`, `Display.ItemDisplay.setItemStack`, `ClientLevel.addEntity`,
`Block.getId(BlockState)` / `Block.stateById(int)`, `SoundManager.playDelayed(SoundInstance, int)`,
`new SimpleSoundInstance(SoundEvent, SoundSource, float, float, RandomSource, double, double, double)`,
`ClientLevel.playLocalSound(x, y, z, sound, source, volume, pitch, distanceDelay)` (vanilla delays by distance / 40 b/s;
we schedule ourselves, 28.4.3), `ClientLevel.setSkyFlashTime`, `RenderPipelines.GUI_INVERT` with
`GuiGraphicsExtractor.fill(RenderPipeline, x0, y0, x1, y1, col)`, `Level.getHeight(Heightmap.Types, x, z)` with
`WORLD_SURFACE` / `MOTION_BLOCKING_NO_LEAVES` (both `Usage.CLIENT`), `ParticleTypes.BLOCK`, `BLOCK_CRUMBLE`,
`DUST_PILLAR`, `FALLING_DUST`, and `Blocks.MAGMA_BLOCK, BLACKSTONE, POLISHED_BLACKSTONE, BASALT, SMOOTH_BASALT, TUFF,
COBBLED_DEEPSLATE, PACKED_ICE, SNOW_BLOCK, CALCITE, SMOOTH_STONE, POLISHED_DIORITE, GLASS, MOSS_BLOCK, ROOTED_DIRT,
SOUL_SOIL, COARSE_DIRT, AMETHYST_CLUSTER, END_ROD, SEA_LANTERN` (all plain `Block` constants; `LIGHTNING_ROD` is a
`WeatheringCopperCollection` and is not used).

### 28.2 Tanda Langit (TargetMark)

**What.** Before an ultimate lands, heaven marks the spot: a thin pillar of light in the Dao colour comes down from
the clouds onto the aim, a glyph ring turns on the ground and slowly tightens (a "lock-on"), qi motes rise, and for the
caster a small seal bracket closes around the crosshair. Bystanders see the pillar and ring too (a fair warning in PvP).

**When (no new packet).** From the TechFx stream, for specs whose `Dampak.mark() != NONE`:
- the **CAST** of an uncharged cast, or the **CHARGE** of a charged one (the mark lives through the charge and snaps at
  the release CAST);
- every TRAVEL with `FLAG_PRE_IMPACT` of a `MULTI` mark (one sub-mark per falling sun, palm, sword or dive at `to`,
  living `duration` ticks; the Nine Suns get nine);
- every PHANTOM with `FLAG_PRE_IMPACT` (cosmic avatar stomps) and every step EXTRA0 of a dash for `FOOT` marks.

The mark ends on the climax event (it becomes the impact), on ABORT, after `Dampak.markTicks` (default: until the
climax, at most 200 ticks) or 20 ticks after a lasting field starts (the ring then hands over to the Sigil Bumi).

**Server contract (M1).** Every CAST and CHARGE of a spec with a Dampak carries the resolved aim in `tx,ty,tz` (the
field or zone centre, the densest point of a sky zone, the beam's or front's far end, the caster's feet for
caster-centred domains). Most shapes already do (27.1 geometry); M1 checks the rest in `Caster` / `Steps` and SpecLint
reports a Dampak spec whose CAST would send `to == pos` for a non-caster-centred shape.

**Own charge follows the crosshair.** While the local player charges, the mark follows a client clip along the look
(one `ClientLevel.clip` per tick, ≤ the spec's range, blocks only); at the release CAST it eases to the server's point
in 4 ticks. Purely visual: the server's aim is the truth.

**Kinds** (`Dampak.Mark`): `PILLAR` (pillar + ring), `MULTI` (one small pillar + ring per pre-impact), `SHADOW` (a dark
soft disc the size of the falling object grows under it: palms, feet, mountains), `PATH` (a glowing line along a beam
or front, with the ring at its end), `FOOT` (a golden footprint glyph 10 ticks before each stomp), `RING_ONLY` (no
pillar: domains around the caster), `NONE`.

**Look and budgets.**

| | Minimal | Normal | Maximal |
|---|---|---|---|
| pillar | none (particle column, 1 per 2 ticks) | `PillarRenderer` descending, glow 0.6 b, narrows to 0.15 b over the last 4 ticks (`takePillar`) | + a second fainter halo pillar (glow 1.4 b, α 0.3) |
| ring | `RingRenderer` rune circle r 3 b | r 4-6 b, contracts 2× → 1×, + the art's glyph (`EpicDisplays.glyph`) | + an outer dotted ring |
| motes | 4 / s | 12 / s `kultivator:qi` | 24 / s |
| sub-marks (MULTI) | 3 | 9 | 9 + their pillars |
| crosshair seal (own) | yes (HUD, 2 quads) | yes | yes |

Others' marks follow "Efek pemain lain" (Ringan: ring only, Mati: none). Under `FLAG_LOW_LOAD`: ring only.

### 28.3 Perjalanan Langit (SkyRide shot)

#### 28.3.1 The idea within our speed caps

The weapon mod flies the camera kilometres up a beam. 7b caps camera speed (23.7.3: ≤ 7.6 b/s average, ≤ 25°/s,
crane ≤ 24 b), so the trip is **told, not travelled**: three short segments joined by **masked cuts** (a cloud wipe
covering the screen), the height sold by parallax (cloud streaks passing the lens), an FOV punch and a sky grade that
turns star-dark, and "space" shown by a **vista** sky-projected above (23.10.3), not by moving far.

#### 28.3.2 Segments (Penuh, total `Dampak.rideTicks` ≤ 80, timed to END on the climax event)

| Part | Share | Camera (each segment validated by `Shot.validate`) | On screen |
|---|---|---|---|
| R1 **Naik** (rise) | 0-0.375 | from over the shoulder up beside the mark pillar: side 4 b, h 2 → 14, pitch −15° → −55°, yaw sweep ≤ 20° | the pillar, motes streaming up; at 0.30 the **cloud wipe** starts (HUD cloud texture α 0 → 0.9 over 4 ticks, scrolling down: we rise) |
| cut 1 | | instant, allowed only while the wipe covers ≥ 0.8 | |
| R2 **Puncak** (vista) | 0.375-0.625 | world-anchored above the aim: h 22-24, 6 b aside, pitch −55° → −40°, slow 15° yaw | sky grade star-dark (`SkyDirector`, STAR_BRIGHTNESS up), the **vista** (28.3.3) and the technique's object charging in it (the sword drawn, the sun core kindling); the wipe clears over 6 ticks |
| cut 2 | | instant under a second wipe (≥ 1 s after the first: one luminance event each) | |
| R3 **Turun** (ride down) | 0.625-1 | behind and above the falling object: start aim + (back 6, up 20), pitch 60° → 70° (looking down), descend ≤ 11 b | the object falls past the lens, speed lines (`ScreenFlash.speedLines`), FOV punch −8 % (`CinematicDirector.snap`) |
| exit | | on the climax: instant cut to the eye **under the impact frame** (Penuh frames), else the normal 10-tick blend | 28.4 |

If the climax event is late (server lag) R3 holds its last pose up to 20 ticks, then exits by blend. If the aim is
more than 40 b from the caster's feet, R3 is dropped (the ride ends after R2 with a blend). `Shots.Type.SKY_RIDE` has
`max = 80` and `ceremony = true` (48 b reach), and counts in the Penuh scene cap (400 ticks) and the KIND_ULTIMATE gap
(1200 ticks). A new `Shot.cut()` marks a segment start that may skip the blend; `CinematicDirector` honours it only
when `CloudWipe.cover() ≥ 0.8` or an impact frame shows, otherwise it blends as before.

A FULL ride of a lasting ultimate (field, domain) starts `climaxAt − rideTicks` ticks after the CAST (a client timer
of the TECH_ULTIMATE scene, cancelled by ABORT or END); a charged one may start at the CHARGE.

#### 28.3.3 Vistas (`Dampak.Vista`, own client only, sky-projected, life = R2 + 10 ticks)

| Vista | Built from | Lore |
|---|---|---|
| `GERBANG_LANGIT` | `GateRenderer` 64 × 96 (doors opening), gold rays (`RaysRenderer`) | the Southern Heavenly Gate (Nantianmen), Journey to the West |
| `PUSARAN` | `VortexRenderer` tribulation whirlpool, micro-arcs | the tribulation clouds of 7b |
| `SEMBILAN_LANGIT` | three (Maximal: five) thin stacked vortex rims at rising heights, deity silhouettes | the Nine Heavens |
| `SUNGAI_BINTANG` | a wide `TrailRenderer` seam across the sky in star-white, starfield motes | the Heavenly River (Tianhe), Journey to the West |
| `MATAHARI_KAISAR` | a violet-white sun core (`emperor_lotus_core` sky prop) with corona quads | design |
| `GUNUNG_ES` | `AuroraRenderer` pale ribbons and an `ice_mountain` prop high in the sky | design |
| `CAKRAM_AKRESI` | an orange-violet `VortexRenderer` laid flat as an accretion disc around a black core | Stellar Transformations (the art's own source) |
| `POHON_CAHAYA` | golden god rays and drifting petals around the bodhi canopy | Battle Through the Heavens (the art's own source) |
| `LAUT_UTARA` | a dark sea plane far below the clouds with the Kun silhouette turning | Zhuangzi, "Free and Easy Wandering" (the Kun of the Northern Darkness) [lore verify] |
| `BY_DAO` | the vista of the first stored Dao (own arts) | — |

Each vista is one or two large layers (rank 2-5); Minimal shows only the sky grade and particles.

#### 28.3.4 Gates (all must hold at the ride's start; a failure falls back to Singkat's crane, then to nothing)

Kamera sinematik Penuh; setting "Perjalanan langit" allows it (`Pertama` = the first cast of each spec per session,
default; `Selalu`; `Mati`); the scene is the local player's own (never a disciple's or another player's); the local
`FLAG_SAFE` (calm, not targeted, 23.5) **and** no `Enemy` within 24 b **and** health ≥ 50 % **and** the 23.7.4 gates
(`ShotGuard.blocked`); not `FLAG_LOW_LOAD`; the KIND_ULTIMATE gap passed. During the ride every 23.7.4 abort applies
(a foreign hurt snaps back at once). The ride never delays or changes anything on the server: the strike lands when
the server says, whether the camera is still flying or not.

**Singkat** (and `Dampak.Ride.SHORT` at Penuh): `Shots.craneUp` 2 s that looks up at the falling object and ends on the
climax (or a reveal crane after it when the climax time is player-timed). **Mati**: none; the player still sees the
mark, the frames and the impact.

### 28.4 Dampak Sunyi (SilentImpact): impact frames, delayed boom, hit-stop

#### 28.4.1 Bingkai Dampak (impact frames, HUD only)

On the event with `FLAG_CLIMAX` of a Dampak spec (own casts always; others only when the impact is ≤ 32 b away and in
front of the camera, view dot > 0.3):

| Setting | Tick 0 | Tick 1 | Tick 2 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Penuh** (opt-in, warning) | `GUI_INVERT` full-screen fill, then the `frame1` tint α 0.45 (a black frame when `frame1` = `BLACK`) | `frame2` α 0.8 with radial impact streaks (`dampak_streaks.png`, turned by the seed) | `frame3` α 0.5 → 0 |
| **Lembut** (default) | `frame1` tint α ≤ 0.35 (`EpicScreen.MAX_FLASH`) | fading | — |
| **Mati** | nothing (the spec's own `flash()` layer still plays as before) | | |

Rules: one luminance event (the spec's own climax `flash()` layer is suppressed for 2 ticks: `ScreenFlash.suppress`);
"Hide Lightning Flashes" or "Kilatan layar" off → Mati; `screenEffectScale` multiplies alpha; "Kurangi gerak" →
Lembut without streaks; F1 hides it; Mode Rekam keeps it. Bystanders' frames are always Lembut at half alpha.

The first switch to Penuh opens `PhotosensitivityScreen`: "Peringatan fotosensitif: Bingkai dampak Penuh memakai
kilatan layar penuh dan pembalikan warna. Jangan aktifkan jika kamu peka terhadap cahaya berkedip." with
**Aktifkan** / **Batal** (remembered as `epic_impact_frames_ok`).

#### 28.4.2 Hit-stop (presentation time only)

At the climax: Dewa `EpicClock.hitStop(3)`, Abadi `hitStop(2)` (a new overload; σ = 0, then the 20-tick ramp), only
with "Gerak lambat" on and never with "Kurangi gerak". Phase 10 makes more presentation clocks read σ: cast poses
(`PoseApplier` keyframe time), prop animations (`ModelFx` step age), the `FireUltimates` clock, `DisplayRun` layer
ages, and the debris, lift cells, sigils and rings of 28.5-28.10. Vanilla entities, vanilla particles,
`DeltaTracker`, the tick-rate managers, the server and damage are never touched (23.1.1 rule 3).

#### 28.4.3 The delayed boom

- **Server (M1).** For a spec with `Dampak.silence() > 0`, `Caster.sound(phase, at)` does not play the cues of the
  event it marks `FLAG_CLIMAX` (same tick, same phase); every other event plays as before.
- **Client (M2).** `SilentImpact.onClimax(payload, spec)` runs on **every** client that receives the event, before any
  VFX gate ("Efek pemain lain: Mati" still hears it): for each cue of `spec.sounds(climaxPhase)` (≤ 4) it plays
  `new SimpleSoundInstance(cue.sound(), SoundSource.PLAYERS, volume, pitch, RandomSource.create(seed + i), x, y, z)`
  through `SoundManager.playDelayed(instance, delay)` with
  `delay = cue.delay() + silence + min(16, round(distance(camera, impact) / 2))` (40 b/s, the vanilla thunder speed).
  Setting "Dampak sunyi" off: `delay = cue.delay()`.
- During the silence the local player's ambient, weather, music and block categories duck to 0.35
  (`EpicSound.duck`; never HOSTILE or PLAYERS), and a sub-bass thump (`EpicSound.subBass`) lands with the boom.
- Silence values: Dewa 6 ticks, Abadi 3, the time art 10 ("time resumes"), life arts 4, 0 = classic.

### 28.5 Gelombang Kejut (ShockRing)

An expanding ground ripple following the terrain: a soft annulus (`ring_soft.png`, `entityTranslucentEmissive`)
sampled at 32 / 48 / 64 segments, each vertex at `Level.getHeight(MOTION_BLOCKING_NO_LEAVES) + 0.04`, growing 0 → R
over 12 ticks (easeOutCubic) and fading; a **dust wall** at the front (`ParticleTypes.BLOCK` of the ground block under
the front, `DUST_PILLAR` at Normal+, 8 / 24 / 48 per tick through `FxBudget`); a **second ring** 8 ticks later to
1.4 R, fainter. A ring wider than 16 b takes a large layer (rank 6). Variants (`Dampak.Ring`): `DUST` (default),
`EMBER` (flame and lava-drip front: fire), `FROST` (frost front and ice spikes: up to 8 / 16 / 32 `PACKED_ICE`
BlockDisplays rising 1-3 b along the front, staying 10 s, then shattering into `BLOCK` particles), `VOID` (contracts
to 0.3 R first, then bursts out: black hole, mirror), `GOLD` (glow motes: life and body arts). Minimal: a particle
ring.

### 28.6 Puing (Debris)

#### 28.6.1 Real debris (Mode Kehancuran on)

While a WorldBreaker job (self or disciple, not a restore) changes blocks, the server sends per tick at most one
`Payloads.DampakDebris` (28.13.2) with up to 64 of the positions it changed that tick (a uniform sample when more) and
the **old** block state ids, to the players within 96 b of the batch centroid in the job's dimension. The client:

- skips states without a solid model (air, plants, fluids, `RenderShape.INVISIBLE`): `BLOCK` particles instead;
- spawns a client-only `Display.BlockDisplay` of the state at the position, size 0.35-0.9 (Maximal: one in eight is a
  full 1.0 block), launched up 0.35-0.9 b/t and outward 0.15-0.6 b/t from the job centre (scaled by "Daya dampak"),
  spinning 6-20°/t about a seeded axis, gravity 0.06 b/t², drag 0.98; it bounces once on the client heightmap
  (`vy × −0.3`, spin halves), rests, then leaves by one shrink over 8 ticks with `BLOCK_CRUMBLE` particles (life 40-70
  ticks, Minimal 30);
- modes from the spec's `Dampak.debris()`: `BURST` (default), `WAKE` (along a line: spawn delay = distance along the
  line / 4 ticks, so the ground erupts behind a dash or a beam), `LIFT` (28.7), `IMPLODE` (pulled toward the centre
  and up, shrinking: black hole), `SUSPEND` (rise 1-3 b and hang still until the spec's climax, then drop: the time
  art), `CONVERT` (wither: ash and leaf particles, no displays);
- `CONVERT` batches (wither, strip) spawn no displays; `SURFACE` batches light the new surface (28.8.3); restore jobs
  send nothing (the existing shimmer stays); `DONE` (job finished, `total` = changed) fires the closing ShockRing
  (28.5) with `R = clamp(2 + sqrt(total) / 2, 4, 40)` and a last dust wall.

#### 28.6.2 Visual debris (Mode Kehancuran off)

On the climax of a Dampak spec whose event lacks `FLAG_KEHANCURAN`: chunks of the **client's** surface block under the
impact (`ClientLevel.getBlockState` at the heightmap), 6 / 24 / 48 by quality, the same motion as above, and a cracked
glowing decal under them (28.8.3). Nothing is read from or sent to the server; real blocks are never touched.

#### 28.6.3 Budgets

| | Minimal | Normal | Maximal |
|---|---|---|---|
| Dampak displays alive (debris + lift cells + crystals + ice spikes) | 16 | 96 | 256 |
| created per tick | 4 | 16 | 32 |
| re-key (`DisplayKey.key`) | every 2 ticks, duration 2 | every 2 ticks, duration 2 | every tick, duration 1 |
| fake debris per climax | 6 | 24 | 48 |
| particles per batch | 8 | 24 | 48 (all via `FxBudget`) |

Others' casts × `EffectQuality.othersScale()`; "Efek pemain lain: Ringan" → no displays (particles only);
`FLAG_LOW_LOAD` → no displays; the 7b frame guard lowers the tier (tier −1 → particles only); no spawn farther than
64 b from the camera, half beyond 32 b. Setting "Puing & monumen" off → particles only.

#### 28.6.4 Display pool

`client/dampak/world/DampakDisplays`: displays made with `EntityType.create(clientLevel, LOAD)`, ids counting down from
**−6,000,000** (PhantomDisplays −2 M, EpicDisplays −3 M, RealmScenery −5 M), added with `ClientLevel.addEntity`, never
sent anywhere, `setViewRange` and width/height set so culling mods keep them, removed on their end, on a dimension
change, on disconnect and on `uji dampak berhenti` (ABORT of their cast ends lift cells and suspended chunks, not
debris already flying). Every transform goes through `DisplayKey` (snap first, then key). A creation failure turns the
pool off for the session (particles stand in).

### 28.7 Gunung Terangkat (TerrainLift)

For `Dampak.debris() == LIFT` (space and earth-shaping arts): the positions of a job's batches are grouped into
**cells** (2 × 2 columns at Normal and Maximal, 3 × 3 at Minimal or above the cap); each cell is one BlockDisplay of its
most common top state, scaled (cell, 1-2, cell), that rises 12-30 b over 40-60 ticks (easeOutCubic) while turning
2-5°/t about a seeded tilted axis, hangs 10 ticks, then crumbles (one shrink over 6 ticks + `BLOCK` particles).
`IMPLODE` cells spiral into the black hole core instead. A **light grid** (thin glow lines along the cell borders,
pattern `GRID` of 28.9) shows on the ground 10-20 ticks before the cells lift.

Without Kehancuran the cells are visual: sampled from the client's surface around the impact (one heightmap read per
cell), they rise from 0.1 b above the ground while the ground stays, with a glowing crack decal under each.

| | Minimal | Normal | Maximal |
|---|---|---|---|
| lift cells alive (inside the display pool) | 0 (particles) | 24 | 64 |
| grid lines | particles every 2 b | 48 segments | 128 segments |

### 28.8 Kawah Lebur (MoltenCrater)

#### 28.8.1 Server surface pass (Mode Kehancuran only, M1)

After a job's carve positions are done, a job whose spec names a palette (`Dampak.palette() != NONE`) gets a second
phase in the **same job, same undo entry, same per-tick budget**:

1. Candidates (reads stay within 4 × cap): for each carved position, the block directly below if it was not carved,
   and the four side neighbours of each carved column's top (the rim). Duplicates dropped.
2. Kept only if `Shapes.natural(state)`, not `ProtectedZones.neverTouch`, not in a protected zone (re-checked per batch
   like the carve), not `touchesUnsafe` (no fluid or block-entity neighbour), not in the caster's safe column and, for
   magma, at least 6 b from the cast position and not under a standing player.
3. Cap: `min(kehancuranSurfaceMax (256), max(16, changed / 8))`, a seeded sample (seed = job centre hash).
4. Each candidate becomes the palette's target by a position hash (deterministic), set with WorldBreaker's `FLAGS`
   (no updates, no drops) and recorded in the undo entry as (old, placed); Pulihkan restores it only where the placed
   state is still there. Never a gravity block, fluid, fire, block entity or valuable block.
5. One `DampakDebris` `SURFACE` batch per tick lets clients glow the converted blocks; `DONE` follows the pass.

Server config `kehancuranSurfacePass` (default true) and `kehancuranSurfaceMax` (16-512, default 256); per player
`/kultivasi kehancuran kawah nyala|mati` (stored with the self switch, default on). Disciple Destroyer Arts keep their
20.3 look (no palette).

#### 28.8.2 Palettes (`kehancuran/Surface.Palette`)

| Palette | Bottom (weights) | Rim | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `FIRE` Kawah Lebur | magma 12 %, blackstone 40 %, basalt 30 %, smooth basalt 18 % | blackstone, basalt; sand → glass | magma never ≤ 6 b from the cast position |
| `ICE` Kawah Beku | packed ice 55 %, snow block 45 % | snow block | no ICE (it melts into water), no blue ice |
| `LIGHTNING` Bekas Petir | tuff 60 %, smooth basalt 40 % | dirt-likes → coarse dirt | sand / red sand → glass (fulgurite) |
| `SWORD` Goresan Pedang | calcite 50 %, smooth stone 35 %, polished diorite 15 % | calcite | sword qi scours the stone white |
| `SPACE` Retakan Hampa | polished blackstone 40 %, blackstone 30 %, tuff 30 % | tuff | no obsidian or crying obsidian (portals, value) |
| `EARTH` Bumi Retak | cobbled deepslate 40 %, tuff 30 %, coarse dirt 30 % | coarse dirt | body arts, Five Elements Mountain, Ninth Hex |
| `LIFE` Tanah Hidup | dirt-likes → moss block 60 %, rooted dirt 40 %; stone untouched | moss block | life returns to the wound |
| `SHADOW` Tanah Arwah | dirt-likes → soul soil 50 %; stone → blackstone 50 % | soul soil | |
| `TAIJI` | calcite / blackstone in bands 2 b wide across the path | — | Tai Chi Diagram |

Excluded on purpose (anti-farm and world safety): obsidian, crying obsidian, blue ice, ice, amethyst, ores, lava, fire,
powder snow, sand and gravel as targets, anything with a block entity.

#### 28.8.3 Without Kehancuran: the glowing decal (M3)

A crater-shaped ground decal (`ground_glow.png` in the palette's glow colour, ≤ 64 quads following the heightmap) that
cools over 20-40 s (alpha and colour ramp to dark), plus 1-2 palette particles per tick (lava drip, snowflake,
electric spark, end rod, spore blossom, soul) for the first 10 s. Real `SURFACE` batches get the same glow on the
converted blocks for 10 s.

client; `yawFor(castPos, aim, seed)` is the horizontal angle of `aim − castPos`, or `seed % 360` when they coincide.

#### 28.9.2 Drawing (M3)

Lines are thin glow strips (width 0.25-0.6 b, additive `lightning()` type, the Dao colour; a second wider strip at
α 0.25 fakes the bloom) sampled every 1 b along the line, each vertex at the client heightmap + 0.04 (so they climb
hills and drop into craters); nodes are soft glow discs (r 0.8-1.5 b). **Ignition** follows `Dampak.sigilIgnite`: one
node and its incoming line light per event of that phase (EXTRA0 strikes, PULSE ticks, each step of a dash), the
remaining ones all together on the climax; lit lines brighten from the node outward over 6 ticks. **Star impacts**
(`BEIDOU_NINE`, `WUXING`, `LUOSHU`): on the climax each node gets a staggered strike (2 ticks apart): a short sky
pillar, a small ShockRing and a **glowing crystal** (a client BlockDisplay of `AMETHYST_CLUSTER`, `END_ROD` or
`SEA_LANTERN` by Dao, full bright, 0.6-1.6 b) that stays as part of the monument (28.10). A sigil lives until its
cast's climax + 100 ticks (crystals: the monument's time), then fades over 20 ticks.

| | Minimal | Normal | Maximal |
|---|---|---|---|
| segments drawn | none (dust dots every 2 b) | 256 | 512 |
| node discs | 0 | 16 | 32 |
| crystals (in the display pool) | 0 | 9 | 18 (two per node) |

#### 28.9.3 Burning trenches (Mode Kehancuran only, M1)

For `Dampak.sigilTrench() == true`, `Destruction` adds the pattern's segments (scaled by `K × mastery area`, clamped to
`kehancuranMaxRadius × 2`) as TRENCH shapes 1 b wide and 1 b deep (2 at Dewa), anchored on the surface and submitted
with the climax's shapes in the same `Kehancuran.submitSelf` (one job, one undo entry). They take a fixed **15 %
share** of the cast's block cap, carved out before the existing split, so the total never exceeds `blockCap`. With a
`FIRE` or `LIGHTNING` palette the trench floors join the surface pass (molten lines). The client draws the burning
look (ember or spark particles along the lit lines for 10 s).

### 28.10 Monumen (Monument)

A lingering giant prop at the impact: a client-only `ModelFx` prop (`ModelRequest` with `casterId` −1 so ABORT does not
end it, `glow` true, `FxLayer.Priority.CORE`) of an existing `kultivator:fx/<id>` model, posed by `Dampak.pose`:
`PLANTED` (tilted 8-12°, sunk 20 % into the ground), `FLAT` (lying on the ground), `UPRIGHT` (standing, a slow 0.3°/t
turn), `HOVER` (floating 2 b up, slow BOB). It appears on the climax with one `GROW` from 0.6 (or a `FALL` + `STAMP`
for planted swords), breathes by light (`lightCycle(9, 80, seed)`), cools by `lightTo(6, life)` and leaves by one
`end(20)` after `Dampak.monumentSeconds` (30-180). The crystals of a sigil (28.9.2) belong to it.

| | Minimal | Normal | Maximal |
|---|---|---|---|
| monuments alive (all casters; the oldest ends first; inside the PhantomDisplays caps) | 1 | 2 | 4 |
| child parts | no | yes | yes |

Ended early when the camera is more than 128 b away or the dimension changes. **Decision: no real block remnant**, not
even under Kehancuran: a placed "sword block" would be farmable, would need protection rules of its own and would
outlive the undo window. The crater (28.8) is the only real trace.
