#### Contracts

**C30.1 Driver API** (`UltimatesA` and `UltimatesB`, same shape as `FireUltimates`, all `public static`):

```java
boolean handles(String specId);                       // the spec ids of 30.4 owned by this driver
void onTechFx(Payloads.TechFx p, TechniqueSpec spec, Phase phase, @Nullable Entity caster); // every phase incl. ABORT
void tick(ClientLevel level);                         // once per unpaused client tick, after FireUltimates.tick
void abort(int casterId);                             // idempotent; ends that caster's runs (fade 6)
void clear();                                         // world change, disconnect
void models(FxModels.Sink sink);                      // registers the Info rows of its models
```

F wires: in `ArtModels.onTechFx`, after the "Efek pemain lain" check and the ABORT handling, `if (UltimatesA.handles(id))
{ UltimatesA.onTechFx(p, spec, phase, caster); return; }` (same for B), before `place(...)`; `ArtModels.endCast` also
calls both `abort`s; `AnimClient` calls both `tick`s and `clear`s; `FxModels` gains
`public interface Sink { void put(String id, float scale, Axis axis, boolean glow, int color, int color2, float baseY,
Part... parts); }` and its static block ends with `UltimatesA.models(FxModels::put); UltimatesB.models(FxModels::put);`
(the private `put` is passed as a method reference; no other change to the table).

**C30.2 Film API** (`client/epic/film/FilmDirector`, F):

```java
public record Ctx(int casterId, String specId, Vec3 origin, Vec3 aim, float yaw, long seed, int climaxIn, int duration) {}
public interface Track { Vec3 pos(float partial); float yaw(float partial); float pitch(float partial); boolean alive(); }
public static boolean play(String filmId, Ctx ctx);   // own caster only; false: not played (setting, gates, no film)
public static void cue(int casterId, String beat, Vec3 at);   // driver beats: "release", "impact", "dive", "step", …
public static void track(int casterId, String key, @Nullable Track track); // props for P(key) spaces (null removes)
public static void abort(int casterId);
public static boolean claims(String specId);          // true while a film of that spec is armed or playing
public static boolean playing();
```

- The drivers call `play(spec.id(), ctx)` on the CAST (or the CHARGE for charged specs) with `climaxIn` = the spec's
  `dampak().climaxAt()` minus the event's age, or −1 when the climax is player-timed (`void_mirror`, `tai_chi_diagram`,
  `kunpeng_art`, `ninth_hex` released early, own arts). They call `track` when a tracked prop appears and `cue` on the
  beats their tables name. A driver's choreography never depends on whether the film plays.
- F starts the films of `emperor_flame`, `nine_suns_heavens_fury` (from its `ArtModels` dispatch, using
  `FireUltimates`' props through positions it computes from the events) and of the four Titah decrees (from the
  `PusakaFilm` hand-off).
- `claims` lets `SkyRide` and `PusakaFilm` yield; when a film is refused they run exactly as today.

**C30.3 Shot DSL** (30.2.5): `Film`, `FilmAct`, `FilmShot`, `FilmSpace`, `Ease`, `FilmLens`, `FilmShake`,
`FilmSound.Cue`; public so that test commands and future films can build shots. Only `FilmDirector` turns them into
`Shots.Type.FILM`.

**C30.4 Particles and sounds** (F, common): `FilmParticles.SPARK, FLARE, STAR, SMOKE, FLAME, MAGIC, SLASH, TRACE, TWIRL,
CIRCLE, MUZZLE, DIRT, SYMBOL` (`SimpleParticleType`), and `FilmSounds.RISER_LONG … ROCK` (`SoundEvent`); drivers may
spawn the particles (through `FxBudget`) but play film sounds only through `FilmSound` (F), never as world sounds.

**C30.5 Hancur Total** (K, server): `ProtectedZones.Rules { CLASSIC, TOTAL }`, `ProtectedZones.neverTouch(level, pos,
state, rules)`, `Kehancuran.totalOn(ServerPlayer)`, `Kehancuran.rulesFor(UUID owner, MinecraftServer)`. No client code
reads them; the client learns nothing new (the debris packets of 28.13.2 already carry any removed state).

### 30.7 Daftar uji (untuk `docs/uji/FASE-30.md`)

**Hancur Total (K)**
1. Mode Kehancuran nyala, Hancur Total nyala (bawaan). Rapal jurus berpahat di atas batuan dasar, obsidian, portal
   Nether, dan peti berisi: semuanya hilang, tidak ada item jatuh, tidak ada lava atau api.
2. `/kultivasi kehancuran total mati`, ulangi: batuan dasar, obsidian, portal, cairan dan peti dibiarkan (aturan lama).
3. Di dekat aula sekte, lokasi pembangunan sekte, gua tinggal, desa, ranah rahasia, titik spawn dan pemain lain: tidak
   satu blok pun berubah walau Hancur Total nyala. Prasasti aula, mata formasi dan blok monumen Titah tidak pernah hancur.
4. Pahat ke dalam danau: air di dalam bentuk ikut hilang, tidak ada air melayang di dalam kawah; dinding air di tepi
   tetap diam sampai ada pembaruan di sebelahnya. Dengan `kehancuranFluidSettle 64` tepi langsung mengalir.
5. Peti berisi ikut terpahat lalu **Pulihkan**: peti kembali **beserta isinya** (cek satu per satu), tungku dengan isinya,
   kotak shulker dengan isinya. Pesan "Dipulihkan: … wadah beserta isinya" muncul.
6. Titah tingkat 3 (undo massal) di atas peti: Pulihkan mengembalikan isi peti. Titah tingkat 6-9: teks konfirmasi
   menyebut peti hilang bersama isinya; setelah "Ya", Pulihkan menjawab permanen.
7. Batas simpanan wadah (`kehancuranUndoBlockEntities 2`, tiga peti dalam bentuk): peti ketiga tetap utuh dan pesan
   batas muncul sekali.
8. Batuan dasar paling bawah terpahat: kehampaan terbuka; pesan "Hancur Total NYALA" sudah memperingatkannya.
   Kolom aman perapal tetap berdiri.
9. Murid dengan Jurus Pemusnah memakai saklar Hancur Total milik guru.
10. `kehancuranTotalAllowed false` di server: semua jalan memakai aturan lama, saklar menampilkan "dimatikan server".

**Film Spektakuler (F)**
11. Pengaturan Kamera sinematik berputar Singkat → Penuh → Spektakuler → Mati; pertama kali memilih Spektakuler muncul
    peringatan gerak; "Kembali ke Penuh" benar-benar kembali ke Penuh.
12. "Kurangi gerak" nyala: Spektakuler tidak tersedia (Mati). Mati, Singkat dan Penuh berperilaku persis seperti sebelumnya.
13. `/sinematik film titah_pedang`: naik ke langit, Langit Kosmik (sungai bintang, nebula, istana), POV menunggang
    pedang turun, bingkai dampak, waktu beku, dentuman terlambat, sapuan cepat mengikuti belahan, tarikan udara.
    Tidak ada potongan kasar tanpa penutup (tirai hitam, awan, bingkai, coretan sapuan).
14. Kecepatan: kamera Spektakuler tidak pernah tampak melompat; F3 tidak menunjukkan chunk hilang atau berkedip
    (Sodium); di ketinggian 48 b tanah tetap termuat.
15. Bahaya: zombie mendekat dalam 24 b, nyawa di bawah 50 %, terkena pukulan, jatuh, di air, berkuda: film tidak mulai
    atau langsung kembali ke mata; Backspace melewati satu babak, tekan dua kali melewati seluruh film.
16. Setiap babak dimulai ulang hanya jika semua syarat aman masih terpenuhi; pertarungan di antara babak memakai kamera
    pemain sendiri.
17. Lapisan lensa: butiran film, pinggiran warna, suar lensa (hilang saat sumber tertutup), garis anamorfik
    (Maksimal), kebocoran cahaya, coretan sapuan, riak panas. "Lapisan lensa: Ringan" dan "Mati" bekerja.

    mematikan bingkai dampak.
19. Langit Kosmik hanya terlihat oleh perapal; pemain lain melihat langit dan efek dunia biasa.
20. Waktu beku: efek mod membeku, kamera tetap bergerak; mob vanilla tetap bergerak sesuai server; server tidak melambat

21. Suara Kenney: riser saat naik, whoosh tiap sapuan, dengung di angkasa, sub-boom tepat pada dentuman terlambat;
    subtitle muncul dalam dua bahasa. Suara stereo hanya terdengar oleh perapal; suara mono berposisi untuk pemain dekat.
22. `docs/CREDITS.md` menyebut Kenney (CC0) dan daftar berkas yang dipakai.

**Pamungkas baru (U1, U2)**
23. Setiap jurus di 30.4 (`/kultivasi uji dampak <id>`): ada empat babak yang jelas (persiapan, pelepasan, dampak,

24. Tidak ada perubahan ukuran acak: properti tumbuh sekali, membuka atau melipat dengan halus, berputar tetap, bernapas

26. Angka permainan tidak berubah: kerusakan, jangkauan, durasi, cooldown dan baris Sumber sama persis (bandingkan

27. Monumen Dampak tetap muncul dan properti akhir berganti ke monumen dengan memudar, tanpa kedip.
28. Tanpa Mode Kehancuran semua efek hanya visual; dengan Mode Kehancuran kawah dan parit mengikuti Hancur Total.

32. Teks: setiap kunci `kehancuran_total.*` dan `film.*` ada di en_us dan id_id; semua Sumber tetap sama.

## 31. Aura Kultivasi

The user asked (2026-10-21, translated): "While I (or a disciple) cultivate, show a rich aura that is different for each of
the nine realms, visibly grows with every stage, follows my Dao, and looks like the cultivation novels." This section
is the contract for that feature. It is **presentation only**: no gameplay number, no Sumber line of an existing
feature, no block and no server entity changes.

### 31.0 Scope, facts from the code, and what stays (binding)

**Stays exactly as it is:** every existing Sumber line and gameplay number; rule 0.1 (no block changes: the aura never
touches `WorldBreaker` or `BuildPlacer`, never a `LightningBolt`, weather, time or tick-rate change); rule 0.4 (all
effects client side from synced state); the weak-laptop rule (no post chain, no core shader, no custom
`RenderPipeline`; the "heavy shader" look is faked with layered additive quads, glow textures and a HUD overlay); the
budgets of 22.15 / 23.14 (`EffectQuality`, `FxBudget`, `EpicBudget`, `PhantomDisplays`); Sodium/Iris (28.1.4, the pack
profile of 23.14.3); `DisplayKey` for every display transform (through `ModelFx`); ItemStacks created lazily
(`ModelFx.stack` only, never in a static initialiser or renderer constructor); each file's line endings
(`KultivatorClient.java` is CRLF, the other files touched here are LF; check `git ls-files --eol` first); text in
`lang-src/<fragment>.en_us.json` and `.id_id.json` with identical keys; server code never references a client class.
The aura never moves the camera (the 7b camera rules are untouched; it adds no shot).

**Facts found in the code (the code is the truth):**

| Fact | Where | Consequence for 31 |
|---|---|---|
| "Cultivating" = `CultivationData.meditating()`, synced as `VisualState.MEDITATING`; the seat is `MeditationPose.posed(visual) && MeditationPose.canSit(player)` (MEDITATING, or BREAKING_THROUGH without TRIBULATION); its eased strength is `MeditationPose.strength(entity, partial)` | `cultivation/Meditation`, `data/Cultivators.refreshVisual`, `client/render/MeditationPose` | the aura is active exactly while seated (or previewed, 31.6); it fades with its own clock, started from the same state |
| Disciples: `DiscipleEntity.FLAG_MEDITATING` / `FLAG_BREAKING_THROUGH` in `syncedFlags()`; seat `DiscipleLook.seated`, `DiscipleLook.seatStrength` | `disciple/DiscipleEntity`, `client/disciple/DiscipleLook` | same rule for disciples |
| Ranks: `Rank(realm, layer, stage)`, stage 0..3 (Awal, Tengah, Akhir, Puncak); **only Immortal Ascension has layers (9)**; Qi Refining has 4 stages and no layers; Mortal has one stage | `data/Rank`, `data/Realm` | "grows with Qi Refining layers" is read as: grows with the 4 stages in every realm, and additionally with the 9 layers of Immortal Ascension |
| `Rank.isBottleneck()` (stage = Peak) and `CultivationData.barFull()` / `DiscipleData.barFull()` | `data/Rank`, `data/CultivationData`, `disciple/DiscipleData` | breakthrough-ready = `isBottleneck() && barFull() && !isMax()`; not synced today, S adds it |
| Root grade `RootGrade.HEAVENLY` (players and disciples); the root element mask is synced only as its main colour (`VisualState.rootColor`, `DiscipleEntity.syncedRootColor`) | `data/RootGrade`, `data/Element` | S syncs the Heavenly flag and the element mask |
| Special physiques exist **only for disciples** (`PowerIds.PHYSIQUE_*` 1..9, synced in `syncedTalent()` bits 0-3); players have none | `disciple/power/PowerIds`, `DiscipleEntity.packTalent` | accent for players: Heavenly root only; for disciples: Heavenly root or physique ≠ 0 |
| Dao colour `Dao.color()`; `DiscipleLook.color(realm, dao)` (Dao colour once chosen, else realm colour) | `data/Dao` | the aura tint (31.3) |
| `AuraFx` draws the subtle realm aura of players (≥ Qi Refining, `SHOW_AURA`), `DiscipleFx` the disciples' aura and meditation motes, `MeditationFx` the root-colour motes into the dantian and the Maximal ground ring | `client/fx/*` | kept when NOT cultivating; while the new aura is active they skip their aura/meditation-mote parts for that entity (31.2.6) |
| `QuadFx` kinds have technique caps; `FilmParticleProviders.spawn` counts a per-shot cap that only resets inside films | `client/fx/quad`, `client/epic/film` | the aura has its own quad renderer and budget; E adds an ambient spawn method that skips the shot cap (C31.4) |

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 31.1 What the player sees (summary)

When a cultivator sits down to cultivate, the old faint aura cross-fades (30 ticks, smoothstep) into the **Aura
Kultivasi** of their realm: a glowing ground decal opens under the seat, the realm's layered light appears around the
body, its 3D props grow in once, motes of qi start to flow, and a very quiet realm hum fades in. Every stage adds a
clearly visible element (31.4); Immortal Ascension layers add more. The colours follow the cultivator's Dao, a
Heavenly root or a special physique adds an accent, and a full bottleneck makes the aura pulse with an amber warning
glow. When cultivation stops the aura fades out over 20 ticks, props shrink away once (fade 12), and the subtle
`AuraFx` aura returns.

### 31.2 The shared aura engine (module E)

#### 31.2.1 Classes (all in `src/client/java/dev/kultivator/client/aura/`, E)

| Class | Role |
|---|---|
| `AuraClient` | `init()` (from `KultivatorClient`, one line): registers the preview receiver, the render hook, the HUD element, the realm drivers (E's five, then `AuraHigh.init()`); `tick(Minecraft)` (from `AuraFx.tick`); `clear()` (world change / disconnect) |
| `AuraEngine` | finds subjects (players and disciples ≤ 64 b), owns one `AuraRig` per entity id, runs the lifecycle (31.2.2), LOD (31.2.4), budgets (31.2.5), the driver registry `register(Realm, AuraRealmDriver)`, `covers(int entityId)` |
| `AuraSubject` | immutable per-tick snapshot of one cultivator (C31.2) |
| `AuraRig` | per-entity state: fade, clocks, props (`ModelHandle`s by key), eased stage values, driver scratch data |
| `AuraDraw` | the per-frame quad writer (billboard glow, flat decal, tilted ring, beam, ribbon, upright textured card) with the aura quad budget; render types made lazily per texture through `RenderTypes.entityTranslucentEmissive(Identifier)` and `RenderTypes.lightning()` (via `EpicRenderTypes` where one exists) |
| `AuraParticles` | qi and film particles through `FxBudget` (DETAIL for own and own disciples, EXTRA for others), vanilla particle setting respected, seeded positions |
| `AuraColors` | the palette of a subject (31.3) and the physique accent table |
| `AuraRng` | deterministic hash noise `float of(int entityId, long tick, int salt)` (no `RandomSource` for shapes) |
| `AuraHum` | the looping hum (`AbstractTickableSoundInstance`, `SoundSource.AMBIENT`) and rare chimes; ≤ 2 hums at once (the nearest), fade in/out with the aura |
| `AuraHud` | the first-person screen-edge glow (`HudElementRegistry.attachElementBefore(VanillaHudElements.CHAT, Kultivator.id("aura_edge"), …)`) |
| `AuraPreviewClient` | the client side of the preview payload (31.6): entity id → preview rank and flags until a tick |
| `AuraSettings` | the three settings rows (31.5), stored through `EffectQuality.get/put` |
| `realm/MortalAura`, `realm/QiRefiningAura`, `realm/FoundationAura`, `realm/GoldenCoreAura`, `realm/NascentSoulAura` | E's five drivers (31.4.1-31.4.5) |

H adds `src/client/java/dev/kultivator/client/aura/high/**` (31.4.6-31.4.9) with the entry class `AuraHigh`.

#### 31.2.2 Lifecycle (per entity)

1. **Active** = (seated: players `MeditationPose.posed(visual) && canSit`, disciples `DiscipleLook.seated`) or a live
   preview for that entity id; and not invisible / spectator / removed; and the settings allow it (31.5); and
   `SHOW_AURA` is set for players (their own cosmetic choice; previews ignore it).
2. **Fade** `f` (0..1) ages by client ticks: in over 30 t, out over 20 t, smoothstep. While BREAKING_THROUGH the aura is
   held at `f × 0.5` so `BreakthroughFx` reads clearly; DEVIATION or TRIBULATION end it (fade out).
3. **Start**: the driver's `start` is called once when `f` leaves 0 (or the realm changes); props are requested then
   (grow-in 20 t, once). **Stage or layer change** while active: `AuraRig.ease` values move to the new stage over 20 t,
   props `scaleTo` the new size once over 20 t, and a one-shot ring of light rolls out of the decal (the only "swell").
   **Realm change**: the old driver `stop`s (props end, fade 10) and the new one starts.
4. **Stop**: when `f` reaches 0 after the fade-out, the driver's `stop` ends every prop (`end(12)`) and the rig is
   dropped; rigs of entities out of range or gone for 40 t are dropped too.
5. Idle cost with nobody cultivating: one pass over `level.players()` plus one disciple box query every 10 ticks.

**Deterministic animation:** shapes are functions of `clock = gameTime + entityId × 37` and the eased stage values;
"breathing" is done only by alpha or display light (`ModelHandle.lightCycle`), never by size; particle positions come
from `AuraRng`; there is no random size anywhere.

#### 31.2.3 Geometry and the body frame

The frame of a subject: `feet` (entity position, lerped with the partial tick), `seatTop = feet + 0.55 × scale` when
seated (the pose lowers the model by `MeditationPose.LOWER`), `dantian = feet + 0.45 × scale` seated (0.9 standing),
`crown = feet + bbHeight × 0.69 + 0.15` seated, the body yaw `yBodyRot`, the scale `entity.getScale()`. Every radius in
31.4 is in blocks at scale 1 and multiplied by the scale. Ground decals sit `0.04` b above `feet.y` and are drawn only
while `onGround()` (no polygon offset, 28.1.4). Quads are drawn from Fabric `LevelRenderEvents.COLLECT_SUBMITS`
(registered after `QuadFx`), never during `ShaderCompat.shadowPass()`.

#### 31.2.4 Distance LOD (distance from the camera)

| Band | What is drawn |
|---|---|
| ≤ 24 b: **full** | everything the quality and settings allow |
| 24-64 b: **reduced** | decal + one body glow + the realm's identity quad (no props, no ribbons, no hum), particles × 0.25 |
| > 64 b | nothing (the rig fades out) |

A preview of your own aura is always full when within 24 b.

#### 31.2.5 Budgets (per Effect Quality: Minimal / Normal / Maximal)

| Item | Minimal | Normal | Maximal |
|---|---|---|---|
| auras drawn at full LOD (nearest first; your own always first) | 1 | 4 | 8 |
| auras drawn at reduced LOD in addition | 2 | 8 | 16 |
| aura quads per frame, all auras (× `EpicBudget.PACK_QUADS` 0.6 with a shader pack) | 120 | 600 | 1500 |
| quads per aura | 60 | 200 | 400 |
| props (displays) per aura (through `ModelFx`, priority DETAIL, so techniques win) | 0 | 3 | 6 |
| props of all auras alive | 0 | 9 | 24 (and never more than a third of `EffectQuality.displaysAlive()`) |
| particles per aura per tick (before share and LOD) | 1 | 4 | 10 |
| ribbons per aura | 0 | 2 | 4 |
| hums at once | 1 | 2 | 2 |

- The quality in effect is `min(EffectQuality.level(), EpicBudget.tier())` while a 7b/10/30 scene runs; when
  `EpicBudget.tier()` is −1 the aura draws particles only. The EpicBudget frame guard therefore thins the aura first.
- `share` = 1 for yourself and your own disciples, `EffectQuality.othersScale()` for other players and their disciples
  (Penuh 1, Ringan 0.25: no props, half the quads, a quarter of the particles; Mati: none).
- "Sederhana" (31.5) = Minimal-sized aura at any quality: decal, two glow layers, the identity quad, particles; no
  props, no ribbons.
- Every particle goes through `FxBudget.take` (cost `max(1, life / 20)`); a refused particle is simply not made.

#### 31.2.6 Interplay with existing effects

- `AuraFx` (E): unchanged when not cultivating; for a player with `AuraEngine.covers(id)` it skips that player
  (the new aura replaces it while active; it cross-fades back by the engine's fade-out).
- `MeditationFx` (E, one guard): `meditationMotes` is skipped for players the engine covers (the realm drivers draw
  their own inflow in the root colour). The enlightenment halo, formation lines and one-shot effects stay.
- `DiscipleFx` (E, one guard): `aura(...)` and `meditation(...)` are skipped for covered disciples; breakthrough,
  deviation and fighting effects stay.
- `DaoCircleLayer`, robe, eyes, back sword: untouched (they still draw; the aura is around them).
- While the subject's own `DHARMA` flag is set, H's Deity Transformation idol is hidden (no double giant).

#### 31.2.7 First person (your own aura with a first-person camera)

No world quads, props or decal for yourself. Instead: (a) `AuraHud` draws a soft screen-edge glow (a vignette made of
4 gradient strips, alpha ≤ 0.16 × f, the realm's body colour mixed 35 % with the tint, breathing by alpha over 80 t);
bottleneck-ready adds an amber edge pulse (31.3); (b) at most one mote every 4 ticks drifts across the lower half of
the view 1.2-2.0 b in front of the eyes, below the eye line, life 30 t. Hidden with F1 (`hideGui`), while a film
plays (`FilmDirector.playing()`), in spectator, and when Aura Kultivasi is Mati. Third person (F5) shows the full aura.

#### 31.2.8 Shader packs (Iris) and Sodium

Sodium: nothing touches chunk meshes; props are client displays, the rest are world quads. Iris: no geometry in the
shadow pass; with `ShaderCompat.packOn()` the pack profile applies: × 0.6 quads, at most one large layer per aura
(the biggest glow or the idol card), `entityTranslucentEmissive` only (no `lightning()` thin glow under a pack, like
`EpicRenderTypes.BOLT_EMISSIVE_UNDER_PACK = false`), decals at 0.04 b. The HUD glow is unaffected by packs.

#### 31.2.9 Sound

Each driver names its hum (31.4): a vanilla looping sound at volume ≤ 0.08, played as an `AuraHum` instance bound to the
subject (`AbstractTickableSoundInstance`, `SoundSource.AMBIENT`, looping, volume × f each tick, stopped when f = 0),
only for the two nearest active auras within 12 b; chimes (one-shot `SimpleSoundInstance` at ≤ 0.12) at most one per 60
ticks per aura. Film sounds are not used (C30.4 keeps them in `FilmSound`). "Dengung aura: Mati" silences all of it.
Vanilla sounds used (verified in mcsrc `SoundEvents`): `BEACON_AMBIENT`, `CONDUIT_AMBIENT`, `RESPAWN_ANCHOR_AMBIENT`,
`AMETHYST_BLOCK_CHIME`, `BELL_RESONATE`, `ENCHANTMENT_TABLE_USE`, `NOTE_BLOCK_CHIME` (a `Holder.Reference`: use
`.value()`).

### 31.3 Colours, accent and the breakthrough-ready glow

`AuraColors.of(subject)` returns:

| Name | Value |
|---|---|
| `body` | the realm colour of the table in 31.4 (not `Realm.color()` for Immortal Ascension, whose white is too flat) |
| `tint` | the Dao colour (`Dao.color()`) when a Dao is chosen, else `body`; mixed 35 % into ribbons, rings and decals, 20 % into glows |
| `inflow` | the root's main element colour (`rootColor`): the qi motes drawn in |
| `elements` | the element colours of the root mask (≤ 4, `Element.fromMask(rootElements)`): Dao Union runes and the True Immortal wheel |
| `accent` | Heavenly root: `RootGrade.HEAVENLY.color()` `FFC93C`; else a disciple physique: Poison `6BCB3A`, Taixu `7FD8FF`, Dou Di `C02030`, Golden Body `FFD54A`, Devouring `5A2A8A`, Supreme Bone `F0F0FF`, Double Pupils `9A6AFF`, Heretic `D04020`, Attributeless `D8D8D8`; else none (−1) |
| `warn` | `FF9A3A` → `FF4A3A` (breakthrough ready) |

**Accent** (when `accent ≠ −1`): a thin outer ring at 1.15 × the realm's widest radius in the accent colour (alpha 0.45,
turning 0.6°/t), and three accent sparks orbiting the dantian at r 0.5 (period 60 t). Heavenly roots also give the decal
a second, outer gilded line.

**Breakthrough ready** (`isBottleneck && barFull && !isMax`): an amber rim glow around the whole aura whose alpha follows
`0.25 + 0.2 × (1 − cos(2π t / 30)) / 2` (deterministic, never a size change); thin red crack lines fade in on the decal
(texture `aura/decal_crack`); one quiet `BELL_RESONATE` chime every 120 t (pitch 1.6, volume 0.06); in first person
the screen edge pulses amber with the same curve.

### 31.4 The nine realms

Common stage words: **Awal** (stage 0), **Tengah** (1), **Akhir** (2), **Puncak** (3). Every stage adds what its row
says on top of the earlier stages; sizes ease to the new value once (31.2.2). Model ids start with `aura_` and carry no
`FxModels` row (they use `FxModels.DEFAULT`; each driver passes its own scale), so `FxModels.java` is not edited. Quad
textures live in `textures/misc/aura/` (E) and `textures/misc/aura_high/` (H). The Sumber lines below go into the realm
aura text keys (C31.6) exactly as written (Indonesian here; the English key says the same).

| Stages | Awal: the lotus throne and the star wheel (9 stars). Tengah: 18 stars, the domain r 3, the decal. Akhir: 28 stars with the Beidou seven bright, the domain r 4.5, the armillary prop. Puncak: the domain r 6 with a second wheel crossing the first at 60°, the nine-grade throne, the light column. True Immortal Puncak is the maximum rank: never a bottleneck glow |
| Sumber | Sumber: alkimia batin Daois, 大周天 Sirkuit Langit Agung (peredaran qi yang mengikuti putaran langit); Beidou, tujuh bintang Biduk Utara, dan dua puluh delapan rumah bulan; wilayah (领域) dalam Renegade Immortal, seperti wilayah Hidup-Mati dan Karma milik Wang Lin (bab 826, 851); Sutra Kontemplasi Amitayus (观无量寿经): sembilan tingkat kelahiran di atas teratai (九品莲台); roda bintang dan singgasana adalah rancangan permainan |

### 31.6 Test commands (S, server, op; under `/kultivasi uji` and `/cultivate uji`)

| Command | Does |
|---|---|
| `/kultivasi uji aura <realm> [stage 1-4] [layer 1-9]` | previews that aura on yourself for 20 s **without changing your rank** (default stage 4, layer 1; the layer only matters for `immortal_ascension`); uses your real Dao, root and accent; a Puncak preview below True Immortal shows the breakthrough-ready glow in its last 10 s |
| `/kultivasi uji aura semua` | cycles every realm and stage on yourself, 3 s each: Mortal; Qi Refining .. Dao Union stages 1-4; Immortal Ascension (layer 1 Awal, 3 Tengah, 6 Akhir, 9 Puncak); True Immortal 1-4 (33 steps, 99 s); Puncak steps below True Immortal show the bottleneck glow; an action-bar line names each step |
| `/kultivasi uji aura murid <name> <realm> [stage] [layer]` | the same 20-s preview on that loaded disciple of yours (name token as in `uji murid`, the same suggestions) |
| `/kultivasi uji aura aksen` | toggles, for your previews, a forced accent (Heavenly gold) to check 31.3 |
| `/kultivasi uji aura stop` | ends your preview or cycle and those of your disciples |

The preview draws the aura as if the subject were cultivating (seated or not; sit with the meditation key to see the
pose too). Previews end on death, dimension change, logout and server stop; nothing is saved.

### 31.7 Modules (exactly three, disjoint files)

**Order of work.** S and E start in parallel; E commits the API of C31.1-C31.4 first as compiling skeletons so H builds
on it. A single compile step runs after all three (rule 0.6); E's `AuraClient.init` calls `AuraHigh.init()` directly,
as `FxModels` calls `UltimatesA/B` (30.5).

#### S: server and shared (sync, preview, test commands, server text)

Owns: `src/main/java/dev/kultivator/data/VisualState.java` (C31.5), the aura lines of `Cultivators.refreshVisual`,
`src/main/java/dev/kultivator/disciple/DiscipleEntity.java` (the new `DATA_AURA` accessor, its define, `syncedAura()`,
the packing in `syncFlags`), `DiscipleData` only if a helper is needed, the new package
`src/main/java/dev/kultivator/aura/**` (`AuraPreviewPayload`, `AuraPreviews`: payload registration, the `aura` command
node, the preview/cycle ticker, cleanup on death / dimension change / leave / stop), one line in
`Kultivator.onInitialize` (`AuraPreviews.init()`), one `.then(AuraPreviews.command())` line in
`TestCommands.addCommands` (plus `token(DiscipleEntity)` and the name suggestions made public), and
`lang-src/aura_server.{en_us,id_id}.json` (`kultivator.aura.cmd.*`).

#### E: client aura engine, realms 1-5, settings, disciple hook

Owns: `src/client/java/dev/kultivator/client/aura/**` except `aura/high/**` (31.2.1), the guards in
`client/fx/AuraFx.java`, `client/fx/MeditationFx.java`, `client/fx/DiscipleFx.java` (31.2.6), the settings block in
`client/screen/SettingsPage.java`, the one init line in `client/KultivatorClient.java` (CRLF), the ambient spawn method
in `client/epic/film/FilmParticleProviders.java` (C31.4; nothing else in that file), `tools/gen_aura_assets.py` (new;
uses `tools/png.py`), `tools/fx_model_ids_aura.txt`, the assets `textures/misc/aura/**` and the models, item
definitions and textures with the prefixes `aura_fe_`, `aura_gc_`, `aura_ns_` (`models/item/fx/`, `items/fx/`,
`textures/item/fx/`), and `lang-src/aura.{en_us,id_id}.json` (settings rows and tooltips; realm aura names, lines and
Sumber of Mortal .. Nascent Soul).

#### H: client realms 6-9

Owns: `src/client/java/dev/kultivator/client/aura/high/**` (`AuraHigh` with `init()`, `DeityAura`, `DaoUnionAura`,
`AscensionAura`, `TrueImmortalAura`, any helper), `tools/gen_aura_high_assets.py` (new; uses `tools/png.py`),
`tools/fx_model_ids_aura_high.txt`, the assets `textures/misc/aura_high/**` and the prefixes `aura_dt_`, `aura_du_`,
`aura_ia_`, `aura_ti_`, and `lang-src/aura_high.{en_us,id_id}.json` (realm aura names, lines and Sumber of Deity
Transformation .. True Immortal).

Nobody edits another module's file. Every generated texture is opened with Read once (no magenta, glows fade to alpha 0
at the border), every model follows the rules of the `gen_fire_ultimate_models.py` docstring (anchor 8,8,8; coords
−16..32; single-axis rotations by 22.5° steps), and every new Minecraft or Fabric API use is checked in
`butterbot-fabric/reference/mcsrc` (or the Fabric API sources) and listed in the module's report.

### 31.8 Contracts

**C31.1 Driver API** (E, `dev.kultivator.client.aura`):

```java
public interface AuraRealmDriver {
    void start(AuraSubject s, AuraRig rig);                 // the aura of this realm begins (props grow in here)
    void tick(AuraSubject s, AuraRig rig);                  // every unpaused client tick while f > 0 (particles, props)
    void render(AuraSubject s, AuraRig rig, AuraDraw draw, float partial); // every frame, quads only
    void stop(AuraSubject s, AuraRig rig);                  // fade-out done or realm changed: end every prop
    AuraHum.Spec hum(AuraSubject s);                        // the hum and chime of 31.4 (AuraHum.Spec.NONE for none)
}
public final class AuraEngine {
    public static void register(Realm realm, AuraRealmDriver driver); // one per realm; E registers 0-4, AuraHigh.init() 5-8
    public static boolean covers(int entityId);             // true while the new aura draws this entity (f > 0)
}
```

**C31.2 Subject** (E): `public record AuraSubject(int entityId, @Nullable Entity entity, boolean disciple, boolean own,
Vec3 feet, double scale, double height, float bodyYaw, boolean seated, boolean onGround, Realm realm, int layer, int
stage, int dao, int rootColor, int rootElements, int accent, boolean bottleneck, boolean ascended, boolean dharma,
float fade, float lod /* 1 full, 0.5 reduced */, float share, boolean firstPersonSelf, boolean simple /* Sederhana */,
boolean preview)` with helpers `Vec3 dantian()`, `Vec3 crown()`, `Vec3 seatTop()`, `float stageGrow()` (0.55, 0.7,
0.85, 1.0 by stage), `float layerGrow()` (layer / 8 for Immortal Ascension, else 0), `AuraColors.Palette colors()`.

**C31.3 Rig, draw, particles, hum** (E):

```java
public final class AuraRig {
    public long clock();                                    // gameTime + entityId * 37
    public float ease(String key, float target, int ticks); // eased value; moves to a new target once (stage changes)
    public @Nullable ModelHandle prop(String key, Supplier<ModelRequest> request); // made once; null if refused (budget)
    public void endProp(String key, int fadeTicks);
    public void endProps(int fadeTicks);
    public int stageChangedAgo();                           // ticks since the last stage/layer change (MAX_VALUE if none)
    public <T> T data(String key, Supplier<T> init);        // driver scratch state
}
public final class AuraDraw {                               // every method returns false when the quad budget is spent
    public boolean glow(Vec3 c, float radius, int rgb, float alpha);                                  // camera-facing soft disc
    public boolean flat(Vec3 c, float radius, float turnDeg, Identifier tex, int rgb, float alpha);   // ground decal / disc
    public boolean ring(Vec3 c, Vec3 axis, float r0, float r1, float turnDeg, Identifier tex, int rgb, float alpha);
    public boolean beam(Vec3 from, Vec3 to, float width, int rgb, float alpha);
    public boolean card(Vec3 base, float w, float h, float yawDeg, boolean crossed, Identifier tex, int rgb, float alpha);
    public boolean ribbon(List<Vec3> points, float width, float tailWidth, int head, int tail, float alpha);
    public boolean large();                                 // takes the aura's one large-layer slot (pack profile)
}
```

loop, float volume, float pitch, @Nullable SoundEvent chime, float chimePitch, int chimeEvery)` with `Spec.NONE`.

**C31.5 Sync** (S, server and shared):
- `VisualState` gains the component `int rootElements` after `rootColor` (codec: a VarInt after the colour) and the
  flags `HEAVENLY_ROOT = 1 << 14`, `BOTTLENECK_READY = 1 << 15`; a 7-argument constructor with the old signature stays
  (rootElements 0); `NONE` keeps its values. `Cultivators.refreshVisual` sets them: Heavenly = `rootTested() &&
  rootGrade() == RootGrade.HEAVENLY`, ready = `rank.isBottleneck() && data.barFull() && !rank.isMax()`, elements =
  `data.rootElements()`.
- `DiscipleEntity`: `DATA_AURA` (INT, default 0) defined after the existing accessors; `public int syncedAura()`; bits
  `AURA_HEAVENLY_ROOT = 1`, `AURA_BOTTLENECK_READY = 2`, the root element mask in bits 8-23 (`AURA_ELEMENT_SHIFT = 8`);
  set from `syncFlags()` only when changed. The physique stays in `syncedTalent()` bits 0-3.
- `AuraPreviewPayload(int entityId, int realm, int layer, int stage, int flags, int ticks)` (clientbound, id
  `kultivator:aura_preview`, registered with `PayloadTypeRegistry.clientboundPlay()` from `AuraPreviews.init()`);
  `flags`: 1 forced accent, 2 bottleneck glow, 4 cycle step; `ticks` 0 = stop. The server re-sends a live preview every

  up), through `Net.send`. Dao, root colour and elements come from the subject's real synced data.
- Server text keys (S): `kultivator.aura.cmd.preview`, `.cycle_step`, `.disciple`, `.accent_on`, `.accent_off`, `.stop`,
  `.no_disciple`, `.unknown_realm`; realm names come from the client keys of C31.6 (`Component.translatable`; the lang

### 31.9 Daftar uji (untuk `docs/uji/FASE-31.md`)

**Dasar**
1. Duduk bermeditasi (tombol meditasi): aura lama memudar dan Aura Kultivasi muncul halus dalam ±1,5 detik; berdiri:
   aura memudar dalam ±1 detik, model 3D mengecil sekali lalu hilang, aura lama kembali. Tidak ada kedip.
2. `/kultivasi uji aura semua`: 33 langkah, tiap 3 detik, baris aksi menyebut ranah dan tahapnya. Setiap ranah jelas
   berbeda; setiap tahap menambah unsur yang terlihat (tabel 31.4); Kenaikan Abadi bertambah pilar dan paku gerbang
   per lapisan.
3. `/kultivasi uji aura golden_core 2`, lalu `... 4`: ukuran berubah mulus sekali, ada satu cincin cahaya dari dekal;
   tidak ada denyut ukuran acak. Ulangi dua kali: gerakannya sama persis.
4. Peringkat asli tidak berubah setelah pratinjau (status `/kultivasi` sama sebelum dan sesudah); pratinjau berhenti
   sendiri setelah 20 detik dan dengan `/kultivasi uji aura stop`.
5. `/kultivasi uji aura murid <nama> nascent_soul 3`: murid itu menampilkan aura Jiwa Baru Lahir; murid yang benar-benar
   bermeditasi juga menampilkan auranya sendiri; efek meditasi lama murid tidak tampil ganda.

**Warna dan aksen**
6. Pilih Dao berbeda (Api, Es, Petir, ...): cincin, pita, dekal dan rune ikut warna Dao; motes yang masuk memakai warna
   akar.
7. Akar Surgawi (atau `/kultivasi uji aura aksen`): cincin luar emas dan tiga percikan emas; murid dengan fisik langka
   memakai warna aksen fisiknya.
8. Bar kultivasi penuh di Puncak: cahaya peringatan kuning-merah berdenyut (bukan berubah ukuran), garis retak tipis di
   dekal, denting lonceng pelan; di Abadi Sejati Puncak tidak pernah muncul.

**Pengaturan**
9. "Aura Kultivasi: Sederhana": hanya dekal, cahaya dan partikel; tanpa model 3D dan pita. "Mati": hanya aura lama.
10. "Aura orang lain: Mati": aura pemain lain dan murid mereka hilang; aura sendiri dan murid sendiri tetap.
11. "Dengung aura: Mati": tidak ada dengung atau denting. Nyala: dengung sangat pelan, berbeda per ranah, ikut slider
    Suara Sekitar vanilla.
12. Kualitas Minimal / Normal / Maksimal: jumlah lapisan, model dan partikel sesuai tabel 31.2.5; "Efek pemain lain:
    Ringan" mengurangi aura orang lain.

**Kamera, jarak dan keamanan**
13. Orang pertama: tidak ada model atau quad menutupi pandangan; hanya cahaya lembut di tepi layar dan beberapa motes di
    bawah garis mata. F5: aura lengkap. F1: cahaya tepi hilang.
14. Jarak: ≤ 24 b lengkap; 24-64 b hanya dekal, satu cahaya dan sedikit partikel; > 64 b tidak ada.
15. Aura tidak pernah menggerakkan kamera; film dan sinematik tetap seperti biasa, dan cahaya tepi hilang saat film main.
16. Tidak ada blok berubah, tidak ada petir vanilla, cuaca, waktu atau kecepatan tick yang berubah; Mode Kehancuran tidak
    berpengaruh pada aura.
17. Terobosan: aura meredup separuh agar efek terobosan jelas; Penyimpangan Qi dan Tribulasi mengakhiri aura.

**Performa dan kompatibilitas (laptop lemah, Minimal/Otomatis, jarak render 8)**
18. Lima murid bermeditasi + diri sendiri di Abadi Sejati: FPS tidak turun di bawah 30 lebih dari sesaat; teknik tetap
    mendapat model lebih dulu (aura memakai prioritas DETAIL).
19. Sodium + Iris dengan paket shader: aura tampil, tidak ada bayangan aneh dari quad, dekal tidak berkedip di tanah,
    paling banyak satu lapisan besar per aura.
20. Tidak ada yang bermeditasi: biaya aura hampir nol (tanpa rig, tanpa quad).
21. Teks: setiap kunci `kultivator.aura.*` ada di en_us dan id_id; semua baris Sumber lama tetap sama; setiap ranah punya
    baris Sumber aura sesuai 31.4.
22. Semua tekstur aura tampak benar (tanpa ungu-hitam), tepi cahaya lembut; model 3D aura tampil rapi dari segala arah.

## 32. Film Kosmik 3D

The user asked (2026-10-21, translated): "For the Heaven seals (Titah Langit / Pusaka Langit) like the sword or the
pillar falling from the sky, make the cinematic so that at first the sword is in **outer space**, then it is summoned
and plunges into the earth. Make components with textures in the video, **3D**, like a 3D Earth or planet. Also when
the pillar from heaven falls, make a 3D cinematic of **Heaven** itself, and the others too." Asked whether to build the
3D version now, the user answered "gas" (yes).

Today the four decree films (30.3.1-30.3.4, `FilmCatalogTitah`) reach "space" only through Langit Kosmik (30.2.8):
2D billboards and strips projected on the sky. This section adds **Film Kosmik 3D**: two real 3D sets drawn by our own
client renderer, the **Orbit stage** (a planet that is this world seen from space, its moon, sun, clouds, atmosphere
and starfield) and the **Heaven stage** (the Southern Heaven Gate, the Lingxiao Hall, the cloud sea and the Nine
Heavens), and new authored shots for the four decree films that play inside them. It is presentation only, for the
caster's own client.

### 32.0 Scope, facts from the code, and what stays (binding)

**Stays exactly as it is:** every Sumber line and gameplay number (radii, damage, `climaxAt`, K = 100 / 120 / 140 / 90,
the TechFx timeline, Kecepatan, Tingkat 1-9 of 29.16, silences); rule 0.1 and 30.0 amendment 1 (blocks change only
through `kehancuran/WorldBreaker` under the player's own Mode Kehancuran, Titah carves or disciple Destroyer Arts;
nothing here touches a block, and without Kehancuran every effect stays visual); never a `LightningBolt`, weather,
time-of-day or tick-rate change (the stage's sun and moon are drawn, `SkyDirector` is not used in stage shots); the
weak-laptop rule (no post chain, no core shader, **no custom `RenderPipeline`**: only vanilla render types; the "heavy
shader" look is layered additive quads, glow textures and the HUD lens layers); `EffectQuality` Minimal / Normal /
Maximal and the `EpicBudget` frame guard; Sodium and Iris (28.1.4, the pack profile of 23.14.3); the 7b camera safety
rules (short skippable shots, Kamera Singkat / Penuh / Spektakuler / Mati, Backspace skips, never during danger, every
23.7.4 hard gate and the 30.2.2 film gates); `DisplayKey` for every display transform (the stages spawn **no** Display
entity; a later user that needs one goes through `DisplayKey`); ItemStacks only through `ModelFx.stack` and only on
first draw (never in a static initialiser, a constructor or `prepare`); server code is not touched at all; each file's
line endings (every file touched here is LF today: check `git ls-files --eol` first); text in
`lang-src/<fragment>.en_us.json` + `.id_id.json` with identical keys. The Japanese heaven voice (`voice.heaven.decree_*`)
stays server-triggered and is never played by the film; stage ducking never touches VOICE (`EpicSound.DUCKED` is
AMBIENT, WEATHER, NEUTRAL, BLOCKS only).

**Facts found in the code (the code is the truth):**

| Fact | Where | Consequence for 32 |
|---|---|---|
| A film shot's camera is `FilmPath.out` (x, y, z, yaw, pitch, FOV k, roll), evaluated in `CinematicDirector.filmPose` during camera setup, before the level renders; one `level.clip` per frame from the last pose | `epic/film/FilmPath`, `epic/camera/CinematicDirector` | a stage shot keeps the real camera still at a safe point and turns it; the virtual eye moves in the stage. The renderer reads the same frame's virtual eye |
| Real camera caps: ≤ 48 b above the subject's feet, ≤ min(64, render distance × 16 − 24) b from it | `FilmPath.MAX_HEIGHT`, `FilmStage.reach` | the camera never travels to a real place "in space"; space is a set drawn around a nearby air pocket |
| Our geometry is drawn from Fabric `LevelRenderEvents.COLLECT_SUBMITS` through `EpicRenderer.Sink` (camera-relative floats, `submitCustomGeometry`); skipped in Iris's shadow pass | `epic/render/EpicRenderer`, `ShaderCompat.shadowPass` | the stages use the same path and sinks |
| `submitCustomGeometry` routes a blending render type to the **translucent** phase and an opaque one to the **solid** phase; the classic order is solid terrain, solid features, translucent features, translucent terrain (water, glass), clouds, weather, world border; with "improved transparency" the translucent work is OIT; the see-through *text* phase runs last but custom geometry never goes there | mcsrc `SubmitNodeCollection.submitCustomGeometry`, `LevelRenderer.addMainPass` / `executeClassicTransparency` / `executeOit` | `textSeeThrough` quads (CosmicSky's open-sky trick) are still painted over by water, clouds and rain drawn later. The stage therefore hides the world with an **opaque, depth-writing dome close around the camera**, so everything drawn later fails the depth test |
| Near plane `Camera.PROJECTION_Z_NEAR = 0.05`; depth is reverse-Z (`GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL`, cleared to 0) | mcsrc `Camera`, `RenderPipelines` | stage geometry lives between 0.12 b and the dome |
| Vanilla types usable for the stage: `entitySolid(tex)` (opaque, culled, depth write), `entityCutout(tex)` (alpha cutout 0.1, no cull), `entityTranslucentEmissive(tex)` (translucent, no cull, depth test without write), `energySwirl(tex, u, v)` (ADDITIVE blend, `NO_CARDINAL_LIGHTING`, `EMISSIVE`, no cull, depth write; a new `RenderType` per call, so it is created **once** per texture with offsets 0, 0 and animated through vertex UVs) | mcsrc `RenderTypes`, `RenderPipelines.ENTITY_SOLID`, `ENTITY_CUTOUT`, `ENTITY_TRANSLUCENT_EMISSIVE`, `ENERGY_SWIRL` | the four stage sink kinds of C32.3 |
| Living-entity name tags render in the see-through text phase (no depth) unless the HUD is hidden | mcsrc `EntityRenderer.extractNameTags`, `LivingEntityRenderer.shouldShowName` | a tiny mixin clears `state.nameTag` / `scoreText` while a stage is shown, else other players' names would float over space |
| Item models can be submitted without an entity (`ItemModelResolver.updateForTopItem`, `ItemStackRenderState.submit`, `ItemDisplayContext.FIXED`), as `TitahMonumentRenderer` does | mcsrc, `pusakalangit/world/TitahMonumentRenderer` | the decree weapons (`heaven_splitting_sword`, `dinghai_pillar`, `star_core`, `yishan_seal`) appear in the stages as their existing models |
| Titah films: one continuous pre-climax act that ends on the server's climax (`holdForClimax`), the climax act on the event under the IMPACT mask, `retimeTitah` shortens cosmic shots first; shots ≤ 4 s, film ≤ 12 s (29.16) | `FilmDirector`, `FilmCatalogTitah` | kept; stage shots shrink first (32.5.1) |
| Film Pusaka (Kamera Penuh): F3 "Istana" is a world-anchored segment behind the first cloud wipe, 0.30 of the film (≤ 72 ticks) | `pusakalangit/cinema/PusakaFilm` | the Penuh version replaces F3 by one calm stage beat (32.5.6) |

**Not done (and why):** no real camera travel to y = 2000 or beyond the caps (chunks, fog and Sodium would show
edges); no `textSeeThrough`-only stage (water, clouds and rain would paint over it); no render target or GUI
picture-in-picture (a second full-screen target is a post-chain cost on the weak laptop); no runtime shaders.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 32.1 The virtual stage technique (F core, used by O and H)

#### 32.1.1 Where the camera goes

At the start of every stage shot F finds a **pocket**: a point C near the caster with a sphere of radius `R_d` (the
dome radius) that holds only air. The real camera jumps to C under the shot's mask (black dip, cloud wipe, smear or
impact frame) and **stays there** for the whole stage shot (and the following stage shots of the same stage). Only its
rotation, FOV and roll change, from the virtual eye's look in the stage. The virtual eye (double precision, stage metres
"sm") is what moves.

Pocket search (`StagePocket`, once per stage shot start, ≤ 0.3 ms):
- target `R_d` = 12 b (Normal, Maximal), 10 b (Minimal), 8 b (Kamera Penuh); minimum 6 b (Penuh 5 b);
- candidates, in order: straight above the caster's feet at heights `R_d + 3`, then +4 b steps up to 46 b (Penuh: up to
  24 b), then the same columns shifted 8 b to each of the four sides; each candidate must also be ≤ 64 b and
  ≤ render distance × 16 − 24 b from the caster (the 30.2.3 caps);
- a candidate passes when: `C.y − R_d − 2 ≥` the highest `Heightmap.Types.WORLD_SURFACE` of 7 × 7 samples over the square
  of side `2 R_d + 4` around it; `C.y + R_d + 2 ≤ level.getMaxY()`; every sampled column `level.hasChunkAt`; no entity
  other than the caster within `R_d + 2` (`level.getEntities` with an inflated AABB);
- the fog: the last frame's `fogStart` (`EpicRenderer.Frame.fogStart`) ≥ 2.5 × `R_d`, else `R_d` = fogStart / 2.5 if
  that is ≥ the minimum; no Blindness or Darkness on the player (`LivingEntity.hasEffect(MobEffects.BLINDNESS /
  DARKNESS)`); the camera fluid is none (ShotGuard already refuses fluids);
- if no candidate passes, the shot plays its **fallback** (`orElse`, 32.5) with the same length: the film never waits.

The pocket is kept for consecutive stage shots of the same stage (no camera jump between them).

#### 32.1.2 Hiding the real world: the dome

The first thing a stage draws is its **dome**: an inward-facing sphere at 0.97 `R_d` around the real camera in the
**solid** phase (`entitySolid(dome texture)`, depth write on). It is nearer than any world surface outside the pocket,
so it covers the vanilla sky, terrain, entities and chunk edges, and everything drawn after it (translucent terrain,
water, vanilla and Iris clouds, rain, particles, the world border) fails the depth test. The Orbit dome is the
starfield and Milky Way; the Heaven dome is the heavenly sky. If a stage has no dome texture yet, F draws a black
`textures/misc/kosmik/black.png` dome. The dome is frustum-culled on the CPU (quads whose centre direction is more than
(diagonal half-FOV + 12°) from the camera forward are skipped).

Name tags: the mixin `KosmikNameTagMixin` (F) injects at the TAIL of `EntityRenderer.extractNameTags(Entity,
EntityRenderState, float, double, double)` and sets `state.nameTag = null; state.scoreText = null` while
`Kosmik3D.covering()`; idle cost one boolean. A see-through `TextDisplay` within the pocket can still show (accepted,
rare).

While a stage covers the frame, `EpicRenderer.collect` skips the 7b element loop, `CosmicSky` and `HeatHaze` (they are
behind the dome) and spends the whole 7b quad budget on the stage.

#### 32.1.3 Depth inside the dome: the logarithmic diorama

Stage objects span 0.5 sm (a POV ride) to 20 000 sm (the far side of the moon). They are squeezed radially around the
virtual eye into the dome: a stage point P with `d = P − eye`, `ρ = |d|` is drawn camera-relative at

```
g(ρ) = clamp(N + (F − N) · ln(ρ / ρ0) / ln(ρ1 / ρ0), N, F)      N = 0.12 b, F = 0.90 R_d, ρ0 = 0.5 sm, ρ1 = 20 000 sm
drawn = d · g(ρ) / ρ
```

Every point keeps its exact direction from the eye, so the picture is exactly the true perspective picture; only depth is
compressed, monotonically, so the depth test still orders surfaces correctly (meshes are tessellated finely enough that
the per-vertex remap never shows: no stage triangle spans more than a 3:1 distance ratio, enforced by the mesh grids).
Rules:
- **Meshes** (spheres, shells, rings, ribbons, billboards, cuboid models of C32.4) are remapped **per vertex**.
- **Item models** (the decree weapons) cannot be remapped per vertex: each is drawn with one uniform scale `k = g(ρc) /
  ρc` about the eye, from its centre distance ρc (exact image, approximate depth). Its own decorations (rune rings,
  plasma sheath) use the same `k` (`StageFrame.cluster`). Camera keys keep ρc ≥ 1.6 × the model's radius.
- **Sky objects** (sun discs, corona, bright stars) are directions, drawn at 0.94 `R_d` (behind every mapped body, in
  front of the dome), so a planet or a palace in front hides them through the depth test.
- The dome at 0.97 `R_d` is behind everything.

Stage axes equal world axes (no rotation): a stage direction is a world direction, so FOV, roll, the HUD lens layers
and the flare projection all work unchanged.

#### 32.1.4 Render hook and frame (C32.3)

`EpicRenderer.collect` (F) calls `Kosmik3D.render(FRAME)` first when `Kosmik3D.wants()` (one boolean while idle).
`Kosmik3D` reads `CinematicDirector.stageBinding()`: the binding of the running shot, non-null only while a stage shot
runs and is not exiting. No binding → nothing is drawn, and a stage that was bound gets `end()`. So the stage can never
outlive the camera: a danger abort, a death, a disconnect, a skip or the next cut all drop it in the same frame.

Per frame: the binding gives the stage, the pocket C, `R_d`, the beat and the virtual eye (written by `FilmPath.evaluate`
or, for Penuh, from the shot progress) and the camera axes of `CameraRenderState`. The stage writes into the core's
sinks; the core submits them in this order: solid (dome first) and cutout; the item models (`ItemStackRenderState.submit`
with `LightCoordsUtil.FULL_BRIGHT`, `OverlayTexture.NO_OVERLAY`); translucent glow; additive (`collector.order(1)`).
Normals are written as +Y so the entity diffuse term is constant (`minecraft_mix_light` saturates for an up normal;
[verify in game, 32.10 item 1]);
shading is baked into vertex colours by the stage.

#### 32.1.5 Leaving a stage

A stage shot is only entered under a mask (or straight from a stage shot of the same stage) and only left under a mask:
the next shot's cut, or, when the act ends or is skipped on a stage shot, F raises the 2-tick black dip and calls
`CinematicDirector.abort()` (instant) once the dip covers ≥ 0.9; `CinematicDirector.skip()` on a stage shot does the
same instead of the 10-tick ease (an ease from C to the eye would show the world from the pocket). Danger aborts snap at
once as today. Nothing else needs restoring: the stage holds no camera, time, weather or world state.

#### 32.1.6 Shader packs (Iris) and Sodium

- The stage draws from `COLLECT_SUBMITS`, never in the shadow pass. The pocket is chosen in open air above the highest
  surface, so pack shadows on stage surfaces are rare.
- Pack profile (`ShaderCompat.packOn()`): × 0.6 quads (`EpicBudget`), one large additive layer fewer (atmosphere keeps
  one shell, no cloud shell, no night-light shell), no petals above Normal counts, the dome stays (black space or the sky
  gradient). `KosmikTypes.PACK_EMISSIVE_BODIES` (default false, [verify in game, 32.10 item 21]) switches planet and moon
  to `entityTranslucentEmissive` drawn far to near if a pack shades the solid planet badly.
- The dome writes depth at ≤ 12 b, so pack fog, volumetric clouds and sky passes see a near surface: they do not draw
  over space. Bloom and tone mapping act on our colours as on any emissive entity.
- Sodium: no chunk mesh is touched; the jump to C (≤ 48 b, inside render distance) is masked; nothing depends on chunk
  visibility because the dome covers the world.

#### 32.1.7 Motion caps of stage shots

The real camera does not translate, so the 24 / 48 b/s caps of 30.2.3 do not apply to the virtual eye. Instead:
- **flow cap**: the virtual path length per second ≤ 2.0 × the mean distance from the eye to the look target
  (Spektakuler) or ≤ 0.4 × (Kamera Penuh, the calm beats); `FilmPath.validate` shortens the path toward its first key as
  today;
- the look, whip and roll caps of 30.2.3 stay (≤ 12°/tick, whip ≤ 45°/tick with the smear, roll ≤ 20°, ≤ 3°/tick);
  Penuh beats ≤ 16°/s and ≤ 5° roll;
- no `bullet()` in a stage shot (the stage clock is the shot clock);
- **luminance**: every stage brightening that covers more than 20 % of the screen (a rune ignition, the cloud punch, a
  sunrise flare, the gate light) is one luminance event and keeps the 500 ms spacing of 23.x; ring crossings are soft
  rises (≤ +0.2 alpha over 6 ticks), never flashes. Impact frames are unchanged (they belong to the world shots).

### 32.2 The Orbit stage (module O)

**Units and layout.** Stage metres (sm). The planet centre is the origin, its axis +Y, radius `r_p` = 1000 sm, turning
0.02°/tick about +Y (clouds 0.03°/tick, deterministic from the shot clock). **Home** is the point under the caster: on
the meridian facing +Z at a latitude from the caster's biome (snowy 60° N, dry 22° N, jungle-like (foliage green and
warm) 6° N, otherwise 40° N); the default planet texture guarantees a continent with every climate band along that
meridian (latitude 0-70° N, longitude ±25°). The moon (radius 270 sm) stands at (−6000, 2500, −6500) sm; the sun is a
direction set per beat. Tingkat: the decree's anchors carry `fs = s(t)^0.35` (32.5.7); the planet does not scale.

#### 32.2.1 Meshes and shells (per quality after "Film kosmik 3D: Ringan" and the frame guard)

All spheres are UV spheres (rings × segments) built once per size into float arrays (unit position = normal, equirect
UV with the seam duplicated); each frame the CPU drops quads whose four corners face away from the eye (planet, moon,
shells) or lie outside the view cone (dome). "Drawn" counts are typical with half the body in view.

| Layer | Look | Render type | Minimal | Normal | Maximal |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Space dome | `space_<n>.png`: black, soft stars, the Milky Way band tilted 60° to the stage equator, faint nebula tints | `entitySolid` | 6 × 12 (72; ≈ 30 drawn) | 10 × 20 (200; ≈ 70) | 12 × 24 (288; ≈ 100) |
| Bright stars | 4-point twinkling billboards (`star_spike.png`), alpha-only twinkle (sine, seeded phase) | additive | 0 | 40 | 80 |
| Planet | the day map (baked, 32.2.2), per-vertex light: `day × (0.08 + 0.92 × max(0, n·sun)^0.8)` | `entitySolid` | 12 × 24 (288; ≈ 150) | 24 × 48 (1152; ≈ 600) | 32 × 64 (2048; ≈ 1050) |
| Night lights | `planet_night_<n>.png` speckles (villages along coasts and rivers), alpha `smoothstep(0.1, −0.15, n·sun)` | additive shell × 1.001 | – | same grid as the planet, only night quads (≈ 150) | ≈ 260 |
| Cloud shell | `clouds_<n>.png`, alpha × (0.15 + 0.85 × light), turning faster | `entityTranslucentEmissive` × 1.008 | – | 16 × 32 (≈ 270) | 24 × 48 (≈ 600) |
| Atmosphere shells | fresnel rim: alpha `a_i × (1 − abs(n·v))^p_i × (0.25 + 0.75 smoothstep(−0.3, 0.4, n·sun))`, colour day `7EC8FF` → terminator `FF9A5A` → night `2A3A8A`; shells × 1.015 / 1.03 / 1.05, `p` = 3 / 4 / 6, quads with all corners < 0.02 alpha skipped | additive | 1 limb billboard only | limb billboard + 2 shells 12 × 24 (≈ 120 each) | limb + 3 shells 16 × 32 (≈ 150 each) |
| Limb glow | one camera-facing annulus (`limb_glow.png`) at the planet centre, 1.15 `r_p`: the planet's own front hides its middle, so only the rim halo shows | additive | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Moon | `moon_<n>.png` craters, light `0.06 + 0.94 × max(0, n·sun)` | `entitySolid` | – | 10 × 20 (≈ 100) | 16 × 32 (≈ 256) |
| Sun | core (`sun_core.png`, 2 layers), corona (`sun_corona.png`, turning 0.05°/tick), the lens-flare light point | additive sky billboards | 2 | 3 | 4 |
| Local patch | around home, when the eye is within 1500 sm of it: a land detail decal (`patch_land_<n>.png`, tiled 4 ×, tinted by the home colours, radial alpha fade) 0.3 sm above the surface on a 6 × 12 polar grid, and 2 cloud-deck layers (`patch_cloud_<n>.png`) at +8 and +14 sm | `entityTranslucentEmissive` | decal only (72) | decal + 1 deck (144) | decal + 2 decks (216) |
| Props of the beats | 32.2.3 | item models + additive | ≤ 2 models, ≤ 40 quads | ≤ 8 models, ≤ 160 | ≤ 16 models, ≤ 320 |
| **Total drawn (estimate)** | | | **≤ 360** (pack ≤ 230: planet 10 × 20) | **≤ 1450** (pack ≤ 880: planet 20 × 40, one shell, no clouds) | **≤ 2950** (pack ≤ 1780) |

Each layer asks `EpicBudget.takeQuads(n)` in this priority order: dome, planet, sun, limb, props, moon, atmosphere,
clouds, night lights, local patch, bright stars; a refused layer is skipped for that frame (never half-drawn). The grid
size changes only at a shot start (no popping). Vertex count = 4 × quads; every grid is built once per session per
size; per frame the stage only writes floats into the reused sinks (no allocation).

#### 32.2.2 Textures (O, `tools/gen_kosmik_orbit.py`)

Run `python -I tools/gen_kosmik_orbit.py` (stdlib + `tools/png.py`, fixed seed). Noise is 3D value-noise fbm sampled on
the unit sphere, so every equirect map is seamless in longitude and not pinched at the poles; every map is generated at
its largest size and box-downsampled. `validate()` checks sizes, the seam (first and last column differ ≤ 2 per
channel), no magenta, glow textures fading to alpha 0 at the border, and prints the total size (must stay ≤ 8 MB). O
opens a sample of every output with Read. Output under `assets/kultivator/textures/misc/kosmik/orbit/`:

| File | Size | Content |
|---|---|---|
| `planet_day_256/512/1024.png` | 2:1 | the default albedo: deep → shallow ocean, beaches, plains, forest, taiga, savanna, desert belts at 15-30°, jungle near the equator, mountain ridges with slope darkening (no baked sun), ice caps above ±70°; land ≈ 30 % |
| `planet_class_256/512/1024.png` | 2:1 | R = climate class × 16 (0 deep ocean, 1 shallow, 2 beach, 3 plains, 4 forest, 5 taiga, 6 savanna, 7 desert, 8 jungle, 9 rock, 10 snow / ice), G = detail luminance, B = home weight (1 at home, smooth fall-off to 0 at 35° of arc), A = 255 |
| `planet_night_256/512.png` | 2:1 | warm city-light speckles on land (alpha = intensity), clustered near coasts and rivers |
| `clouds_256/512/1024.png` | 2:1 | white with alpha: fbm cover ≈ 45 %, three or four cyclone swirls, thin polar bands |
| `space_256/512/1024.png` | 2:1 | the dome: black, ≈ 1 star per 60 px as 2-3 px soft dots, the Milky Way band with dark lanes, faint violet and teal nebula tints |
| `moon_128/256.png` | 2:1 | grey regolith, maria, craters with rims and rays |
| `sun_core.png` 128, `sun_corona.png` 256, `limb_glow.png` 256, `star_spike.png` 128, `atmo.png` 32 | square | radial glows, streamers, soft annulus, diffraction cross, flat soft white (the shells' alpha is per vertex) |
| `plasma.png` 64 × 128, `trail.png` 128 × 32, `beam.png` 32 × 128, `star_line.png` 64 × 8 | | the re-entry sheath (white → orange → violet), the burning trail, the star beams, the Dipper lines |
| `rune_ring.png` 256 | square | a gold annulus of twelve of our own seal glyphs (abstract strokes, not real characters) |
| `patch_land_256/512.png`, `patch_cloud_256/512.png` | tileable | local land detail (fields, woods, rivers) and the cloud deck |
| `cell_top.png` 32, `cell_side.png` 32 × 64, `cell_bottom.png` 32 | | Gunung's lifted cells: grass top (white-ish, tinted by the home grass colour), soil and stone layers, roots underneath |

Quality → maps: Minimal 256, Normal 512, Maximal 1024 (planet day, class, clouds, space); "Ringan" one step down.

**Planet bake** (`PlanetBake`, runtime, overworld only): at film arm (or preview) O reads `planet_day_<n>` and
`planet_class_<n>` (`NativeImage.read` from the resource manager) and recolours them with the home colours of
`KosmikColors` (C32.2): per pixel `target = palette(class, colours) × (0.75 + 0.5 × G)` (grass classes from the sampled
grass and foliage colours, water classes from the sampled water colour darkened by depth, snow white, desert and rock
kept), `out = mix(day, target, 0.85 × B + (water ? 0.3 : 0))`. It runs in row slices on the client thread until 1.2 ms
per tick are spent (`System.nanoTime`), then uploads one `DynamicTexture` registered at
`kultivator:dynamic/kosmik_planet` (`TextureManager.register`, the previous one released). Until it is ready the static
day map is drawn. It is re-baked only when the sampled colours changed (hash), and released on disconnect and resource
reload. "Ringan" and Minimal skip the bake.

### 32.3 The Heaven stage (module H)

**Units and layout.** Stage metres, axes x east, y up, z north. The Southern Heaven Gate stands at the south end of the
court with its opening centre at (0, 30, 0), facing south (arrivals come from −z); the court runs north over white-jade
terraces at y = 0 to the Lingxiao Hall at z = +420. The palace islands float on a local cloud bank at y = −10. Below them
the **Nine Heavens** hang as nine glowing rings, ring 9 at y = −60 (radius 140) down to ring 1 at y = −420 (radius 520);
below them lies the great **sea of clouds** at y = −460, and through its gaps the dim mortal land at y = −2000.

waterfalls, petals.

#### 32.3.2 Textures and models (H, `tools/gen_kosmik_surga.py`)

Run `python -I tools/gen_kosmik_surga.py` (stdlib + `tools/png.py`). Writes `surga_atlas.png` (256: vermilion lacquer
with grain, gold trim, imperial and jade glazed tiles with ridges, white jade, dragon scales, *xiangyun* cloud relief,
gold door studs, the two plaques drawn as our own strokes, lantern paper, island rock, jade terrace, crystal, guard
armour), `sky_heaven_128/256/512.png`, `cloud_sea_256/512.png` (tileable), `cloud_puff.png` 128, `shaft.png` 64 × 256,
`petal.png` 128 × 32, `waterfall.png` 64 × 256, `nine_rings.png` 512 × 72, `gate_glow.png` 128, `land_below_256.png`
(tileable) under `assets/kultivator/textures/misc/kosmik/surga/`, and `assets/kultivator/kosmik/surga_models.json`
(format C32.4). `validate()`: every cuboid inside its model's box, every UV inside the atlas, no zero-size face, the
per-model cuboid counts of the table, the per-quality totals, seamless tiles, alpha borders. Read a sample of every
output.

#### 32.3.3 Anchors and beats (H)

Anchors (C32.6): `gerbang` (the opening centre; stage axes; scale 1), `pintu` (between the doors), `aula` (the hall's
front), `tiang` (the heavenly pillar's centre; stage axes; scale fs), `javelin`, `segel` (the jade seal; scale fs),
`cincin1`..`cincin9` (ring centres), `laut` (the cloud-sea surface under the gate), `lembah` (the land below).

| Beat | Choreography |
|---|---|
| `tiang_gerbang` | 0.05-0.35 the thrown javelin (`dinghai_pillar`, 6 × fs sm, ember trail) rises out of the cloud bank past the camera and strikes the bell tower (a soft gold glow at 0.35: one luminance event); 0.40-0.85 the doors swing open to 100° (ease out), the gate glow and the shafts rise through the opening, petals begin; the Four Heavenly Kings flank the stair |
| `tiang_lepas` | continues: at 0.1 the javelin's glow merges into the heavenly pillar (`dinghai_pillar`, 60 × fs sm) gliding out of the hall's light along the court axis (3 sm/tick); 0.55-0.75 at the terrace edge beyond the gate it turns vertical, its hoops ignite gold → ember; at 0.75 it is released |
| `tiang_jatuh` | the pillar falls from y −20 to the cloud sea (−460) with `EXPO_IN`, ember trail; each ring brightens softly as the tip passes its plane (tick ≈ 2, 5, 8, …); the cloud sea rushes up; F's cloud wipe closes over the last 5 ticks |
| `gunung_segel` | the jade seal (`yishan_seal`, 10 × fs sm) rises from the cloud sea to y −40 through the rings (each brightening), turning 90° slowly; the doors open to 40°; at 0.8 a gold beam descends from the gate onto it |
| `tiang_tenang` (Penuh) | the eye drifts toward the gate (140 → 120 sm); doors open 0.2-0.7; the pillar glides out and is released at 0.9 |
| `gunung_tenang` (Penuh) | the seal rises through the rings into the gate light; doors to 40° |
| `preview_a` / `_b` / `_c` | from the cloud sea up to the gate / across the court to the hall / looking down through the nine rings |

### 32.4 Film DSL additions (F)

| Addition | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `FilmSpace.V` | a point in the stage of the shot, in the frame of a stage anchor (`prop` = anchor name): origin, x right, y up, z forward, all × the anchor's scale |
| `FilmShot.stage(StageId, String beat)` | this shot is drawn in that stage and plays that beat; the real camera stands at the pocket |
| `keyV(t, anchor, x, y, z)`, `lookV(anchor, x, y, z)`, `lookEndV(anchor, x, y, z)`, `povV(anchor, back, up)`, `flareV(anchor, x, y, z)` | keys, look, POV and flare light point in V |
| `orElse(FilmShot fallback)` | the shot played when the stage refuses (setting Mati, no pocket, fog, budget −1, stage not ready); forced to the same length |

`FilmPath.evaluate` for a stage shot: the keys and looks resolve through `Kosmik3D.point(anchor, x, y, z, t, out)` at the
shot time t; `out[0..2]` = C; yaw and pitch from the virtual look direction; FOV, roll, whip, dolly and shake as today
(the shake rotates only); the virtual eye is published in the binding. `FilmPath.validate` applies the flow cap of
32.1.7 instead of the b/s caps. `FilmDirector.lightPoint` converts a V light point with the frame's mapping (C + drawn
offset) and passes null when `KosmikStage.occluded` says a body hides it.

Catalogue validator (F, at first build): a stage shot is preceded by a mask cut or by a stage shot of the same stage;
no `bullet()` on a stage shot; `orElse` exists; beat ids exist in the stage's `beats()` (checked when the stage is
created; a missing beat logs once and plays the fallback).

### 32.5 The films (F, `FilmCatalogTitah`)

Notation as 30.3 (C = arming tick, K = climax). **ORB** = Orbit stage, **SRG** = Heaven stage, **W** = world. Lens and
sound words as 30.2.7 / 30.2.12; every shot also has LB + VG; stage shots in space add `quiet(0.6)` (world categories
ducked, `hum_energy` low), never more than 3 film cues per beat. The fallback of each stage shot is the shot it replaced
(listed), so a refused stage gives exactly today's film.

#### 32.5.1 The climax contract (unchanged, restated)

- Each film is one pre-climax CAST act whose length is exactly K at Kecepatan 1, ending with a world shot that
  `holdForClimax()` (≤ 20 ticks), and one CLIMAX act starting on the server's climax event under the IMPACT mask.
- **Re-timing** (`retimeTitah`): a longer build-up starts the act later (the player's own camera before it); a shorter
  one shortens **stage shots first** (down to 10 ticks each, their beats compress because they are authored in shot
  fractions), then cosmic shots, then all shots proportionally (≥ 10 ticks).
- An **early climax** ends the running act at once, even in the middle of a stage shot: the climax act's IMPACT cut moves
  the camera from C to the impact and the binding drops in the same frame. A late climax holds the last world shot up to
  20 ticks; a climax that never comes drops the climax acts after 60 ticks (30.2.6).
- Titah limits of 29.16 stay: every shot ≤ 4 s, the whole film ≤ 12 s; hard cuts ≥ 10 ticks apart; total camera time
  ≤ 400 ticks. The KIND_ULTIMATE gap does not apply to Titah (as today).

#### 32.5.6 Kamera Penuh: the shorter version (F edits `PusakaFilm`)

When the Spektakuler film is refused (or the camera is Penuh), Film Pusaka plays as today, but its **F3 "Istana"**
(0.30 of the film, ≤ 72 ticks, already behind the first cloud wipe) becomes one calm stage beat when
`Kosmik3D.penuh(skill, ctx, f3)` returns a plan: Pedang `pedang_tenang` (ORB), Tiang `tiang_tenang` (SRG), Bintang
`bintang_tenang` (ORB), Gunung `gunung_tenang` (SRG). The plan gives the pocket C (≤ 24 b above the caster, `R_d` 8 b)
and the look directions; F3 is one `Shots.pusakaFilm(C, C, look0, look1, f3)` segment carrying the stage binding (the
virtual eye follows the shot's eased progress). Penuh caps hold: no translation, ≤ 16°/s, roll ≤ 5°, flow ≤ 0.4 ×
distance per second. The Vistas of F3 are not spawned; the jade title card shows as today. The second cloud wipe ends it;
a skip in F3 dips and cuts to the eye (32.1.5). A refused plan leaves F3 exactly as today. Kamera Singkat and Mati never
show a stage.

#### 32.5.7 Tingkat Titah (29.16) in the stages

`fs = s(t)^0.35` (1.0 at tier 1, 1.18 at 2, 1.39 at 3, 1.64 at 4, 1.93 at 5, 2.28 at 6, 2.68 at 7, 3.16 at 8, 3.73 at
9). The decree props scale by `fs` (sword, pillar, seal, javelin), the Dipper by `fs^0.5`, the cells by `fs^0.7`; the
anchors `sword`, `beam`, `home`, `tiang`, `segel`, `javelin`, `dipper`, `cells` carry that scale, so every `keyV` in
their frames frames the bigger weapon without new numbers. Rune rings: +1 from tier 5, +1 from tier 8. The planet,
the moon and the palace never scale: a tier-9 sword is a quarter of the planet's radius, a tier-9 pillar towers over
the gate. Timing does not change with the tier (29.16.1).

### 32.6 Settings (F)

- New row **"Film kosmik 3D: %s"** right after "Langit kosmik" in the Momen Epik group (`EpicSettings`, key
  `epic_kosmik3d`, values `penuh` (default) / `ringan` / `mati`; shown only when its lang key exists, like the other film
  rows). Tooltip (id): "Saat film Titah, kamera masuk ke panggung 3D: planet dunia ini dilihat dari angkasa, bulan,
  matahari, dan Istana Langit. Ringan: lapisan lebih sedikit dan tekstur lebih kecil. Mati: kembali ke Langit Kosmik
  biasa. Hanya kamu yang melihatnya."
- **Penuh**: the layers of the current quality tier. **Ringan**: one tier lower (Minimal stays Minimal), every map one
  size smaller, no planet bake, petals and guards halved. **Mati**: every stage shot plays its fallback.
- Independent of "Langit kosmik" (which only affects the fallbacks and the other films). Kamera Singkat / Mati, "Kurangi
  gerak", "Perjalanan langit: Mati" and the per-decree Film choice keep their meaning (30.2.1, 29.4).
- The stage tier = `EpicBudget.tier()` lowered by Ringan, read at each stage shot start; −1 → fallback.

| `/sinematik kosmik3d surga [detik] [tingkat]` | the same for the Heaven stage; also prints the stage name and its Sumber lines |

| `/sinematik pusaka film <skill> [detik] [tingkat]` | (exists) the Penuh version with its F3 stage beat |

### 32.8 Verified 26.3 API (mcsrc, new uses)

`RenderTypes.entitySolid(Identifier)`, `entityCutout(Identifier)`, `entityTranslucentEmissive(Identifier)`,
`energySwirl(Identifier, float, float)` (pipeline `ENERGY_SWIRL`: `BlendFunction.ADDITIVE`, depth `DEFAULT`, no cull,
`NO_CARDINAL_LIGHTING`); `SubmitNodeCollection.submitCustomGeometry` (blending → translucent phase, else solid);
`LevelRenderer.executeClassicTransparency` / `executeOit` order; `Camera.PROJECTION_Z_NEAR` (0.05);
`DepthStencilState.DEFAULT` (`GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL`, write); `Minecraft.getItemModelResolver()`,
`ItemModelResolver.updateForTopItem(ItemStackRenderState, ItemStack, ItemDisplayContext, Level, ItemOwner, int)`,
`ItemStackRenderState.submit(PoseStack, SubmitNodeCollector, int, int, int)`; `DynamicTexture(Supplier<String>,
NativeImage)`, `DynamicTexture.upload()`, `TextureManager.register(Identifier, AbstractTexture)` / `release(Identifier)`,
`NativeImage(int, int, boolean)`, `NativeImage.read(InputStream)`, `getPixel` / `setPixel` (ARGB);
`BiomeColors.getAverageGrassColor` / `getAverageFoliageColor` / `getAverageWaterColor(BlockAndTintGetter, BlockPos)`,
`Biome.coldEnoughToSnow(BlockPos, int)`, `Biome.hasPrecipitation()`, `LevelReader.getBiome(BlockPos)`;
`Level.getHeight(Heightmap.Types.WORLD_SURFACE, x, z)`, `LevelReader.hasChunkAt(BlockPos)`,
`LevelHeightAccessor.getMaxY()`; `LivingEntity.hasEffect(Holder<MobEffect>)`, `MobEffects.BLINDNESS`, `DARKNESS`;
`EntityRenderer.extractNameTags(T, S, float, double, double)` (protected final; mixin TAIL),
`EntityRenderState.nameTag` / `scoreText` (public). Fabric: `LevelRenderEvents.COLLECT_SUBMITS` (in use),
`ClientPlayConnectionEvents.DISCONNECT` (in use by `TitahWorld`).

### 32.9 Modules (exactly three, disjoint files) and contracts

**Order of work.** F first commits the core API of C32.1-C32.5 as compiling skeletons (the records, the interface,
`StageFrame` and `KosmikMesh` signatures, `Kosmik3D` calling `OrbitStage.create()` and `SurgaStage.create()`); O and H
commit their `create()` skeletons next (a stub stage whose `ready()` is false, so every stage shot plays its fallback),
then all three work in parallel. A single compile step runs after all three (rule 0.6). Nobody edits another module's
file. Every generated texture is opened with Read once; every new Minecraft or Fabric API use is checked in
`butterbot-fabric/reference/mcsrc` and listed in the module's report.

#### O: the Orbit stage

Owns: `src/client/java/dev/kultivator/client/epic/kosmik/orbit/**` (`OrbitStage` with `public static KosmikStage
create()`, the planet, `PlanetBake`, moon, sun, dome, atmosphere, clouds, local patch, props, beats and anchors of 32.2),
`tools/gen_kosmik_orbit.py` (new), `assets/kultivator/textures/misc/kosmik/orbit/**`, and
`lang-src/kosmik_orbit.{en_us,id_id}.json` (`kultivator.kosmik.orbit.name`, `.source` = "Sumber: rancangan permainan
