#### C32.1 Stage interface (F defines, O and H implement; `dev.kultivator.client.epic.kosmik`)

```java
public interface KosmikStage {
    Kosmik3D.StageId id();                                  // ORBIT or SURGA
    void prepare(StageContext ctx);                         // at film arm / preview: build meshes (once), start any bake; ≤ 4 ms; never throws
    boolean ready();                                        // meshes built (a bake may still run: the static map is used meanwhile)
    List<String> beats();                                   // the beat ids of 32.2.3 / 32.3.3
    void beat(String beat, StageContext ctx, int ticks, boolean continued); // a shot of this beat starts (continued: from this stage's previous shot)
    boolean anchor(String name, double t, StageAnchor out); // the anchor at shot time t (ticks, fractional); false = unknown
    boolean occluded(double px, double py, double pz, double ex, double ey, double ez); // a body hides P from the eye (flare)
    void render(StageFrame frame);                          // every frame while bound
    void end();                                             // the binding ended (cut, skip, abort, death, disconnect)
    void release();                                         // disconnect / resource reload: free dynamic textures and caches
    List<String> info();                                    // lines for /sinematik kosmik3d info
}
public final class Kosmik3D {
    public enum StageId { ORBIT, SURGA }
    public static void init();                               // creates nothing; registers the disconnect release
    public static boolean wants();                           // one boolean while idle (EpicRenderer)
    public static boolean covering();                        // a stage is drawn this frame (name-tag mixin, EpicRenderer)
    public static void prepare(StageId id, StageContext ctx);// from FilmDirector.arm / PusakaFilm / the preview
    public static @Nullable Binding enter(StageId id, String beat, StageContext ctx, int ticks, boolean penuh); // pocket + gates; null = fallback
    public static boolean point(Binding b, String anchor, double x, double y, double z, double t, double[] out);
    public static @Nullable PenuhPlan penuh(int skill, StageContext ctx, int ticks);
    public static void render(EpicRenderer.Frame frame);
    public static void clear();                              // from FilmDirector.clear
    public static List<String> info();
    public record PenuhPlan(Binding binding, Vec3 c, Vec3 look0, Vec3 look1) {}
    public static final class Binding { /* stage, beat, C, R_d, eye[3] (written by FilmPath / CinematicDirector), shot time, scale map */ }
}
```

#### C32.2 Context and colours (F)

`public record StageContext(int skill /* 0-3, −1 preview */, int tier /* 1-9 */, float s, float fs, int rgb, long seed,
int quality /* 0-2 after Ringan and the guard */, boolean ringan, boolean pack, boolean calm /* Kamera Penuh */,
KosmikColors colors)`.
`public record KosmikColors(int grass, int foliage, int water, boolean snowy, boolean dry, boolean overworld)`: sampled
once at arm by `KosmikColors.sample(ClientLevel, BlockPos)` (the average of 9 `BiomeColors` samples, the caster's and 8
on a 48-b ring; `snowy` = `coldEnoughToSnow` at the caster, `dry` = `!hasPrecipitation()`).
`public final class StageAnchor { public double x, y, z, fx, fy, fz, ux, uy, uz, scale; public void place(double lx,
double ly, double lz, double[] out); }` (right = forward × up; mutable and reused, no per-frame allocation).

#### C32.3 Frame (F)

```java
public final class StageFrame {
    public double ex, ey, ez;                 // the virtual eye (sm)
    public final Vector3f right, up, forward; // camera axes (stage axes = world axes)
    public double time;                       // shot time (ticks, fractional; held by hit-stop)
    public float shotT;                       // 0..1 of the shot
    public int quality; public boolean pack; public float domeRadius; public float fovDeg;
    public void map(double x, double y, double z, float[] out);                        // stage point → drawn camera-relative (32.1.3)
    public float cluster(double cx, double cy, double cz, float[] centreOut);           // uniform k of a compact cluster
    public EpicRenderer.Sink solid(Identifier tex);   // entitySolid, created once per texture
    public EpicRenderer.Sink cutout(Identifier tex);  // entityCutout
    public EpicRenderer.Sink glow(Identifier tex);    // entityTranslucentEmissive
    public EpicRenderer.Sink add(Identifier tex);     // energySwirl(tex, 0, 0), submitted with order(1)
    public void vertex(EpicRenderer.Sink s, double x, double y, double z, float u, float v, int argb); // mapped, normal +Y
    public void billboard(EpicRenderer.Sink s, double x, double y, double z, double half, float rollRad, int argb);
    public void skyBillboard(EpicRenderer.Sink s, float dx, float dy, float dz, float angularHalf, float rollRad, int argb); // at 0.94 R_d
    public void ribbon(EpicRenderer.Sink s, double[] xyz, int n, double w0, double w1, int c0, int c1, float uOffset);
    public void dome(Identifier tex, float uTurn);                                    // the backdrop, first, CPU view-culled
    public int sphere(EpicRenderer.Sink s, KosmikMesh.Sphere m, double cx, double cy, double cz, double r,
                      float spinRad, boolean inside, KosmikMesh.Shade shade);         // CPU back-face cull; returns quads written
    public int model(KosmikMesh.Model m, String part, double x, double y, double z, Quaternionf rot, double scale,
                     int tint, float light);                                          // cuboid stage model (C32.4)
    public void item(String modelId, double x, double y, double z, Quaternionf rot, double scale); // ModelFx item model, uniform k
    public boolean take(int quads);                                                   // EpicBudget.takeQuads
    public boolean large();                                                           // EpicBudget.takeLarge
}
```

#### C32.4 Meshes (F, `KosmikMesh`)

- `Sphere sphere(int rings, int segments)`: cached per size; unit positions (= normals) and equirect UVs.
- `interface Shade { int argb(double nx, double ny, double nz, float u, float v); }` implemented by stage objects (no
  per-frame lambdas).
- `Model load(Identifier json)`: cached per resource reload; a parse error logs once and returns an empty model. JSON:
  `{"atlas": "<texture id>", "atlasSize": 256, "models": {"<id>": {"parts": {"<part>": {"pivot": [x,y,z], "cuboids":
  [{"from": [x,y,z], "to": [x,y,z], "rot": {"axis": "x|y|z", "angle": deg, "origin": [x,y,z]}, "faces": {"north|south|
  east|west|up|down": [u0,v0,u1,v1]}, "lod": 0|1|2, "glow": false, "tint": "RRGGBB"}]}}}}}`, coordinates in stage metres,
  angles any value (single axis), UVs in atlas pixels, omitted faces not drawn; `glow` faces go to the additive sink.
  `StageFrame.model` rotates a part about its pivot (doors) and counts its quads.

#### C32.5 Film and camera hooks (F only; listed so O and H know the names)

`FilmSpace.V`; `FilmShot.stage / keyV / lookV / lookEndV / povV / flareV / orElse` (32.4); `CinematicDirector
.stageBinding()` (non-null only while a stage shot runs and is not exiting); `Shots.Shot.stage(Kosmik3D.Binding)`;
`FilmDirector`: prepare at arm (`Kosmik3D.prepare` for the stages a film uses), `enter` at each stage shot start (else
`orElse`), the dip + abort exit (32.1.5), stage shots first in `retimeTitah`.

#### C32.6 Beat and anchor names (O and H implement exactly these)

- Orbit beats: `pedang_hadir`, `pedang_menukik`, `pedang_masuk`, `bintang_biduk`, `bintang_sinar`, `gunung_sel`,
  `pedang_tenang`, `bintang_tenang`, `preview_a`, `preview_b`, `preview_c`. Anchors: `planet`, `home`, `sword`, `beam`,
  `moon`, `sun`, `dipper`, `core1`..`core7`, `cells`.
- Heaven beats: `tiang_gerbang`, `tiang_lepas`, `tiang_jatuh`, `gunung_segel`, `tiang_tenang`, `gunung_tenang`,
  `preview_a`, `preview_b`, `preview_c`. Anchors: `gerbang`, `pintu`, `aula`, `tiang`, `javelin`, `segel`,
  `cincin1`..`cincin9`, `laut`, `lembah`.
- An unknown anchor resolves to the stage origin (logged once); an unknown beat plays the fallback.

#### C32.7 Budgets (all modules)

The stage's quads count in `EpicBudget` (the tables of 32.2.1 and 32.3.1 are the caps per quality, pack × 0.6), its CPU
time in `EpicBudget.addCpu` (the frame guard lowers the stage tier at the next shot start), item models ≤ 2 / 8 / 16,
the planet bake ≤ 1.2 ms per tick, `prepare` ≤ 4 ms once. Animation is deterministic (seeded hashes, shot time); size
only ever changes along an authored path (rings igniting, a growing shock ring), never by random pulsing; glows breathe
by alpha. No allocation per frame in the draw paths.

### 32.10 Daftar uji (untuk `docs/uji/FASE-32.md`)

**Dasar (Kamera Spektakuler, "Film kosmik 3D: Penuh", kualitas Normal)**
1. `/sinematik kosmik3d orbit`: layar masuk ke angkasa lewat celup hitam; terlihat planet 3D bulat dengan laut, benua,
   es kutub, awan yang berputar sedikit lebih cepat, cahaya tepi atmosfer, sisi malam dengan titik lampu kota, bulan
   berkawah, matahari dengan korona, bintang dan pita Bima Sakti. Tidak ada tepi chunk, langit vanilla, awan vanilla,
   hujan atau air yang menembus.
2. Biome warna: uji di hutan, gurun dan salju. Daratan di sekitar "rumah" di planet mengikuti warna rumput dan air biome
   setempat (setelah ±0,5 detik pemanggangan); di Nether/End planet memakai warna bawaan.
3. `/sinematik kosmik3d surga`: Gerbang Langit Selatan dengan empat pilar berbelit naga, atap tiga lapis, Istana
   Lingxiao, jembatan giok, pulau melayang, laut awan bergerak, sinar emas, kelopak berjatuhan, sembilan cincin langit di
   bawah istana. Baris nama dan Sumber tercetak di chat.
4. `/sinematik film titah_pedang`: pedang tampak di angkasa di atas planet, cincin rune menyala satu per satu, matahari
   terbit di tepi planet, pedang berbalik lalu menukik; tembakan dari orbit menunjukkan jejak api dan selubung plasma
   menembus atmosfer dan dek awan; lalu potongan awan ke tunggangan POV dan langit terbelah; dampak tepat pada klimaks.
5. `/sinematik film titah_tiang`: film dibuka di Surga; lembing api naik dari awan, gerbang terbuka, Tiang langit keluar
   dari istana dan dilepas, jatuh melewati sembilan cincin dan laut awan, lalu potongan ke dunia nyata sampai dampak.
6. `/sinematik film titah_bintang`: tujuh inti bintang Biduk Utara menyala berurutan di angkasa di atas sisi malam
   planet, garisnya tergambar, lalu tujuh sinar menembus atmosfer; montase bintang jatuh dan klimaks tetap seperti biasa.
7. `/sinematik film titah_gunung`: segel giok naik melewati cincin ke gerbang surga; setelah dampak, potongan ke orbit
   menunjukkan sel-sel tanah terangkat melayang di depan planet; jenderal yang terangkat tetap terbanting tepat waktunya.

**Waktu dan klimaks**
8. Pakai segel sungguhan (bukan perintah uji) pada Kecepatan 1, 2 dan 0,5: dampak selalu terjadi tepat saat server
   memukul; pada Kecepatan cepat tembakan panggung memendek dulu (tetap ≥ 0,5 detik), pada Kecepatan lambat film mulai
   lebih lambat (kamera sendiri dulu).
9. Klimaks datang lebih awal saat masih di panggung: langsung potong ke dampak di bawah bingkai dampak, panggung hilang di
   bingkai yang sama.
10. Tingkat 1, 5 dan 9 (`/sinematik kosmik3d orbit 8 9`, `/sinematik film titah_pedang` setelah atur Tingkat): pedang,
    tiang dan segel makin besar dan kamera ikut menjauh; planet dan istana tetap; cincin rune bertambah di tingkat 5 dan 8.

**Keamanan kamera**
11. Tekan Backspace di tengah tembakan panggung: celup hitam singkat lalu kembali ke mata (tanpa melayang dari udara).
    Tekan dua kali: seluruh film berhenti.
12. Gerakkan kunci gerak / mouse besar di panggung: tembakan berakhir dengan aman, kamera kembali normal.
13. Dipukul mob saat di panggung, atau jatuh / masuk air / terbakar: kamera langsung kembali, panggung hilang seketika;
    tidak ada FOV, roll atau posisi kamera yang tertinggal.
14. Mati di tengah film, keluar dunia, pindah dimensi: kembali normal; masuk lagi tidak ada sisa panggung.
15. Ada musuh dalam 24 blok, darah < 50 %, atau di dalam gua sempit / di bawah atap rendah: babak atau tembakan panggung
    tidak main (cadangan Langit Kosmik lama atau kamera sendiri), film tidak pernah menunggu.
16. Kebutaan / Kegelapan, kabut tebal (Nether) atau jarak render sangat kecil: panggung diganti cadangan.

**Pengaturan**
17. "Film kosmik 3D: Ringan": lapisan lebih sedikit, tekstur lebih kecil, tanpa pemanggangan biome; "Mati": film persis
    seperti sebelum fase ini (Langit Kosmik 2D).
18. Kamera Penuh: Film Pusaka tetap, tetapi bagian "Istana" kini panggung 3D tenang (pedang di atas planet / gerbang
    surga terbuka / Biduk menyala / segel naik), pelan, tanpa sapuan. Singkat dan Mati: tidak ada panggung.
19. "Kurangi gerak": tidak ada Spektakuler; "Perjalanan langit: Mati" dan pilihan Film per titah tetap berlaku.
20. Nama pemain lain di dekat titik kamera tidak melayang di angkasa saat panggung tampil, dan kembali normal setelahnya.

**Performa dan kompatibilitas (laptop lemah, Minimal/Otomatis, jarak render 8)**
21. Sodium + Iris dengan paket shader: dome menutupi dunia, tidak ada awan/kabut paket di depan angkasa, planet tidak
    berbayang aneh (jika aneh, catat untuk `PACK_EMISSIVE_BODIES`); jumlah lapisan berkurang sesuai profil paket.
22. Minimal: planet, dome, matahari dan cahaya tepi saja; FPS tidak turun di bawah 30 lebih dari sesaat; penjaga bingkai
    menurunkan panggung di tembakan berikutnya tanpa kedip.
23. `/sinematik kosmik3d info` menunjukkan quad dan ms per bingkai di bawah anggaran; tanpa film, biaya nol.
24. Tidak ada blok berubah, tidak ada petir vanilla, cuaca, waktu atau kecepatan tick yang berubah; pemain lain tidak
    melihat panggung (hanya kamera sendiri).
25. Suara: angkasa sepi (dengung rendah), gong/lonceng/whoosh sesuai daftar, suara "langit" berbahasa Jepang dari server
    tetap terdengar dan tidak dobel.
26. Teks: setiap kunci `kosmik*` ada di en_us dan id_id; semua Sumber lama tetap sama; semua tekstur tampak benar (tanpa
    ungu-hitam), tepi cahaya lembut; model istana rapi dari segala arah, tidak ada wajah hilang atau berkedip.

## 33. UI/UX Terpadu

User request (2026-10-21, Indonesian, binding): the GUI and the keys are hard to use; make every feature easy to reach,
remove what is duplicated or not needed. Follow-up (binding): every frequently used key must be easy to reach from the
left hand on WASD, never far keys such as `;` `'` `-` `,` `.` `\` or the numpad.

### 33.0 Scope and what stays (binding)

- UI and key layout only. No gameplay or balance change, no new block change, no new heavy rendering (the hub and the
  Akses Cepat wheel are GUI fills and the existing jade widgets), no post chains. Every Sumber line, every number and
  the block-safety rules of 22/23/30 stay. The 7b camera rules stay (the wheel and the hub never open while a film shot
  runs; WASD still skips a shot, 23.7.4).
- Every feature stays reachable, and every `/kultivasi ...` command keeps working (commands are not UI, but no UI path
  may need a typed command).
- Stored values stay: every row of `config/kultivator-client.json` keeps its key and meaning; saved key bindings the
  player changed stay (33.4.3).
- Lang only in `lang-src/<fragment>.en_us.json` + `.id_id.json` with identical keys (the `mergeLang` task fails on a
  key defined twice, so every new key lives in exactly one fragment: 33.9).
- Server code never references client classes. ItemStacks lazily. Keep each file's line endings.

### 33.1 Facts from the code (audit, 2026-10-21)

Vanilla 26.3 key defaults (mcsrc `Options`; `InputConstants` now uses USB/SDL scancodes: `KEY_A = 4` ... `KEY_Z = 29`,
`KEY_1 = 30`): W A S D move, Space jump, Left Shift sneak, Left Ctrl sprint, **E** inventory, **F** swap offhand,
**Q** drop, **T** chat, **Tab** player list, **/** command, **O** friends (new), **P** social interactions, **L**
advancements, **G** quick actions (new: `keyQuickActions`, opens the server's `quick_actions` dialog, does nothing when
the server defines none), **C / X** creative hotbar save / load activators, 1-9 hotbar, F1 hide GUI, F2 screenshot, F3
debug (+ letters A B C D G H I L N P T V and 1-4, only while F3 is held), F4 spectator shader, F5 perspective, F11
fullscreen; mouse left attack, right use, middle pick. Mouse buttons are 1-based (`MOUSE_BUTTON_4 = 4`, `_5 = 5`) and a
`KeyMapping` may use `InputConstants.Type.MOUSE`.

`KeyBindsList.refreshEntry` marks a duplicate only when at least one of the two mappings is **not** at its default, so
two default bindings on one key never show red; and `Options` saves **every** mapping to `options.txt`
(`key_<name>:<key>`), so a changed default never reaches a player who already launched once (33.4.3 migrates).

Installed mods (`%APPDATA%/.minecraft/versions/SODIUM/mods`, read from the jars' `Keybindings` / `Iris` classes):
Combat Roll **R** (roll, movement category); Iris **R** (reload, used with F3), **K** (toggle shaders), **I** (shader
pack screen), wireframe unbound; Better Combat feint and toggle-mine unbound; Sodium, Player Animation Library, EMF/ETF,
Dynamic FPS, ImmediatelyFast, Chunky, tl skin cape: no default keys.

### 33.2 Problems found

Duplicates (the same thing in two places):
1. Help: the scroll's Bantuan tab (≈ 75 topics), the codex's Bantuan tablet (4 of those same topics: `teknik`,
   `penguasaan`, `kitab_teknik`, `kehancuran_diri`) and the Kitab Panduan (a third, step-by-step help). Two key lists.
2. Desa: the Dunia screen's Desa tab is a read-only copy of the hall's Desa tablet ("the full cards with their actions
   live on the hall's Desa tablet").
3. "Sembunyikan panduan": the Jalan tab coin and the Pengaturan coin.
4. The Uji Akar talisman: on Status and on Akar & Dao, identical behaviour.
5. Next raid: Dunia › Musuh repeats the first block of Sekte › Pertahanan.
6. Opening behaviour: `'` and the 8th tablet open different kinds of things with the same jade look (a tab vs. a
   separate screen); the codex opens from `-`, from three talismans and from inside the scroll, and Esc in a screen
   opened from the scroll closes everything instead of going back.

Confusing:
7. Three "cincin / roda" names: Cincin Segel (the loadout), Roda Segel (the wheel), Cincin (the storage ring).
8. Two "Kehancuran" pages with a Pulihkan talisman each: the codex's Mode Kehancuran (the player's own) and the hall's
   Segel Merah (disciples' Destroyer arts). Different subjects, the same words.
9. The hall's 13 tablets scroll (at 240 px tall about 6 fit); related pages are far apart (Calon / Jenjang, Tugas / Misi /
   Arena, Pertahanan / Desa).
10. Lang texts with hard-coded keys ("Tekan ' (apostrof)", "tekan ; (titik koma)", "Tekan -", "tahan '" in `guide.*`),
    wrong as soon as a key is rebound.
11. Locked or far features fail silently or are invisible: Dunia, Keabadian, Titah and Cincin have no button; the Aula
    has no path except walking to the stele.

Dead UI: no button whose `enabledWhen` can never be true was found. The dead ends are the unbound keys with no button
(`dunia`, `abadi`, `cincin`, `guide`, `wheel`, `seal_1..4`) and the 8th tablet as the only button to the Kitab Panduan.

### 33.3 The hub (Gulungan Kultivasi = the one way in)

The jade scroll `CultivationScreen` becomes the hub. Left edge: **8 jade tablets**, one per section, in play order;
number keys **1-8** switch section; the header line shows the section's **sub-coins** (a row of small jade coins drawn in
the header strip, so the content area keeps its size); `Tab` / `Shift+Tab` step through the sub-coins; a "?" seal at the
right end of the header opens Panduan › Ensiklopedia on the page's topic.

| # | section | sub-coins / cards | opens | locked state (from synced client data only) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Diri** | Status · Akar & Dao · Jalan · Alkimia | the existing `StatusPage`, `RootDaoPage`, `JalanPage`, `AlchemyBookPage` | never |
| 2 | **Teknik** | launcher card (`TechniquesPage`) | Kitab Teknik on Kodeks / Rangkai Segel / Kehancuran Diri | never |
| 3 | **Murid** | card "Murid terdekat" + key hint | `DISCIPLE_OPEN -1` (the server answers as for M) | never (the server says when none is near) |
| 4 | **Sekte** | cards: Aula, Bangun, Formasi, Anggota, Perbendaharaan, Kegiatan, Wilayah, Segel Merah Murid | `HubNav.openHall(page)` (new own-hall op, C33.N4) on that tablet | no own hall in `HallClient.info()` after a refresh: one card "Dirikan sekte: rakit dan letakkan Prasasti Sekte" (links the help topic with the recipe) and the other cards greyed "butuh Prasasti Sekte" |
| 5 | **Dunia** | cards: Alam Rahasia, Pusaka, Musuh, Cincin | `DuniaScreen` tab 0 / 1 / 2; Cincin = `TEMPA "ring:open"` | Alam Rahasia greyed "terbuka di Pemurnian Qi" while the realm is Mortal (`RealmSpecs`: the first gate is Qi Refining); the pages explain their other locks themselves |
| 6 | **Keabadian** | cards: Alam Abadi, Purba, Bencana, Batin, Ciptaan, Lelang, Titah Langit | `KeabadianScreen` tab 0-5; Titah = the new `TITAH` open op | Alam Abadi always (it explains the ascent); the next five greyed "terbuka setelah naik ke Alam Abadi" until the phase-9 ascended flag is true (the `ascended` of the Batin sync; not `CultivationData.ascended()`, which is the phase-5 Ascension; verify the accessor); Titah greyed "terbuka di Dewa Abadi Sejati" below True Immortal, "butuh Segel Titah Langit di tas" without the player's seal in the inventory |
| 7 | **Panduan** | Kitab Panduan (talisman: the step book) · Ensiklopedia (`HelpPage`, now with a topic index) | `GuideClient.open(hub)`; `HelpPage` | never |
| 8 | **Pengaturan** | Tampilan & Efek · Kamera & Film · Suara · HUD · Kontrol | `SettingsPage` (module G, 33.5) | never |

A greyed card is drawn at 45 % ink with a small lock seal; hovering shows the lock line; clicking it plays the tablet
"thock" and shows the lock line under the card for 2 s (never a silent no-op). The hub never duplicates a server gate it
cannot see: anything not listed above opens, and the page itself explains.

Legacy tab ids stay valid (`CultivationScreen(int tab)` and `OpenScreen.INFO` args): 0 → Diri/Status, 1 → Diri/Akar &
Dao, 2 → Teknik, 3 → Pengaturan, 4 → Panduan/Ensiklopedia, 5 → Diri/Jalan, 6 → Diri/Alkimia. The hub remembers the last
section and sub-coin for the session (a plain static, no file).

Layout: at 320 × 240 the 8 tablets are 24 px tall with glyph and a one-word name; below 230 px of paper the tablets show
the glyph only (≥ 18 px) and the name moves to the tooltip, which always also names the number key. Sub-coins shrink
their text to ≥ 0.6 scale and, when they still do not fit, show the first 4 letters with the full name in the tooltip.
No text below 0.6 scale; nothing drawn over other text (header title, coins and "?" each get their own box).

#### 33.3.1 Akses Cepat (the radial)

One key, **V**: a **tap** (< 250 ms) opens the hub on the last section; **holding** V opens the Akses Cepat wheel around
the crosshair (HUD only, like the Roda Segel: the mouse moves a virtual pointer, WASD keeps working, releasing V on a
slice chooses, releasing in the centre opens the hub, right click or Esc cancels, 1-8 choose a slice directly). Eight
slices, clockwise from the top:

1 Meditasi · 2 Pedang Terbang · 3 Kitab Teknik · 4 Murid · 5 Cincin · 6 Dunia · 7 Keabadian · 8 Kitab Panduan.

Slices 6 and 7 open the hub on the Dunia / Keabadian section (the cards show what is open). The Akses Cepat wheel and the
Roda Segel are never open together (opening one closes the other). Neither opens while a film shot runs, while a screen
is open, or while the tribulation HUD is live (danger). Holding V also peeks the guide tracker (the role `'` had).

### 33.4 Keys

#### 33.4.1 New default table

| key | id | does | old default |
|---|---|---|---|
| **G** | `cast` | tap: cast; hold: Roda Segel | G (kept) |
| **V** | `quick` (new) | tap: hub; hold: Akses Cepat wheel | — |
| **Z** | `next` | next seal of the loadout (carousel) | `.` |
| **B** | `meditate` | meditate on/off (also on the wheel) | `;` |
| **H** | `flying_sword` | flying sword on/off (also on the wheel) | `\` |
| M | `murid` | disciple scroll (kept; also on the wheel and in the hub) | M |
| Backspace | `skip_scene` | skip a shot (WASD, jump, attack ... also skip it, 23.7.4) | Backspace (kept) |
| unbound | `info` | the hub without the wheel (for players who want a plain toggle) | `'` |
| unbound | `previous` | previous seal (the Roda Segel picks directly; a mouse side button is a good choice) | `,` |
| unbound | `codex` | Kitab Teknik (wheel slice 3, hub section 2) | `-` |
| unbound | `wheel`, `seal_1..4`, `dunia`, `abadi`, `cincin`, `guide` | unchanged (all reachable from V and the hub) | unbound |

Core layout: **G, V, Z** (three keys beside WASD) reach everything; B and H are one-tap shortcuts for the two toggles
players use most. Checked against 33.1: Z, V, B, H are free in vanilla (apart from the F3 debug combos F3+V, F3+B, F3+H,
which then also press our key, harmless), in Combat Roll, Iris and Better Combat. Not used on purpose: R (Combat Roll,
Iris), Q E F T Tab (vanilla), X C (creative hotbar activators), K I (Iris), O P L (vanilla), Caps Lock (toggles the OS
state and capitalises chat). G stays as the user asked; vanilla's `key.quickActions` is also G and only acts on a server
that defines a quick-actions dialog (then both fire; the Kontrol group says so and links to the controls screen). Two
defaults on G never show red (the `KeyBindsList` rule above).

Key name (lang `hub.*`): `key.kultivator.quick` "Akses Cepat (ketuk: Gulungan, tahan: roda)" / "Quick Access (tap:
scroll, hold: wheel)". The other names stay. All keys stay in the "Kultivator" category.

#### 33.4.2 Keys inside screens (one rule set)

- **Esc** closes the top overlay first (search, slip, confirm), then: in the hub, closes it; in a screen opened from the
  hub, returns to the hub on the section it came from; in a screen opened from the world, closes it.
- **V** (the `quick` key) closes the hub and any screen opened from it in one press; the `info` key (if bound) does the
  same. A screen's own toggle key (`codex`, `dunia`, `abadi`, `guide`, M) still closes that screen (M inside the disciple
  scroll still means "next disciple").
- **1-8** in the hub: sections (inside Dunia, Keabadian and the disciple scroll the number keys keep switching their own
  tabs, as today).
- **Tab / Shift+Tab**: the sub-coins of the hub section.
- Every icon (tablet, coin, card, slice, "?") has a tooltip: name, one line of what it does, the key if any, the lock line
  if locked.

#### 33.4.3 Migrating saved keys (players who never rebound)

`options.txt` holds every mapping, so new defaults alone change nothing for an existing install. On
`ClientLifecycleEvents.CLIENT_STARTED`, once (`key_layout` < 2 in `config/kultivator-client.json` through
`EffectQuality.get/put`): for each moved mapping (`meditate` `;`, `info` `'`, `previous` `,`, `next` `.`,
`flying_sword` `\`, `codex` `-`) whose `saveString()` equals the **old** default's
`InputConstants.Type.KEYBOARD.getOrCreate(old).getName()`, call `setKey(getDefaultKey())`; then
`KeyMapping.resetMapping()`, `options.save()` and write `key_layout = 2`. A mapping the player changed is left alone
(it stays their key). A fresh install already has the new defaults. One chat line after a migration (on the first
world join): "Tombol Kultivator dipindah ke dekat WASD: G rapal, V Akses Cepat, Z teknik berikutnya, B meditasi, H pedang
terbang. Ubah di Pengaturan › Kontrol."

`SettingsPage` keeps its jade look (talismans for cycles, jade coins for toggles), its scrolling right column and every
stored key; it gains the five sub-coins of the hub header and shows one group at a time (no long scroll):

| group | rows (existing keys and setters, unchanged) |
|---|---|
| **Tampilan & Efek** | Kualitas efek (Minimal / Normal / Maksimal / Otomatis, the left column as today); Kosmetik ×5; Aura: mode, aura orang lain; Teknik: guncangan layar, kilatan layar, bayangan, efek pemain lain, kurangi gerakan; Dampak: puing & monumen, daya dampak, geometri raksasa, langit berubah, skala VFX momen |
| **Kamera & Film** | kamera sinematik (Penuh / Singkat / Mati / Spektakuler with its warning), lapisan lensa, langit kosmik, film kosmik 3D, waktu beku, gerak lambat, perjalanan langit, bingkai dampak (with its warning), dampak sunyi, bilah layar lebar, kartu judul, mode rekam; **Film Titah**: Pedang, Tiang, Bintang, Gunung (moved from `TitahScreen`; `EpicSettings.titahFilm / setTitahFilm`) |
| **Suara** | musik sinematik, dengung aura, suara bicara, teks suara, kredit VOICEVOX |

| **Kontrol** | tahan G untuk roda, lepas = rapal; the live list of every Kultivator key (name + bound key or "tidak diikat"); a talisman "Ubah tombol…" opening vanilla `KeyBindsScreen(hub, options)`; the G / quick-actions note; under a small "Permainan" heading at the bottom: Hardcore terobosan (its 3 s second-click confirm kept) |

Rows come from the same sources (`EffectQuality`, `AuraSettings`, `EpicSettings.rows()` sorted into groups by row key,
`VoiceSettings.rows()`); a row key missing from the group table falls into Tampilan & Efek, so a later module's row is
never lost. The 7b rule "settings must survive every edit" (23.17.5) holds: every row listed in 33.1 appears exactly
once.

line, `kultivator.hub.sekte.none`), `uxpages.*` (P: link lines, renamed-tab hints, empty states, "?" tooltips) and
`pengaturan.*` (G: group names and tips, the Kontrol texts). Existing values change only where 33.6 says, in the
fragments assigned to P. Both languages always together.

### 33.10 Uji (Indonesia)

1. Instal baru: Kontrol › Kultivator menunjukkan G, V, Z, B, H, M, Backspace; tidak ada yang merah.
2. Instal lama dengan `;` `'` `,` `.` `\` `-` bawaan: setelah masuk, meditasi pindah ke B, teknik berikutnya ke Z, pedang
   terbang ke H, info/sebelumnya/kodeks menjadi tidak diikat; satu baris chat muncul sekali; tombol yang pernah diubah
   pemain tetap.
3. Ketuk V: Gulungan terbuka di bagian terakhir; V lagi menutup. Tahan V: roda Akses Cepat; lepas di tiap irisan
   menjalankan fungsinya; lepas di tengah membuka Gulungan; klik kanan/Esc batal; WASD tetap jalan.
4. Tahan G: Roda Segel; roda Akses Cepat tidak bisa terbuka bersamaan.
5. Tombol 1-8 berpindah bagian; Tab/Shift+Tab berpindah sub-koin; tiap tablet, koin, kartu dan "?" punya tooltip.
6. Dari Gulungan buka Kitab Teknik, Dunia, Keabadian, Aula, Murid, Kitab Panduan: Esc kembali ke bagian asal; V menutup
   semuanya. Dibuka dari dunia (klik kanan prasasti, M, perintah): Esc menutup.
7. Fana: kartu Alam Rahasia abu-abu "terbuka di Pemurnian Qi"; belum naik ke Alam Abadi: lima kartu Keabadian abu-abu;
   Titah abu-abu dengan alasan yang benar; klik kartu terkunci menampilkan alasan, tidak diam.
8. Tanpa sekte: Sekte menunjukkan "Dirikan sekte"; dengan sekte: Aula terbuka dari jauh pada tablet yang dipilih; murid
   sekte lain tetap harus ke prasasti.
9. Aula: 8 tablet tanpa gulir di 320 × 240; `/kultivasi formasi katalog` dan sneak-use mata transport mendarat di
   Formasi; kandidat (Calon) dari server mendarat di Anggota › Calon Murid.
10. `/kultivasi dunia desa` membuka Aula › Wilayah › Desa; Dunia hanya punya Alam, Pusaka, Musuh.
11. Kitab Teknik: tiga tablet; "?" membuka Ensiklopedia pada Kitab Teknik; nama "Rangkai Segel" dan "Kehancuran Diri".
12. Pengaturan: lima grup; setiap baris lama ada tepat sekali; nilai di `kultivator-client.json` tidak berubah setelah
    pembaruan; Film Titah ada di Kamera & Film dan chip di Titah Langit membukanya; peringatan Spektakuler / bingkai
    dampak kembali ke grup yang sama.
13. Kontrol: daftar tombol sesuai ikatan nyata; "Ubah tombol…" membuka layar kontrol Minecraft dan kembali.
14. Ubah meditasi ke J: Kitab Panduan dan Ensiklopedia menulis "J", bukan ";".
15. GUI skala 2, 3, 4 dan jendela 854 × 480: tidak ada teks bertumpuk; tablet hanya glyph bila sempit.
16. Saat film/sinematik berjalan, V dan G-tahan tidak membuka roda/Gulungan; WASD tetap melewati shot.
17. Sodium + Iris (shader aktif): Gulungan, roda dan HUD tampil normal; FPS tidak turun saat roda terbuka (laptop lemah,
    Minimal).
18. Semua perintah `/kultivasi ...` lama tetap bekerja.

## 34. Dunia Kultivasi yang Luas

User request (2026-10-22, Indonesian, binding): implement ideas 53-68, "really focus here, make it HIGH DETAIL and
GOOD": 53 Kota kultivator NPC (auction house, teahouse, black market), 54 NPC kultivator pengembara (exchange knowledge
or fight), 55 Reruntuhan gua leluhur (formation puzzles), 56 Kapal terbang sekte (long journeys), 57 Naga liar (wild
dragons in the sky that can be subdued), 58 Evolusi binatang roh (beast tribulation), 59 Peristiwa langit acak (spirit
meteor shower, blood eclipse, twin moons), 60 Pertanda harta lahir (rainbow light pillar, everyone races for it),
61 Perburuan harta antar-kultivator NPC (rivals race, fight each other, ambush), 62 Penjara iblis kuno (a seal that can
break), 63 Dunia Bawah (Diyu: Naihe, Meng Po, the Yama court, ghost NPCs), 64 Laut Tanpa Batas (spirit islands, sea
monsters, Dragon Palace), 65 Menara 100 lantai (every floor a trial), 66 Kota Abadi (Immortal City in Alam Abadi),
67 Peta dunia kultivasi (world map in the menu with sect territories), 68 Cuaca roh (dense Qi mist, cultivation bonus).
Follow-up (user, binding): "berarti nanti kamu akan mengedit mod world generationnya juga ya" — yes: this phase adds
the mod's own **world generation** (34.0 rule W1), and nothing else changes blocks.

### 34.0 Scope and binding rules

> **User decision (phase 34, 2026-10-22):** the third block exception is **world generation**. New towns, ruins,
> prisons, towers, islands and palaces are vanilla data-driven structures (structure + template_pool + structure_set +
> processor_list JSON, jigsaw, NBT templates written by `tools/structgen.py`), generated only when the game generates a
> **new** chunk; new dimensions get their terrain only from their dimension / dimension_type / noise_settings (or flat /
> fixed biome sources). Rule 1 of 0 stays for every runtime path: no effect, power, technique, event, entity, puzzle,
> seal, NPC, ship, dragon, command or formation of this phase places, breaks or changes a block at runtime.

Worldgen (W):
- **W1** Runtime block changes ONLY through `kehancuran/WorldBreaker` (the player's own opt-in Mode Kehancuran, disciple
  Destroyer Arts) and `sect/build/engine/BuildPlacer` (the confirmed sect footprint). Phase 34 adds no third runtime path.
  The structures are ordinary terrain once generated: Mode Kehancuran may carve them like any terrain inside its caps,
  except the protected zones that 34.2.4 adds through the existing `ProtectedZones.addZoneProvider` hook (no new break
  path).
- **W2** Puzzle doors, seals, barriers, moving parts, ship hulls and dragon bodies are **entities**: a server entity with
  synced state and, where players must be stopped, collision (`canBeCollidedWith(Entity) == true`, the `AbstractBoat` /
  `Shulker` / `HappyGhast` pattern, verified in mcsrc), drawn on the client with client-only Display entities posed
  through `client/fx/spec/DisplayKey` (never a raw `setTransformation` loop). Never `setBlock`, never `FallingBlockEntity`.
- **W3** No `LightningBolt`, no weather, time or tick-rate change. Sky events and spirit weather are client visuals plus
  server gameplay modifiers (34.5.8, 34.5.10). Vanilla weather is only *read* (thunderstorm → Jiao Petir, 34.5.11).
- **W4** Structures generate only in new chunks, at moderate frequency (34.2.1 table), never inside the 6-chunk ring
  around world spawn, with `exclusion_zone` against vanilla villages where a town could overlap one.
- **W5** No chunk force-loading. The only chunk tickets are `DuniaTickets` (34.4.7): a custom `TicketType` with
  `FLAG_LOADING` and a 100-tick timeout, radius ≤ 1, at most 4 alive, used by a ship's cloud leap and a dimension
  arrival, released by the timeout.
- **W6** No runtime structure placement either: test commands never use `/place`; they **find** the nearest structure
  (vanilla locate) and teleport, or show a template as a client ghost preview (34.4.6).

Visuals and weak laptop (V):
- **V1** Every new visual is client side, scaled by `EffectQuality` (Minimal / Normal / Maximal, `scale()`, `chance()`,
  `othersScale()` for other players' effects) and, for anything big, the 7b `EpicBudget` (`takeQuads`, `takeLarge`,
  `takePillar`, `displayCap`, the frame guard). Budgets are listed per feature as `Minimal / Normal / Maximal`.
- **V2** The "heavy shader" look is faked: layered additive quads (`EpicRenderTypes`), glow textures, the `kultivator:qi`
  particle, HUD overlays (`EpicScreen`, `CloudWipe`, `TitleCard`) and `SkyDirector` grades. **No post chain**, no core
  shader, no new render pipeline; Sodium and Iris stay compatible (`ShaderCompat` profile: under a shader pack the
  quads drop to `PACK_QUADS`).
- **V3** Distance LOD everywhere: full detail ≤ 32 b, reduced ≤ 96 b, silhouette or nothing beyond. Entity counts are
  capped on the server (34.4.8); AI is throttled (NPC goals every 4th tick when no player is within 24 b; despawn with no
  player within 64-96 b; never saved bodies, state lives in anchors or SavedData).
- **V4** 7b camera rules: shots are short (≤ 4 s) and skippable (Backspace, WASD), obey Kamera sinematik Penuh / Singkat /
  Mati, never start in real danger (`ShotGuard`: low health, recent damage, a hostile within 8 b) and never during a
  film. Title cards obey "Kartu judul".

Code (C):
- **C1** Server code never references client classes. ItemStacks lazily (no stack in a static initializer or renderer
  constructor). Keep each file's line endings (`KultivatorClient.java` and 38 lang fragments are CRLF; new files LF).
- **C2** Every module registers its own payloads (`PayloadTypeRegistry`, as `aura/AuraPreviews`), entities, items,
  commands and config in its own init class in its own package, wired by ONE line in `DuniaContent.init()` /
  `DuniaContentClient.init()` (both already wired in `Kultivator` / `KultivatorClient`, 34.4). Nobody edits
  `network/Payloads.java` or `Net.java`, `KultivatorConfig.java` or `CultivateCommand.java`.
- **C3** Lang only in `lang-src/<fragment>.en_us.json` + `.id_id.json` with identical keys, Indonesian primary; every key
  in exactly one fragment (the `mergeLang` task fails otherwise).
- **C4** Every big system has an on/off switch with a sane default (34.4.5) and a test command under `/kultivasi uji`
  (the single cheat root; chips in `CheatHelp`, group `jelajah`, 34.4.6).
- **C5** Every Sumber line, gameplay number and block-safety rule of earlier sections stays. Every feature has a Sumber
  line (`Sumber: ...` when the source states it, `Terinspirasi dari ...` when the mod extends it), lang keys
  `kultivator.<module>.<feature>.source` / `.inspired`, shown in tooltips, screens and the Ensiklopedia.
- **C6** Verify every Minecraft API in `butterbot-fabric/reference/mcsrc` and every Fabric API in the jars of the Gradle
  cache before use; 34.1 lists what this design already verified.

### 34.1 Facts from the code and the 26.3 sources (verified 2026-10-22)

Structure templates (`StructureTemplate.save/load`, `NbtUtils`, `StructureTemplateManager`, `TemplateSource`):
- File `data/<ns>/structure/<path>.nbt`, gzip NBT (`NbtIo.readCompressed`), root compound: `DataVersion` int,
  `size` [I×3], `palette` [state] (or `palettes` [[state]]), `blocks` [{`pos` [I×3], `state` I, `nbt`?}],
  `entities` [{`pos` [D×3], `blockPos` [I×3], `nbt`}].
- A palette state is `{id: "minecraft:stone_bricks", properties: {facing: "north"}}` (**lower-case `id` / `properties`**
  in 26.3; `properties` absent for a single-state block). Vanilla 26.3 templates read with `tools/nbt.py` confirm it
  (`plains_small_house_1.nbt`, `tent_taiga_6.nbt`: DataVersion 5023, `id` / `properties`).
- `SharedConstants.WORLD_VERSION = 5023`; a template with DataVersion 5023 is not data-fixed.
- Blocks are stored full blocks first, then other blocks, then block entities, each sorted by y, x, z
  (`buildInfoList`); `placeInWorld` places in list order. Block entity nbt carries `id` (`saveWithId`). Air is stored
  (clears terrain); `structure_void` is simply absent.
- Jigsaw block: state `minecraft:jigsaw[orientation=<FrontAndTop>]` (`north_up` ... `up_north`, `down_south` ...),
  block entity keys `name`, `target`, `pool`, `final_state` (default `minecraft:air`), `joint` (`rollable` / `aligned`),
  `placement_priority`, `selection_priority`.
- `SinglePoolElement` places template entities (`setIgnoreEntities(false)`) and removes structure blocks
  (`BlockIgnoreProcessor.STRUCTURE_BLOCK`); `placeEntities` writes `Pos`, drops `UUID`, creates the entity from nbt
  (`id` required) and `finalizeSpawn`s mobs with `EntitySpawnReason.STRUCTURE`. Vanilla `Marker` keeps **no** data in
  26.3 (empty `addAdditionalSaveData`), so the anchors are our own entity (34.4.1).
- `ChunkMap.addEntity`: an entity type with `clientTrackingRange 0` is never sent to clients (the Marker rule).

Worldgen JSON (codecs in `JigsawStructure`, `Structure.StructureSettings`, `StructureSet`, `StructurePlacements`,
`AbstractSpreadingStructurePlacement`, `StructureTemplatePool`, `StructurePoolElementType`, `StructureProcessorTypes`,
and the vanilla 26.3 data in the jar):
- `worldgen/structure/*.json` `{type: "minecraft:jigsaw", biomes, step, spawn_overrides, terrain_adaptation
  (none|bury|beard_thin|beard_box|encapsulate), start_pool, size (0-20), start_height {absolute}, use_expansion_hack,
  project_start_to_heightmap?, max_distance_from_center (int 1-128 or {horizontal 1-128, vertical}),
  start_jigsaw_name?, pool_aliases?, dimension_padding?, liquid_settings?}`.
- `worldgen/structure_set/*.json` `{structures: [{structure, weight}], placement: {type, salt, spacing (0-4096),
  separation, spread_type?, frequency?, frequency_reduction_method?, locate_offset?, exclusion_zone? {other_set,
  chunk_count 1-16}}}`; placement types `random_spread`, `concentric_rings`, **`dimension_origin`** (new: only the chunk
  `ChunkGenerator.getOrigin()`, = `ChunkPos.ZERO` for noise and flat generators).
- `worldgen/template_pool/*.json` `{elements: [{element, weight 1-150}], fallback}`; element types
  `single_pool_element`, `list_pool_element`, `feature_pool_element`, `empty_pool_element`, `legacy_single_pool_element`;
  element `{location, processors, projection rigid|terrain_matching, override_liquid_settings?}`.
- `worldgen/processor_list/*.json` `{processors: [{processor_type, ...}]}`; types `blackstone_replace`, `block_age`,
  `block_ignore`, `block_rot`, `capped`, `gravity`, `jigsaw_replacement`, `lava_submerged_block`, `nop`,
  `protected_blocks`, `rule` (`rules: [{input_predicate, location_predicate, output_state}]`).
- `FlatLevelSource.createState` uses `structure_overrides` when present (the flat settings list), else every set.
- `worldgen/noise_settings` in 26.3: `default_block`, `default_fluid`, `disable_mob_generation`, `legacy_random_source`,
  **`material_rule`** (a registry reference such as `minecraft:nether`; there is no `surface_rule` key any more),
  `noise {min_y, height}`, `noise_router`, `sea_level`, `spawn_target`, `debug_functions`. Copy a vanilla file and change
  only what is needed.
- `dimension_type` 26.3: `attributes` (environment attributes: `minecraft:visual/*`, `minecraft:gameplay/*`),
  `timelines`, `skybox`, `default_clock`, `cardinal_light`, `has_ceiling`, `has_skylight`, `has_fixed_time`,
  `coordinate_scale`, `min_y`, `height`, `logical_height`, `infiniburn`, `ambient_light`, spawn light limits; see
  `alam_abadi.json` / `alam_rahasia.json` and vanilla `the_nether.json`.

Other verified facts:
- Fabric `ResourceLoader.registerBuiltinPack(Identifier, ModContainer, Component, PackActivationType)`
  (fabric-resource-loader-v1 3.0.4, in 0.162.0+26.3), `PackActivationType.NORMAL | DEFAULT_ENABLED | ALWAYS_ENABLED`;
  `MinecraftServer.configurePackRepository` adds a **new** pack automatically when its source says so and it is not in
  the world's disabled list (verify that Fabric's built-in source does this for `DEFAULT_ENABLED` before relying on it
  for old worlds; 34.4.5 has the fallback).
- `TicketType(long timeout, int flags)` is a public record, registered in `BuiltInRegistries.TICKET_TYPE`; flags
  `FLAG_PERSIST 1`, `FLAG_LOADING 2`, `FLAG_SIMULATION 4`, `FLAG_KEEP_DIMENSION_ACTIVE 8`,
  `FLAG_CAN_EXPIRE_IF_UNLOADED 16`; `ServerChunkCache.addTicketWithRadius(type, pos, radius)` / `removeTicketWithRadius`.
- Vanilla 26.3 entities useful here: `minecraft:mannequin` (`Mannequin`, a player-shaped body with a
  `ResolvableProfile`: the soul journey's empty body, 34.5.13), `minecraft:cushion` (`Cushion`, a block-attached seat
  decoration: teahouse cushions in templates; verify sitting before promising it), `HappyGhast.canBeCollidedWith`
  (a mob players stand on: the ship pattern, 34.5.15).
- `kehancuran/ProtectedZones.addZoneProvider(ZoneProvider)` (a `protects(ServerLevel, BlockPos)` predicate counted as
  the hall zone; a failing provider protects): the only Mode Kehancuran hook this phase uses (34.2.4).
- `util/Targeting.isHostileTo`: duels first (`DuelRules.dueling`), `Targeting.addExclusion(BiPredicate)`, players only in
  sparring, owned pets only while attacking, `Enemy` or a mob targeting the caster. So a peaceful NPC (a
  `PathfinderMob`, not `Enemy`) is never hit by area techniques until it fights; `DuelRules.begin(a, b, maxTicks,
  listener)` is the non-lethal duel (ends at 10 % health).
- `cultivation/SpiritSites`: a fixed `Site` enum (mountain ×1.5, cherry grove ×1.4, beacon ×1.5, amethyst ×1.3, End
  ×1.6, full moon ×1.5), product capped at `CAP 4.0`; `Meditation.gainPerSecond` uses
  `min(3.5, site × formation × fuel)`. There is **no provider hook** for sites yet (L adds one, 34.6 L).
- `beast/BeastData`: kinds `WOLF 0`, `FOX 1`, `MAX_TIER 3`, `TIER_XP {0, 100, 400, 1200}`,
  `TIER_REALM {Mortal, Mortal, Golden Core, Nascent Soul}`; titles Serigala Tersadar / Roh / Petir Bulan / Langit and
  Rubah Tersadar / Roh / Ekor Tiga / Ekor Sembilan.
- `guide/GuideChapters`: 12 chapters in a static block; manual ticks are saved **by step id**
  (`extra.panduan.m`), so appended chapters keep every save valid; `CHAPTER_COUNT` is read by `GuideProgress` and
  clamps `chapter(int)`.
- `client/screen/HubCardsPage`: the Dunia section has four built-in cards (Alam Rahasia, Pusaka, Musuh, Cincin) in a
  `switch`; there is no card registry yet (T adds one, 34.6 T). `HelpPage.TOPICS` is a static array; `CheatHelp.GROUPS`
  a static list.
- Existing spirit stone values (`SpiritStones.MISSION_PK` 0.5 / 4.5 / 40 / 300): this phase prices in **Nilai Batu**
  (NB) with Low = 1, Mid = 9, High = 80, Supreme = 600.
- Existing names reused, never duplicated: Lelang Abadi (`abadi/Auction`, priced in Batu Asal Abadi), natives
  (`abadi/Natives`), rogue cultivators and bands (`musuh/RogueCultivators.spawnBand`), Pengejaran (`abadi/Pursuit`),
  Penyergapan (`musuh/Ambushes`), elite beasts (`elite/*`), primordial beasts (`purba/*`), Bencana Bintang, Hujan Api
  Meteor of the inner world (`batin/BatinMeteorEntity`), secret realms and their slot leases (`alam/Slots`,
  `alam/WallGrid`, `alam/RealmRun`), return points (`alam/ReturnPoint`), the disciple player model (`RogueRenderer`,
  `EnvoyRenderer` pattern), the 7b director, sky grades and cards.
